A debt-ridden building owner agrees to stage a fake kidnapping to save his family and property, only for the plan to spiral into a real abduction and a dangerously escalating situation.

Get ready, Australia! The nation's biggest obsession just got a whole lot juicier. The Married At First Sight universe is expanding like never before with the launch of MAFS: After The Dinner Party, your first and only place to dive into exclusive, unfiltered interviews with the participants right after the show's iconic dinner parties. Plus, fans will have the chance to see unseen footage that picks up right where the main show leaves off, offering even more drama and insight.

With Jules Lund, Brittany Hockley, and Laura Byrne steering the conversation, the debrief starts the second the dinner party ends. MAFS: After The Dinner Party is the ultimate companion series, offering an unapologetic look at the season's biggest scandals. Whether it’s the 'red flags' or catching a first glimpse of the wreckage, this is the essential, no-holds-barred breakdown where the tea is spilt, and the real truth is revealed.
A marketer with traditional views on love and marriage tries to navigate a connection with an adult toy company CEO with different values.
overview_id: Dua orang yang sangat bertolak belakang bertemu, memicu hubungan tak terduga yang menggoyahkan pandangan mereka tentang cinta, gairah, dan kehidupan.

overview: College student Kong Xiaocan discovers that his mother, Kong Guifang, is terminally ill. Through a "life energy" exchange, she regains her youthful appearance at 20 and begins a new chapter in her life, alongside her son and young friends.
overview_id: Kong Xiaocan rela mempertaruhkan hidupnya demi menyelamatkan sang ibu, Kong Guifang, yang sakit parah. Secara ajaib, Guifang kembali muda dengan wajah seperti usia 20 tahun dan mendapat kesempatan menjalani hidup baru. Namun waktu Xiaocan mungkin tak panjang. Di tengah kebahagiaan ini, mampukah mereka mewujudkan mimpi sebelum segalanya terlambat?

overview: When Luang Pho and the gang become suspects in a diamond robbery case, an action-filled mission to restore their honour begins.
Haunted by his past and hunted by his enemies, a Special Forces veteran fights to keep a teenage girl alive on the deadly streets of Rio de Janeiro.
overview_id: Dihantui masa lalu dan diburu oleh musuh-musuhnya, seorang veteran Pasukan Khusus berjuang untuk menyelamatkan seorang gadis remaja di jalanan Rio de Janeiro yang kejam.

overview: Returning to England, Susan Ryeland is reluctantly drawn into a new Atticus Pünd mystery, this time written by a new, young writer. 'Pünd’s Last Case" is a story set in 1955, in an exotic villa in Corfu – but the identity of a real killer is hidden in the text, and once again Susan is going to find herself in grave danger.

The daughter of a former Hooter's waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.
overview_id: Calon penulis Margo Millet hamil, terpaksa putus kuliah, dan menghadapi kekacauan finansial. Namun, saat ayahnya yang mantan pegulat profesional muncul, Margo dapat cara tak terduga untuk mengomersialkan bakat berceritanya.

overview: With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Kayce Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana, where he and his teammates must balance family, duty and the high psychological cost that comes with serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence.
A cast of bears, raccoons, deer, foxes and a host of other horny, lovable forest critters navigate love, sexual relationships and the universal need to hook up and find a partner.
overview_id: Dari pikiran-pikiran gila di balik "Big Mouth" hadir serial komedi animasi dewasa yang liar tentang cinta, seks, dan hubungan yang berlatar dunia hewan.

overview: A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.
overview_id: Seorang ibu yang baru bercerai terjerumus ke dalam lingkaran berbahaya akan pemerasan, pembunuhan, dan sepak bola remaja.

overview: When human remains from an old case are unearthed, a forensic pathologist mysteriously makes contact with his father thirty years in the past. Their connection draws them into a series of murders, forcing them to work across time to uncover a buried truth.

Angelo Doyle lives two totally separate lives — fearsome NYC hitman and sleepy upstate Cooperstown photocopier salesman and father. Both of them are threatened when he is diagnosed with Alzheimer's, a disease he already lost his older brother to.

When star Korean spatial designer Lee Yubin loses everything, he heads off to a Japanese island. There, he meets Karin, a resilient strawberry farmer. Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

After a forbidden act to save the fairy Yuyao, heavenly official Lu Siyuan is condemned to repeated reincarnations, binding their fates across lifetimes. Drawn back together again and again, they face a vengeful force in Xuan Qing and the consequences of defying heaven while protecting a powerful relic tied to their past.
In this crime thriller, Detective Chen Chia-jen races to unmask Baba the Witch, the viral tarot reader who accurately predicts the deaths of influencers.
At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.
Corinne runs Chénoise prison with her unlikely team: By-the-book Jeff, JP who's always been closer to inmates than colleagues, and rookie Stéphanie.
Two women from seemingly-opposite backgrounds both navigate the difficulties of mothering adult children.

Explore the greatest machines, most impactful weapons, and groundbreaking innovations of WWII, shining a light on the engineering and technological advances that shaped the course of the conflict and continue to influence our world today.

A disillusioned billionaire heir Trai abandons his fortune and hides among ordinary people, where he falls for Phakbung, a day laborer who believes money is everything. As love deepens, Trai must confront his fear that wealth will once again come before true love.

Filmmaker Eric Goode follows his first love — reptiles — into the dark underworld of exotic animal smuggling. In this billion-dollar global network, everyone is chasing the ultimate prize, whether it be owning the rarest of species, claiming the biggest fortunes, or taking down the most elusive criminals. As he digs deeper, Goode uncovers a labyrinth of outlaw traffickers, bombastic collectors, and the dogged law enforcement agents on their tails.
The story of Piotr Leyer, a lawyer who, through a tragic twist of fate, becomes the head of a criminal gang.
This trophy-packed, insider-fuelled documentary charts José Mourinho's iconic rise as one of the world's top footballing managers of the most elite clubs.
overview_id: Dokumenter yang menjabarkan prestasi dan info orang dalam ini mengupas perjalanan José Mourinho sebagai salah satu manajer sepak bola top dunia di klub-klub paling elite.

overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."
overview_id: Seorang penulis yang tertutup terbangun untuk menemukan identitasnya dicuri - dan harus bersekutu dengan rentenir yang kejam untuk merebut kembali hidupnya dari seorang pria yang dikenal sebagai "Tikus."

overview: When a comic becomes the inspiration for a killer, the author is forced to work with a detective to try and uncover the truth.

A young woman destined to suffer as a tribal spirit medium is rescued by a city outsider who falls in love with her. But after tragedy strikes, she returns as a vengeful spirit seeking justice against those who abused her.
In 1970s Istanbul, a man's forbidden love for a shop-girl evolves into a lifelong journey of obsession and longing.
overview_id: Istanbul, 1970-an. Cinta terlarang seorang pria kepada gadis penjaga toko berubah menjadi obsesi dan kerinduan seumur hidup. Berdasarkan novel ikonik karya Orhan Pamuk.

overview: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.
overview_id: Pegawai baru bekerja di agensi idola favoritnya, ia berubah dari penggemar menjadi pegawainya yang paling dipercaya.

overview: Restless, razor-sharp and refusing to conform, 17-year-old Sybylla Melvyn is dead set on writing her own story in an era that expects her to find a man and settle down.
overview_id: Gelisah, cerdas, dan keras kepala, Sybylla bertekad menentukan jalan hidupnya sendiri di zaman yang mengharapkannya untuk menikah dan berumah tangga.

overview: Join the sweet and naïve Aemie as she navigates married life with mafia boss husband Zeke, and the dangerous world she’s about to enter.
After accidentally freeing a Dragon Lord from the Dragon Abyss, a sacrificed general's daughter allies with him to fight political conspiracies.
Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

A laugh-a-minute romantic comedy where a 2025 feelings coach gets zapped into a cheesy vintage novel and meets her match, a 1999 CEO who's sweet on the outside but shrewd within. In the ultimate battle of romantic tactics, who will out-scheme whom? To get home, influencer Lin Huan'er launches an operation to win over CEO Gao Haiming, only for her clever plans to hilariously backfire. Just as her ticket home appears, she realizes her heart has already checked in for good. Can this cross-storybook couple write their own happy ending?
overview_id: Saat seorang podcaster cinta dari tahun 2025 terjebak dalam novel romansa klasik dan bertemu dengan bos dingin manipulatif dari tahun 1999. Demi kembali ke dunia nyata, Lin Huan’er menjalankan misi menaklukkan sang bos, Gao Haiming. Tapi makin ia mencoba, makin ia terseret ke dalam dunia fiksi itu—dan makin sulit baginya untuk pergi. Ketika waktunya harus kembali tiba, apakah ia rela meninggalkan cinta yang tak terduga ini?

overview: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.
A reclusive doctor with supernatural abilities faces a disruption when her young niece visits, bringing a different and more intense approach to their shared gift of communicating with spirits.
When fame becomes a burden and criticism leaves wounds, crossing paths with this tutoring guy… will it be a lesson, or a test of the heart?
A school teacher with dreams of becoming a professional gamer is forced to marry her childhood first love, whose hatred of video games puts their relationship to the test.

A descendant of a legendary tomb-raiding family infiltrates four powerful clans before returning to a mysterious tomb from 20 years earlier, where deadly traps and supernatural horrors reveal a long-hidden truth.

For the first time ever, 12 Naked and Afraid All-Stars are going overboard. They've been told it's a Lost Coast challenge in the South Pacific, but they're about to be shipwrecked in the dark of night instead. The All-Stars will have to survive for 35 days -- and then rescue themselves to go home.

Special Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to the NCIS field office and partners with a roguish agent, Nick Schaeffer, to help lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.
overview_id: Dari dunia REACHER, babak baru dimulai. Frances Neagley, seorang detektif swasta di Chicago dan mantan rekan Jack Reacher di Unit Investigasi Khusus 110 Angkatan Darat AS, bertekad mengungkap kebenaran setelah seorang teman lamanya tewas dalam kecelakaan yang mencurigakan.

overview: Examines stories of absurd, outrageous, and dramatic real-life residential conflicts from a wide range of larger-than-life characters across the United States, opening a verité portal into the lives of contemporary American.

To save her gravely ill grandmother, top student Zhou Wan approaches her mother's stepson, Lu Xixiao, for funds. They fall for each other over the summer after graduation but are torn apart by misunderstandings in reality. Ten years later, they reunite at work. Though Lu Xixiao harbors resentment, his love for Zhou Wan remains. As they uncover the truth behind a "factory accident," they resolve their differences and reunite.

Pei Qian accidentally gets an invitation from a mysterious big brother to start a company that must aim to lose money, and eventually becomes a conscientious boss in the hearts of his employees and an industry-recognized business whiz!
overview_id: Saat dipecat dari perusahaan besar, Pei Qian justru mendapat tawaran aneh dari sosok misterius untuk mendirikan perusahaan yang harus merugi. Ia merekrut tim serba tak meyakinkan, menaikkan gaji, memberi cuti, dan berinvestasi di proyek-proyek nyeleneh. Namun semua rencananya selalu berbalik untung. Dianggap bos idaman dan jenius bisnis, Pei Qian cemas bagaimana jika gagal merugi?

overview: Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a soccer player — altering both of their fates.

After a mystical reversal turns the divine stone spirit Shangguan Ziyan into a man, he joins the disciplined Daoist Yuan Chu in the Yuan Zhen Sect. Appointed as demon hunters, the two embark on a mission to seal monsters and restore the heavens—only to uncover each other’s hidden secrets along the way.
overview_id: Kemunculan “Jejak Langit” membawa bencana siluman ke dunia manusia. Shangguan Ziyan, siluman kecil yang menderita penyakit misterius, dan pendeta Tao Yuan Chu yang dikutuk sehingga orang yang dicintainya akan mati, bekerja sama sebagai Pemburu Siluman No. 9 untuk menghadapi berbagai ancaman dan menutup “Jejak Langit”.

overview: After 26 years of tournament drought, Norway's 2026 World Cup hopes were next to nil. But what followed rekindled belief.
overview_id: Setelah 26 tahun tak ikut turnamen, harapan Norwegia di Piala Dunia 2026 hampir nol. Namun, kini keyakinan mereka bangkit, sebagaimana diceritakan dalam dokumenter ini.

overview: Follow five work-obsessed twenty-somethings striving for professional success and, if they have time, personal happiness in Manhattan's most glamorous neighborhood, Murray Hill.
A literature professor discovers a student's talent and offers him writing lessons — but as he sinks into the story, their sessions spiral into chaos.
overview_id: Dosen literatur menemukan bakat seorang murid dan menawarkan pelajaran menulis kepadanya—tetapi saat ia menyelami cerita si murid, sesi belajar mereka menjadi kacau.

overview: Oasis is the most luxurious holiday resort in the country — a paradise reserved for the wealthiest families, featuring private beaches, VIP facilities, and impenetrable security. The perfect place to spend the best summer of your life. But everything falls apart when the police storm the resort to investigate a mysterious disappearance. In such an exclusive place, everyone is a suspect — and no one can leave until the culprit is found.

Hannah Wells tutors hockey captain Garrett Graham to win over her crush. Their deal becomes real connection as they face their pasts. Friends Logan, Dean, Tucker, and Allie navigate college life and love.
overview_id: Hannah Wells membantu kapten hoki Garrett Graham mendekati pujaan. Hubungan mereka berubah. Logan, Dean, Tucker, dan Allie menjalani kampus dan cinta.

overview: A wildly unpredictable romance begins when a flawed “master of melodrama” actor encounters a mysterious woman who believes she is the female lead of a TV drama.

A decade after O.J. Simpson was controversially acquitted of the murders of his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ron Goldman, he attempted to rebrand himself as a reality TV star with the hidden camera prank PPV special Juiced.

After seven years of marriage, a couple decides to call it quits—but their “perfect breakup” quickly turns into a messy battle of pride, jealousy, and unresolved feelings. As unexpected twists pull them back together, they must confront the love they thought was long gone. Can they truly walk away from each other?

In 1995, Zhao Fengsheng returns home only to be shunned by villagers, prompting him to lead the “Four Troublemakers of Old Street” in uncovering a dark conspiracy, settling old feuds, and restoring peace to their town.
overview_id: Pada tahun 1995, Zhao Fengsheng yang pulang ke kampung halamannya justru dikucilkan oleh warga Jalan Lama akibat sebuah kesalahpahaman. Demi membersihkan namanya, Zhao Fengsheng bersama kelompok yang dikenal sebagai "4 Biang Kerok Jalan Lama" membongkar konspirasi kejahatan dan kekuatan hitam, meredakan dendam serta konflik lama, hingga akhirnya berhasil mempertahankan kedamaian tanah kelahiran mereka.

overview:
One map brought to life by excitement, adventure, and 'challenges' !

Travel the world by following the 'Challenge Map', take on hidden missions across the globe, and prove each group's strengths and unique charm.
Orphan Xiong Yuanbao and his neighbor Mu Qingyun grow up side by side, supporting each other through life’s hardships as their deep bond and shared dreams are tested in a changing era.

Free-spirited commoner Lina unexpectedly becomes a candidate to wed the cold and duty-bound Prince Kiran, but as she navigates palace rivalries and political intrigue, she discovers she may be the key to exposing a rebellion—and the consort destined for him all along.
Follows a controversial undercover operation that sent Alain Olivier, a drug-addicted Quebec forestry student, to death row in Thailand in 1989.

In the 1990s, orphan Zhang Xiaoman grows up in the industrial city of Tiexicheng, earning the title “Son of Tiexicheng” for his loyalty and integrity. Alongside the steady Xia Lei and the brave Yan Xiaodan, he experiences a passionate youth. As economic changes force them to leave their hometown to search for new opportunities, they eventually return, weaving a touching story of unwavering loyalty and finding their way back home.
overview_id: Pada tahun 1990-an, Xiaoman, Xia Lei, dan Yan Xiaodan tumbuh bersama sebagai “anak-anak pabrik” di kawasan perumahan sebuah pabrik militer di Timur Laut. Ketika perubahan ekonomi membuat pabrik merosot dan hidup mereka terpecah ke berbagai arah, ketiganya harus meninggalkan kampung halaman untuk bertahan hidup—hingga akhirnya kembali untuk membangun kembali tempat yang membesarkan mereka dan menemukan kembali arti mimpi, persahabatan, dan cinta.

overview: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?
overview_id: Seorang jaksa yang ambisius kehilangan ingatan dan tinggal bersama pelatih tinju yang mengaku sebagai pacarnya. Mampukah situasi rumit ini berubah menjadi cinta sejati?

overview: Two in-laws forced to raise their orphaned nephew together slowly overcome their misunderstandings, finding personal growth and an unexpected romance through co-parenting under one roof.
On a remote tropical island, 16 players must survive the elements, outmaneuver rivals and remain part of a team for a chance to win a $1 million prize.
overview_id: Di pulau tropis terpencil, 16 pemain harus bertahan hidup menghadapi kondisi alam ekstrem, mengakali pesaing, dan menjadi bagian tim untuk memenangkan satu juta dolar AS.

overview: In Republican Shanghai, Murong Qingyi, a warlord’s son swapped at birth, endures years of torment. His life changes when Ren Susu saves him, but tragedy strikes her family because of it. Years later, love sparks between them, but Ren Susu fakes her death to save another, leaving Qingyi heartbroken. Three years on, she returns as his future sister-in-law. Love, hate, betrayal, and old wounds resurface. As war looms, the two must defy fate together, but can love survive a nation’s fall?
overview_id: Di tengah kekacauan era Republik, cinta terlarang tumbuh antara Murong Qingyi—anak jenderal yang tertukar—dan Ren Susu, penyelamatnya di masa lalu. Namun, pengorbanan, kematian palsu, dan status sebagai calon kakak ipar harus memisahkan mereka. Saat cinta kembali tumbuh... akankah mereka bisa bersama?

overview: After losing his wife and daughter in a terrorist attack, an elite bodyguard goes into hiding and forms a private security team overseas to protect Chinese citizens living abroad.

A woman wrongfully believed to be dead returns with her child, while another woman assumes her twin sister’s identity to seek revenge. Years later, a woman who looks identical to a murdered daughter appears and abandons her own identity to avenge her father. As both women sacrifice their identities for revenge, what fate awaits them?

In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.
A timid lawyer who suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts teams up with a cold, elite attorney, and together they take on supernatural clients whose unfinished business reveals buried truths.
After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.
One hundred Italian athletes face brutal physical challenges, each battling to outlast the rest and claim the glory of becoming the one true champion.
Reality competition show based on the original Korean format.
A continuation of the *Śleboda* series, centering on anthropologist Anka Serafin and journalist Sebastian Strzygoń. This time, the story takes us to Upper Silesia.
When a gifted ER surgeon is thrust into cosmetic medicine, her clash with a celebrity doctor exposes the greed and desire beneath the glamour.
overview_id: Saat ahli bedah IGD berbakat terjun ke dunia kecantikan, perseteruannya dengan dokter selebritas mengungkap keserakahan dan hasrat di balik glamor.

overview: In 1977 Moscow, two "PONIES" ("persons of no interest") become CIA operatives and uncover a Cold War conspiracy their husbands were killed for.
A man and a woman who swore off marriage find their carefully controlled lives overturned after a one-night mistake forces them into an unexpected, reverse romance neither planned nor wanted.

After returning home to revive her mother’s failing restaurant, Ren Xizhou reunites with her estranged high school classmate Xiang Nanfeng. As they work together to save the restaurant and confront their past misunderstandings, they heal old wounds and find the courage to embrace a new beginning.

After losing an important memory before ascending to immortality, Bai Suzhen descends to the mortal world with Xiao Qing to find Xu Xian and repay a past kindness. Along the way, they become entangled with demon hunter Xu Xian and Fa Hai, setting the four on a fateful journey.

Follow the Commander-in-Chief and his eccentric staff as they tackle the kind of crises that Rick Sanchez could never be bothered with - from interdimensional diplomacy to paranormal investigations and unexplained phenomena.

Now leading different lives from their Toronto crime-fighting days, private investigators Matt Shade and Angie Everett encounter a world of different cases along with a new group of friends while solving cases in Victoria, British Columbia.
Hoping for a last chance at redemption, a young inmate takes a job inside a luxury Parisian hotel rife with ruthless ambition and betrayal.
A troubled new student and an aloof young man make an unlikely investigative pair as they try to uncover the truth behind crimes at their school.

Li Changshou, a terminally ill patient in his previous life, is reborn into the Primordial World as a low-level Qi cultivator who cherishes life and avoids all karmic entanglements. Determined to dodge the great calamity foretold by the Heavenly Dao, he adopts the "Way of Steady" — his ultimate goal being to secure a humble post in the Heavenly Court and survive quietly. He operates with extreme caution: when still, he's as steady as an old dog; when he moves, he shakes the heavens. He firmly believes the era of bloodshed is over — better to trick than to kill, better to stay single than to fall in love. Yet enemies and beauties keep surging toward him like tides. Before he knows it, he becomes a mastermind pulling strings behind the scenes, entangled in power plays among multiple factions, orchestrating the "Dragon Clan's ascent to Heaven" — and even the great calamity itself accelerates toward him…
overview_id: Li Changshou, yang merupakan pasien berat di kehidupan sebelumnya, secara tidak sengaja terlahir kembali ke dunia kuno, menjelma menjadi seorang alkemis kecil yang menghargai kehidupan dan tidak terlibat dalam karma. Untuk menghindari bencana besar yang diramalkan oleh takdir, dia mengikuti jalan "stabil", dengan niat untuk bertahan hidup di surga. Oleh karena itu, dia bertindak dengan hati-hati, tetap tenang seperti anjing tua, dan saat bertindak, dia menciptakan kejutan besar. Dia meyakini bahwa zaman kekerasan telah berlalu. Jika bisa menipu orang, dia tidak akan membunuh, dan jika bisa sendiri, dia tidak akan jatuh cinta. Namun, musuh dan wanita cantik datang bagaikan gelombang, dan tanpa sengaja, dia menjadi tokoh kunci di balik layar, terlibat dalam berbagai pertempuran, mengoperasikan "Klan Naga ke Langit", bahkan bencana besar itu pun semakin dipercepat datangnya...

overview: This drama follows Fan Changyu, a butcher’s daughter, and Xie Zheng, a fallen noble seeking revenge. Their fake marriage turns into true love, but war tears them apart. Determined, Fan Changyu wields her butcher’s knife on the battlefield, searching for justice and her husband. Meanwhile, Xie Zheng reclaims his title, fighting to protect his country and love. Reunited in battle, they stand together, defying fate, uncovering the truth, and returning home without forgetting their vows.
overview_id: Dalam badai salju, Fan Changyu, putri tukang jagal, bertemu Xie Zheng, bangsawan yang menyamar demi balas dendam. Mereka menikah demi tujuan masing-masing, namun cinta tumbuh di antara sandiwara itu. Hingga perang memisahkan mereka, Changyu terjun ke medan perang, Xie Zheng kembali sebagai jenderal besi. Saat kebenaran terungkap, mampukah cinta mereka bertahan?

overview: Lu Mingyu, a seemingly sheltered heiress, hardened by years of humiliation joins forces with Duan Xiuming, who becomes her weapon of revenge as they fight their enemies and pursue freedom.

When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

After being framed in a match that led to his girlfriend’s death, undefeated snooker champion Cheng Ye disappears from the spotlight and reinvents himself as a delivery driver under the alias Hei Ba. Ten years later, a chance encounter uncovers new clues suggesting her death was no accident. Determined to expose the truth, Cheng Ye returns to the high-stakes world of competitive billiards—unaware that the powerful forces behind the conspiracy are ready to silence him for good.
overview_id: Mantan ahli biliar Cheng Ye menghilang setelah kekasihnya tewas. 10 tahun kemudian, ia hidup sebagai kurir dengan identitas baru, hingga menemukan petunjuk bahwa kematian sang kekasih bukanlah kecelakaan. Demi mengungkap kebenaran, ia kembali ke dunia biliar dan mencari kebenaran atas kematian sang kekasih.

overview: Physicists and doctors race to contain a massive radiological disaster and save thousands of lives.
overview_id: Para fisikawan dan doktor berpacu untuk mengendalikan bencana radiologik masif dan menyelamatkan ribuan nyawa dalam serial drama yang terinspirasi oleh kisah nyata ini.

overview: RAFA retraces Nadal's remarkable journey with cinematic scope, combining testimonies from those who know him best—on and off the court—with unseen moments that reveal what lies behind the legend.

A dating reality that captures the process of forming connections through the senses, rather than relying on languages or physical appearances. Set in the culturally rich and unfamiliar landscape of Thailand, the program brings together ten young adults from Korea and Southeast Asia with completely different backgrounds and cultures to find the answer to the question. They reconnect and share forgotten emotions through the five senses — taste, sight, hearing, smell, and touch — which had been dulled by the fast-paced routines of urban life.

In Barcelona’s Raval neighbourhood, the family-run restaurant “Can Mosques” faces eviction after an investment fund buys the building. The family’s fight to survive escalates, pushing them to cross any and all boundaries.
No plans, just vibes. When two best friends and their crew set off for Texas on an entirely unscripted adventure, there's no telling what's coming next.
What started as a glamorous launchpad for aspiring models became a pop-culture juggernaut defined by explosive drama, public meltdowns, and controversies that still fuel viral moments today.

Chu Qiao, a slave girl, is rescued by Yan Xun, the heir of Yanbei, forming a strong bond with him. However, as ambitions clash and trust is betrayed, Chu Qiao finds herself entangled in power struggles and a quest for justice. Amid political turmoil and personal sacrifice, she rises as a symbol of hope, fighting to protect her people and homeland.
A regular pastry chef, framed for his wife's murder, embarks on a suspenseful journey to prove his innocence by manipulating the detective in charge of the case and uncovering the truth.
An arrogant IT tycoon is reincarnated as a struggling dry cleaner in the past, using his future knowledge to find his killer while rediscovering his humanity.

After a powerful conglomerate chairman is betrayed by his children and wakes up in the body of a young soccer player, he uses his business genius and athletic physique to seek ultimate revenge against his family.
Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.

Three hundred thousand taels of gold suddenly surface in the vast desert, where rumor has it that all who seek the treasure are doomed to become vengeful spirits. An officer of the Imperial Guard sent to investigate descends into madness on his very first day. A loyal and courageous deputy envoy who has ventured too far to turn back finds himself torn between desire and honor. After her entire family is slaughtered, a woman immune to all poisons returns to the vast desert, deliberately making herself the prize every faction is determined to seize as she sets out for revenge. Beneath the vast desert's sweeping sands lie an insatiable greed for gold and a carefully laid trap designed to lure her into the deadly game. From a relay station and an armed escort agency to a general's residence, a band of martial heroes becomes entangled in a deadly struggle across the vast and desolate frontier, bringing the spirit and ideals of Eastern wuxia to life in a new light.

A missing person case forces three girls from different walks of life to face life-altering choices, exposing the ups and downs of an ordinary family. The story intertwines the light and dark sides of the city—above ground and in the underground tunnels. As one girl navigates these challenges alone, she uncovers the truth, finds redemption, and moves toward a hopeful future.
overview_id: Kasus hilangnya seorang gadis menyeret tiga perempuan dengan kehidupan yang sangat berbeda ke dalam pilihan-pilihan sulit yang mengubah takdir mereka. Di balik wajah tenang sebuah kota, rahasia kelam tersembunyi di lorong-lorong bawah tanah. Saat satu per satu kebenaran terungkap, mereka harus menghadapi luka masa lalu, menebus diri, dan menemukan secercah harapan.

overview: After her husband is brutally murdered by a powerful consort, a grieving woman disguises herself as a physician and infiltrates the imperial city to build an intelligence network and seek revenge.
After spending 15 years consumed by revenge, a woman loses all her memories in a sudden accident, and as she searches for her past, she’s drawn toward a dangerous truth she never expected.

Best friends Debbie and Judith are forced on the run when Debbie discovers Judith isn't a forensic accountant, she's an international assassin! With a mysterious figure chasing them, and Debbie's husband involved in something deeply corrupt, it's a race against time and a road trip across Europe to untangle the truth and stay alive.
overview_id: Debbie dan Judith yang bersahabat terpaksa melarikan diri setelah Debbie tahu bahwa Judith bukanlah akuntan forensik, melainkan pembunuh bayaran internasional! Dengan sosok misterius yang memburu mereka dan suami Debbie terlibat sesuatu yang sangat korup, mereka harus berpacu melawan waktu dan melakukan perjalanan keliling Eropa untuk mengungkap kebenaran dan bertahan hidup.

overview: A principled lawyer rebuilds her career in her hometown by forming an unconventional team to fight for justice while reconciling with her estranged father.

After an Allied plane carrying a top-secret WWII bombing plan is shot down behind enemy lines, a wounded survivor hides on a Japanese-occupied island while military intelligence races to recover the documents before they doom the entire operation.
Ex-con photographer RJ Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

When Lin Wanxing returns to her hometown and takes a job at a local high school, she’s unexpectedly tasked with reviving its long-disbanded soccer team. With help from her mysterious tenant, former coach Wang Fa, they work to rebuild the team, guide the students toward their dreams, and face the shadows of their own pasts along the way.
This series follows the life and career of Brazilian soccer star Ronaldinho, tracing his journey from young prodigy to global sports icon.
overview_id: Serial ini menceritakan kehidupan dan karier bintang sepak bola Brasil, Ronaldinho, dengan menyusuri perjalanan si anak ajaib ini sampai menjadi ikon olahraga dunia.

overview: On a college campus, an author navigates a complicated relationship with his daughter.
Citizens combat urban violence until a bus driver and student's murders by thugs spark outrage, leading authorities to hunt the culprits captured on video.

Rescued from the brink of death a decade ago, Meng Tinghui has transformed from a nameless survivor into the Daping Dynasty’s first female scholar to enter the prestigious Hanlin Academy. Known for her sharp wit and cunning nature, she has spent years navigating the treacherous waters of the imperial court. While her peers see only a ruthless official, she harbors a secret devotion to the man who saved her – Emperor Ying Gua. Tinghui is intent on helping Ying Gua become the greatest ruler in history, no matter what it takes. But amidst the power struggles and political schemes, Meng Tinghui remains blind to the one truth that could change everything: the Emperor’s heart has belonged to her all along.
A desperate father searching for his runaway daughter gets caught up in a murder case — and stumbles upon secrets which could destroy his family for good.
overview_id: Seorang ayah putus asa mencari putrinya yang kabur, tetapi terjebak dalam kasus pembunuhan—dan menemukan beragam rahasia yang bisa menghancurkan keluarganya selamanya.

overview: Alliances are formed and friendships tested as seven top celebrities compete in thrilling missions to win the race.

After a high-profile mission goes sideways, Daniel 'Hondo' Harrelson is pulled out of forced retirement to lead a last-chance experimental SWAT unit made up of untested, unpredictable young recruits. Hondo must bridge a generational divide, navigate clashing personalities, and turn a squad of outsiders into a team capable of protecting the city and saving the program that made him who he is.

A devoted fan quits her stable job to pursue her dreams and finally marries her rockstar crush, Ouji Kazuhiro. But on their wedding day, she learns their marriage comes with one unexpected condition—a sexless arrangement.
Martín Salcedo is rarely swept off his feet — until Verónica Pinilla and Quiebra Canto turn up the party, booze and danger.

During a violent confrontation arranged between radical fans of two football clubs, Salvador Aguirre, an ambulance driver, rescues his injured daughter Milena, a member of the ultra group, which defends racist, violent and homophobic values, totally opposed to those he instilled in her.
A bullied rookie idol crosses paths with a famous actor who approaches her as part of a cruel bet. Attraction mutates into obsession as secrets and showbiz darkness unravel them both.
Left in a wheelchair after a crash, Santita leaves the love of her life at the altar. Twenty years later, he returns with a request that changes everything.

Renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Kay Scarpetta returns to her position as Virginia's Chief Medical Examiner, where she investigates a haunting murder with eerie reminders from her first big case decades ago. In 1998, Scarpetta works alongside Detective Pete Marino and FBI Agent Benton Wesley as they investigate a series of brutal stranglings. Based on the best-selling novels by Patricia Cornwell.
overview_id: Dokter Kay Scarpetta, ahli patologi forensik ternama, kembali ke posisi lamanya sebagai Kepala Pemeriksa Medis Virginia, di mana dia menyelidiki pembunuhan mengerikan yang mengingatkan pada kasus pertamanya beberapa dekade sebelumnya. Pada tahun 1998, Scarpetta bekerja bersama Detektif Pete Marino dan Agen FBI Benton Wesley saat mereka menyelidiki serangkaian pembunuhan dengan pencekikan brutal.

overview: J.D. & Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time–medicine has changed, interns have changed, but their bromance has stood the test of time. Characters new and old navigate the waters of Sacred Heart with laughter, heart and some surprises along the way.

After taking over his family’s company, Tan Jianfei becomes locked in a corporate power struggle with his former lover Li Shujing, reigniting old feelings—unaware that she has returned to uncover the truth behind her father’s death, turning their romance into a dangerous game of love and revenge.
overview_id: Tan Jianfei, CEO baru Grup Tan, tengah terjebak dalam krisis besar. Di saat yang sama, mantan kekasihnya, Li Shujing, tiba-tiba masuk ke perusahaan dan terlibat persaingan kekuasaan dengannya. Di balik pertentangan mereka, benih cinta lama kembali muncul. Namun Tan Jianfei tidak menyadari bahwa Li Shujing datang dengan tujuan tersembunyi, yaitu menyelidiki kematian ayahnya sebagai bagian dari rencana balas dendam. Ketika kebenaran terungkap, hubungan mereka terjebak dalam konflik keluarga dan sebuah kisah cinta yang ternyata telah dirancang sebagai jebakan.

overview: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

After being pushed to fake his death by a manipulative manager, fallen writer Fang Haowen teams up with obsessive fan Bie Fan as the "Jiongtu Duo", embarking on a chaotic redemption journey through fame, betrayal, and surreal reality.

Lord Qingyang's son, Li Si, devised a plan to infiltrate the Imperial Detective Division to uncover the truth behind the death of the Fourth Prince. There, he met and joined forces with Bai Zhenzhu, the finest female forensic expert in the land; and Meng Rui, a ghost-catcher renowned for his martial prowess but burdened with a deep-seated vendetta. Together, they formed the Divine Detectives. With seamless teamwork and unwavering determination, this trio ventured through perilous challenges, solving eight enigmatic and bizarre cases.

When young crown prince Chu Ying ascends the throne, his childhood friend, the eunuch Xiao Man, is expelled from the palace. Years later, Xiao Man returns in disguise, and as they navigate court intrigues together, their bond deepens and begins to shift in unexpected ways.
overview_id: Putra Mahkota Chu Ying menjalin persahabatan polos dengan kasim muda bernama Xiao Man sejak kecil. Namun setelah naik takhta, Chu Ying harus kehilangan Xiao Man yang diusir dari istana. 10 tahun kemudian, Xiao Man kembali dengan menyamar sebagai pria. Meski terlihat dekat, keduanya saling mencurigai. Di tengah konflic dan perebutan kekuasaan istana, hubungan mereka pun perlahan berubah...

overview: Falsely accused of murdering her father, Princess Feng Li returns from exile as a feared ruler to uncover the truth behind the crime. At a decadent banquet designed to flush out her enemies, she draws close to Yun Zhan, a mysterious slave who is secretly a fallen prince. As their hidden motives collide and political conspiracies close in, Feng Li and Yun Zhan must choose between revenge, power, and the love that threatens to undo them both.

Reborn in 1991 Shenzhen, entrepreneur Xie Nanfeng faces family hardships and the uncertainties of a rapidly changing era. Armed with determination and business acumen, she sets out to reshape both her own destiny and the future before her.
"Single's Inferno" contestants reunite to reveal honest feelings and relationship updates — revisiting standout moments from their time on the island.
From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

Ace insurance investigator Cha Woo-seok hunts a fraud ring tied to mysterious deaths and becomes dangerously entangled with Han Seol-ah, a flawless art auctioneer whose lovers all seem to die. As attraction and suspicion blur, he must uncover whether she’s a killer or a victim, before the truth costs him his life.

An unfiltered observational reality show where same-aged singles with strong, distinct personalities—who have lived alone for a long time—come together to share a house while supporting each other’s fabulous lifestyles.

Bigger in scale, with twists even more cunning, Sixth Sense returns for a brand-new season!

Is what you saw actually real?

Beyond the frame, it’s time to uncover the hidden truth beneath.

The moment you let your guard down, your entire deduction is flipped upside down!

From unpredictable personalities to spaces beyond imagination, fakes that seem real, and reals that seem fake!

The answer is always hidden on the flip side.

At the end of a deduction filled with twist upon twist, lies a truth you will never find unless you broaden your perspective.

Will the Six-Sensers discover the meticulously hidden B-side and distinguish the 'real' from the 'fake'?
A determined coach leads their ragtag LGBTQ+ softball team through ups and downs on and off the field as they chase their dreams.
Criminal psychology expert Gu Yan and his partner Shen Yu work together to solve mysterious cases and uncover the truth while confronting questions of morality, justice, and self-protection.
The magical and mundane unfold in a suburban shed as a lonely man stumbles on the supernatural.
overview_id: Sejak pacarnya menghilang tujuh tahun sebelumnya, kehidupan Michael menggantung. Namun, suatu resep mistis di sebuah jurnal lama menjanjikan jawaban yang dia tunggu-tunggu.

overview: Three former middle school friends who reunited after 37 years to pursue the mystery behind their former club advisor's disappearance.
A work-obsessed cosmetics CEO and a top home-shopping host struggling with insomnia cross paths, and through an unexpected romance, begin to heal the emptiness in their lives.
Follow true crime influencer Kara Chamberlain as she investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases that have stumped law enforcement and haunted internet sleuths for decades.
A boy vanishes, and no one can find him. An open-and-shut case, except there are no leads. Three hundred people around him, and no one saw anything?

When the CEO of a dating app unknowingly befriends someone out for revenge, old wounds resurface—threatening her company, family, friendships, love life, and even her dream of finding “someone, someday.”
A bride has a feeling that something horrifying will happen at her wedding — and the closer to the altar she gets, the worse it becomes.
overview_id: Seorang calon mempelai wanita memiliki firasat bahwa sesuatu yang mengerikan akan terjadi pada hari pernikahannya, dan makin dekat harinya, firasat itu makin kuat.

overview: After past breakups and unfulfilled romances leave novelist Ayana reluctant to truly fall in love, she tries to face her current relationship sincerely.
From rice cakes to cooking! Thanks to Torong's scheme, the Jilak brothers become part-timers at the Space Rice Cake Shop. A full-scale forced employment restaurant labor adventure!
Amid route disputes and harsh conditions during the Long March, the Red Army struggles to preserve unity while forging solidarity with ethnic minority communities.
Ben Reilly, an aging and down on his luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life as the city's one and only superhero.
overview_id: Detektif swasta Ben Reilly awalnya menerima beberapa kasus sederhana... sampai akhirnya terjebak dalam pusaran para mafia, monster, dan seorang wanita misterius yang membawanya kembali ke masa lalunya sebagai satu-satunya pahlawan super New York: The Spider.

overview: After moving to a quiet rural town to heal from past heartbreak, a withdrawn teacher slowly rediscovers warmth and joy through her unexpected connection with a rough-around-the-edges but kindhearted local man.

After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

After losing four years of her memories, Sakura moves to Singapore with her fiancé, Eita, and begins building a new life while working as a guide at a wildlife park. But when she encounters a mysterious Singaporean man named Lun and feels an inexplicable sense of familiarity, an old key engraved with “203” may hold the answers to the memories she has lost, and the life she no longer remembers.
Betrayed and left for dead, a woman returns with a new face and a mysterious ally to dismantle the people who destroyed her life.
overview_id: Jiang Lai rela mendonorkan ginjalnya demi cinta, tetapi justru dikhianati oleh kekasihnya. Ia bahkan dijebak agar dianggap mengalami gangguan mental dan nyaris dibunuh. Setelah lolos dari maut, ia mengubah wajah dan menyamar sebagai Zhao Ke. Bersama Zhao Mai, seorang wanita misterius, ia kembali untuk menyusun jebakan demi jebakan dan membalikkan keadaan.

overview: Step into a thrilling chapter inspired by For All Mankind. Same alt-history universe. Different perspective: the Soviet Union's. Go behind the Iron Curtain with the cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers who risked it all in the race for the Moon.
overview_id: Masuki sebuah babak menegangkan yang terinspirasi oleh For All Mankind. Dunia sejarah alternatif yang sama. Perspektif: Uni Soviet. Jelajahi negeri Tirai Besi dengan para kosmonaut, rekayasawan, dan agen intelijen yang bertaruh segalanya untuk ke Bulan.

overview: A young group of cadets come together to pursue a common dream of hope and optimism. Under the watchful and demanding eyes of their instructors, they will discover what it takes to become Starfleet officers as they navigate blossoming friendships, explosive rivalries, first loves and a new enemy that threatens both the Academy and the Federation itself.
After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

A typical day at Lochmill Capital is upended when armed thieves burst in and force Zara and her best friend Luke to execute their demands. In the aftermath, conflicted detective Rhys races against time to find out who stole £4 billion pounds of people's pensions and why.
overview_id: Hari yang normal di Lochmill Capital berubah ketika para perampok bersenjata menyerbu dan memaksa Zara dan sahabatnya, Luke memenuhi tuntutan mereka. Usai perampokan, detektif Rhys harus segera menemukan para pelaku dan alasan mereka mencuri 4 miliar paun dana pensiun.

overview: After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.
overview_id: Setelah mengetahui dia mewarisi sebuah pulau terpencil di Kanada dari kakeknya yang tak diizinkan menemuinya, Annie Jacobson yang berusia 17 tahun pergi menyelidikinya hingga memasuki dunia penuh rahasia, persaudarian tak terduga, dan sejarah keluarga rumit yang disembunyikan darinya.

overview: A man and a woman whose lives are shaped by loss and time drift apart in youth and reunite a decade later, discovering that the bond they once shared remains a guiding light through love, grief, and growing up.
overview_id: Jatuh cinta di masa remaja, dua orang yang beranjak dewasa berpisah. Bertemu lagi 10 tahun kemudian, mereka menghadapi patah hati, perubahan, serta tantangan baru mereka.

overview: As Japan's most famous fortune teller, Kazuko Hosoki ruled TV and bestseller lists, but who was she behind rumors of spiritual scams and underworld ties?
overview_id: Sebagai peramal kondang dari Jepang, Kazuko Hosoki mendominasi TV dan daftar buku laris, tetapi siapa dirinya di balik rumor penipuan spiritual dan kaitan dunia kriminal?

overview: Ten talented performance directors battle through high-stakes choreography challenges for the ultimate prize of directing a K-pop music video.
A gifted, humbly born musician and a wealthy student fall for each other amid personal rivalries and a life-changing accident.
After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.
overview_id: Stuart Bloom diberi tugas memulihkan realitas setelah menyebabkan Kiamat multisemesta.

overview: Six non-Amish individuals on a rare journey leave behind their modern "English" lifestyle and step into a deeply traditional Amish community in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

On the eve of her engagement, Ding Dang reunites with her first love, only to discover he is living under a new identity after developing dissociative identity disorder from a failed experiment. Determined to help him heal, she and her friends secretly carry out a plan to guide him into confronting his buried trauma and reclaiming his true self.
overview_id: Menjelang pertunangannya, Ding Dang kembali bertemu cinta pertamanya yang kini hidup dengan nama dan identitas baru setelah mengalami gangguan kepribadian akibat kegagalan eksperimen. Demi menyembuhkannya, Ding Dang bersama teman-temannya diam-diam menjalankan sebuah rencana untuk membantunya menghadapi luka masa lalu dan keluar dari trauma yang selama ini menghantuinya.

overview:
SUMBAKKOKJIL is back for the summer of 2026, with even more sophisticated horror and suspense!

Building on the signature hide-and-seek gameplay from Season 1, the new season weaves in eerie Korean urban legends to create a horror variety experience that goes beyond traditional entertainment.

In this expanded horror universe, the cast must immerse themselves in each ghost tale, survive massive suspense, and find a way to escape.

With massive locations and urban legends brought to life, SUMBAKKOKJIL delivers an immersive horror experience unlike anything before.

Su Wan, a university student majoring in animal psychology, follows a trail of clues to rescue a group of trafficked dogs and ends up in grave danger. She is unexpectedly rescued by Ye Tianyu, her long-lost childhood companion, whose sudden reappearance reconnects them after sixteen years apart.

Prince Rawi, forced into a loveless marriage, is betrayed by his wife’s affair and her deadly plot against him. After falling into an abyss during the confrontation, he wakes with amnesia in a village, starting a new life as Tawan under Lukjan’s care.

A mysterious body by the Tong River resurfaces clues to a five-year-old case, bringing together three childhood friends—now a criminal investigator, a detective, and an undercover agent. As they pursue the truth behind multiple unsolved crimes, they navigate hidden dangers and unravel deep conspiracies.

Meet the bizarre, amazing and breathtaking creatures and landscapes of a vibrant lost world; and discover how life not only survived during the cataclysmic events of this prehistoric era, but thrived.
A suspenseful urban tale where seemingly ordinary neighbors hide dark secrets, leading to a web of distrust and hidden truths.
Left crippled and betrayed after his sect is destroyed, a fallen cultivator rebuilds his power and rises to challenge his enemies, his fate, and the heavens themselves.
Two brothers become police officers to hunt down their parents' killer, who escaped justice by just two days before the statute of limitations was abolished.
Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?
A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.
overview_id: Pria ahli waris perusahaan dengan jantung buatan bertemu wanita bermuatan listrik. Mereka membuat kesepakatan yang membuat jantung si pria berdetak sekaligus deg-degan.

overview: During the Tang Dynasty, gifted forensic investigator Li Jinglan joins forces with the mysterious “ghost detective” Jueming and skilled constable Su Yu’an to solve a string of shocking cases. As they uncover hidden conspiracies behind each crime, danger, justice, and romance become deeply intertwined.
At an unconventional school for kids who avoid traditional classrooms, Tatsuki's carefree approach baffles strict Shizuku as they learn to reach students.

An inspector from the Educational Rights Protection Bureau (ERPB) who is authorized by the government to use physical intervention and unconventional methods to discipline delinquent students and reform the educational system.
overview_id: Saat rasa hormat tidak ada lagi di sekolah, para inspektur tak biasa tiba demi memperbaiki situasi—dengan berbagai pelajaran keras dan lugas yang tak ada dalam buku teks.

overview: Dali Court official Zhang Yi, driven by a hidden blood feud, partners with Jin Yiwei agent Shen Youzhi to hunt a killer—while secretly masterminding a carefully planned revenge that leads all conspiracies to a final judgment.
overview_id: Zhang Yi, pejabat muda Pengadilan Kekaisaran, menyimpan dendam dan menunggu waktu yang tepat dalam diam. Di luar, ia bekerja sama dengan Shen Youzhi, memburu kejahatan, namun diam-diam Zhang Yi adalah dalang di balik layar dari rencana balas dendam besar. Sebuah jebakan yang dirancang dengan cermat tertutup rapat, dimana setiap pilihan bisa menentukan nasib hidup atau mati…

overview: A successful entrepreneur with a seemingly perfect life sees everything fall apart after discovering her husband covering up a murder allegedly committed by their daughter. As the family scrambles to hide the truth, an anonymous blackmailer claims to have recorded everything, pulling them into a dangerous web of lies, secrets, and betrayal.
Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace is convinced the airport couldn’t possibly run without his 24/7 devotion. But new Terminal Manager Mira Ansari-Cole is convinced he’s a walking liability.
Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.
A body found in the middle of town. A luxe label on the rise. A detective tests every stitch of a woman's story that keeps changing. What really happened?
overview_id: Sebuah jasad ditemukan di pusat kota. Sebuah label mewah tengah naik daun. Seorang detektif menguji kisah seorang wanita yang terus berubah. Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi?

overview: Inside the bubble of Silicon Valley, a data-mining CEO strives to turn insight and influence into profit and power in this darkly comedic look at the warped dreams, outsized egos, and ethical lapses of the self-styled inventors of the future.

The world of high fashion turns dark when international supermodels begin dying in gruesome and mysterious ways. FBI Agents Cooper Madsen and Jordan Bennett are sent to Paris to uncover the truth. As they delve deeper into the case, they uncover a sexually transmitted virus that transforms ordinary people into visions of physical perfection, but with terrifying consequences.
Detectives Tom Radley and Emma Crane fall in love while investigating the small-town murder of a figure skater, until one becomes a suspect.
In a seemingly perfect retirement community, a crew of unlikely heroes must stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have: time.
overview_id: Di komunitas pensiunan yang tampak sempurna, sekelompok hero tak terduga harus menghentikan ancaman dari dunia lain yang ingin mencuri hal yang tak mereka miliki: waktu.

overview: A young police officer goes undercover with a traveling music truck band to investigate corruption and expose a powerful local figure.
A modern lawyer transported to an ancient kingdom defends the powerless and reforms its laws before becoming entangled with a prince in a dangerous struggle over the succession.
Ex-members and family speak out about The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City star Mary Cosby and the troubling inner workings of Faith Temple Pentecostal Church.

When Dobby declares his intent to sell the D Dorm, he ends up on a mission to track down the first love of the spirit A Kong in exchange for the right. All the while, he has to deal with the residents trying all sorts of methods to prevent the sale.

While investigating her best friend’s suicide, single mother Yan Ling is drawn into a dangerous web of emotional manipulation. As love and betrayal become entangled, she begins to recognize the truth, break free from control, and reclaim her life.

In a quiet coastal town, a missing bag of drugs ignites a chain of chaos, pulling together a detective, a desperate father, an ambitious young woman, and two siblings caught in addiction. As their lives collide, a risky rescue mission begins—one that no one will walk away from unchanged.

When best friends Bobby and Romy mistakenly open up a gateway to another world, they turn their sleepy coastal town into a hotspot for terrifying creatures of doom. Roped into an epic supernatural mystery, they will cross paths with the so-called “Chosen One” and do battle with both literal and inner monsters.

It tells the story of Li Qiuping, Zheng Decheng and other grassroots cadres from Donggang Town leading the local farmers and people to work together to build a prosperous and harmonious modern city on the beach.
overview_id: Di awal 1980-an, Pingchuan membangun kota Yuehai demi mengejar kemajuan. Li Qiuping dan Zheng Decheng memimpin ribuan petani membangun kota modern dari lahan kosong tanpa dana negara, lewat gotong royong dan kemitraan. Sebuah keajaiban pembangunan yang mengubah nasib ratusan ribu orang dan menorehkan sejarah di masa reformasi.

overview: In 1990s Los Angeles, Wanda and Leon fight to take West Coast rap mainstream while gang wars erupt and record labels move to exploit hip hop culture for their own gain.

Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.
overview_id: Masuki seluk-beluk program paling dominan dalam sejarah basket kampus saat Geno Auriemma mendorong para pemainnya hingga batas maksimal untuk memenangkan 12 gelar. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, dan lainnya mengungkapkan apa yang dibutuhkan untuk bertahan di UConn dan membangun sebuah dinasti.

overview: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...
overview_id: Di awal perantauan ke Beijing, Shang Zhitao berpapasan dengan "genius aneh" Luan Nian. Dengan keberanian dan semangatnya, Shang Zhitao perlahan tumbuh dan berubah, hingga mampu meruntuhkan dinding hati Luan Nian yang keras dan penuh perhitungan. Keduanya saling tertarik, terlibat dalam tarik‑ulur cinta di rimba kota, berpisah dan bersatu berulang kali. Cinta adalah mengerahkan seluruh keberanian tanpa menyisakan penyesalan. Kasih adalah saling menyembuhkan dan tumbuh bersama. Namun di antara cinta dan kasih, dia memilih untuk bertahan hidup. Saat dia sudah bisa berdiri sendiri, dia menahan sisi agresifnya, mereka yang sepadan akan menuliskan akhir baru bagi satu sama lain...

overview: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

After discovering that her wealthy husband has been unfaithful, a Chinese housewife resolutely divorces him and makes ends meet by working from the bottom up at a hotel, which is to be presided over by the hotel manager who previously tried to help her husband cover up his infidelity.
overview_id: Pernikahan sempurna Xu Miyu runtuh tepat di ulang tahun ke-10, mendorongnya memilih bercerai dan memulai hidup baru. Bekerja sebagai petugas kebersihan di Purong Hotel, ia bertemu kembali dengan Ji Feng, manajer baru sekaligus kenalan lama. Di tengah tantangan kerja, cinta tumbuh dan bersama mereka mengubah Purong Hotel menjadi ikon kota yang baru.

overview: When the Sea Calamity strikes and the Divine Tree appears, whoever claims its fruit gains power over all creation, sparking a bloody war among the immortals, demons, and monsters. A century later, Lei Xiuyuan seeks out Qingqiu orphan Xiaobangchui to save his brother. Fate brings them to Chufeng Academy, where loyal friends give her warmth and love begins to bloom. As their bond deepens from friendship to something more, the truth of her origins slowly unravels, threatening everything they've built.
overview_id: Bencana besar tiba, Pohon Primodial muncul, yang mendapatkan Titisan Pohon Primordial bisa mengendalikan segalanya. Suku Dewa, Siluman dan Iblis terjerumus ke dalam perang berdarah. Ratusan tahun kemudian, Lei Xiuyuan sengaja mendekati Bangchui dari Qingqiu (Jiang Lifei) demi menyelamatkan kakaknya. Keduanya kemudian berkultivasi di Akademi Chufeng karena suatu kebetulan. Teman yang sangat melindunginya menjadi teman pertama bagi Bangchui dan menanamkan benih cinta di dalam hatinya. Hubungan Jiang Lifei dengan Lei Xiuyuan pun berkembang dari sahabat menjadi saling mencintai. Pada akhirnya mereka masuk ke perguruan yang sama. Di saat hati keduanya makin mendekat, rahasia identitas juga perlahan-lahan mulai terungkap.

overview: When a young attorney is accused of murdering a police officer's son, he teams up with the "Evil Lawyer" to exploit loopholes and prove his innocence.
overview_id: Dijebak atas kejahatan brutal yang tak dilakukannya, seorang pengacara muda memasrahkan nasibnya kepada pembela kejam untuk membersihkan namanya dan menemukan kebenaran.

overview: At Mirage City's 444 Convenience Store, Xia Dongqing and Ya join forces with a cryptic Night Watcher to maintain the balance between realms—until a crimson moon exposes a hidden conspiracy. Though peace returns, new anomalies stir in the shadows.
In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

Eldest daughter Ye Li marries the crippled Prince Mo Xiuyao, while her sister Ye Ying weds Prince Mo Jinglei the same day. A descendant of Lishan, Ye Li secretly seeks revenge on those who wronged her clan. Suspected by her husband, who also hides a revenge plan, the couple gradually become allies. Meanwhile, Prince Jinglei plots to seize the throne. In the end, Ye Li and Mo Xiuyao join forces to defeat their enemies and restore peace to the empire.
overview_id: Putri sulung Keluarga Ye, Ye Li, menikah dengan Pangeran Mo Xiuyao, yang hidup terasing dan lumpuh. Namun di balik wajah tenangnya, Ye Li menyusun rencana balas dendam atas tragedi masa lalu. Saat rahasia mulai terkuak, siapa yang lebih dulu akan berkhianat—atau sebaliknya?

overview: After her husband's unexpected death and a very public breakdown, famed cook Hollis hosts her best friends for an elaborate weekend on Nantucket.
A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

Zhang Chao, a quiet and withdrawn student, finds himself at odds with a school bully while seeking the truth behind his roommate’s mysterious death. As he digs deeper, he unravels a hidden secret about his past, embarking on a transformative journey of friendship, redemption, and self-discovery.

Boonsita, who has always seen the future, suddenly gains the ability to glimpse the past when she meets Warat, a man haunted by dreams of a mysterious woman. Together, they uncover long-hidden secrets of love and destiny, confronting truths that have been concealed across time.

Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show reboots with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.
overview_id: Selamat datang di The Grand Tour. Seri kendaraan bermotor paling hebat di dunia yang kembali dengan pembawa acara baru - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman, dan Francis Bourgeois - serta perpaduan khas petualangan globalnya, kendaraan menakjubkan, aksi epik, dan opini yang kuat.

overview: Gathering in the care home where they now live, Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May host three special shows looking back at their favourite Grand Tour moments. Or at least the ones they can remember. Their fading memories stretch from California to Mongolia to Italy and everywhere in between, and include classic moments of misery featuring mud, water, and at least two actual injuries.

Modern girl Xi Yuan travels to the realm of Xuanji, where she faces numerous dangers, and her true identity and hidden powers gradually emerge. With the realm's safety at stake, Xi Yuan bravely confronts significant challenges, demonstrating her courage and resilience while striving to protect those around her.
overview_id: Xi Yuan, seorang gadis modern yang tak sengaja memasuki Dunia Xuanji dan terseret ke dalam perang saudara di Negeri Huyun. Di tengah berbagai bahaya yang mengancam nyawanya, jati diri Xi Yuan perlahan terungkap, sementara kekuatan Dewa Phoenix yang tersegel di dalam dirinya pun terbangkitkan oleh takdir. Demi melindungi seluruh Dunia Xuanji, Xi Yuan mengesampingkan keselamatannya sendiri, bangkit menantang hukum ilahi tertinggi, dan pada akhirnya berhasil menyelamatkan seluruh makhluk di Dunia Xuanji berkat kecerdasan serta keteguhan hatinya.

overview: A kidnapping case uncovers a decade-old murder hidden in an old phonograph recording. As the investigation reveals shocking secrets, three young people, once full of potential, form an unbreakable bond, facing their dark pasts and protecting each other from fate’s grip.
On the back nine of his career, golf legend Lonnie "The Hawk" Hawkins chases one final major — and drags everyone he loves into the chaos.
overview_id: Di penghujung kariernya, sang legenda golf Lonnie "The Hawk" Hawkins mengejar satu turnamen mayor terakhir dan menyeret orang-orang terkasihnya ke dalam kekacauan.

overview: A tribute ink scandal topples the Li family’s long-standing ink business, leaving their legacy in ruins. Years later, Li Zhen, the determined youngest daughter, sets out to restore her family's name. As she rises in the industry, she joins forces with Luo Wenqian, heir to another fallen clan, to take on a rising rival and face new challenges from foreign markets, fighting to bring Huizhou ink back to its former glory.
overview_id: Pada pertengahan Dinasti Ming, sebuah kasus tinta upeti mengguncang industri tinta Huizhou dan menjatuhkan keluarga pembuat tinta Li yang telah berjaya selama berabad-abad, sementara keluarga Luo bangkit hingga mencapai puncak kekuasaan sebelum akhirnya ikut hancur akibat intrik pemerintahan. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, Li Zhen, putri bungsu keluarga Li, bertekad menghidupkan kembali usaha pembuatan tinta keluarganya dan perlahan menjadi sosok baru yang diperhitungkan di industri tinta Huizhou. Di saat yang sama, Luo Wenqian, putra kedua keluarga Luo, berusaha memulihkan kejayaan keluarganya dengan mengubah tatanan industri tinta. Bersama, mereka menghadapi persaingan sengit dan tantangan perdagangan luar negeri demi mengembalikan nama besar tinta Huizhou, dalam kisah tentang ambisi, cinta, dan warisan budaya yang bertahan melintasi zaman.

overview: Young detective Tang Tang reopens a decade-old case and uncovers a sprawling criminal network behind a series of disturbing incidents across the city. As the truth comes into focus, the investigation takes a devastating personal turn that puts everything he cares about on the line.
overview_id: Polisi muda Tang Tang menyelidiki kembali kasus 15 tahun lalu saat pelaku utamanya kembali ke Qingcheng. Penyelidikan membuka jaringan kejahatan dari penipuan hingga kasus pembunuhan misterius. Saat kebenaran hampir terungkap, sahabat masa kecil Tang Tang diculik, dan dalang di balik semuanya ternyata adalah seseorang yang tak pernah ia duga...

overview: For the first time in over 40 years, Frank Salerno tells his story of the Hillside Strangler manhunt, revisiting the case that changed him forever. Kenneth Bianchi shares his story on camera for the first time of his role as one of the two people behind the Hillside Strangler.

The epic tale of a proud and passionate family, secret loves, and bloody revolution. The Trueba family's passions, struggles, and secrets span a century of violent social change, culminating in a crisis that hurls the proud, tyrannical patriarch and his beloved granddaughter towards opposite sides of the fence.

When friends on a hunting trip get into a deadly clash with other hunters, they vow to keep it a secret. But as paranoia sets in—and a ruthless gang seeks revenge—the friends must confront their morality, families, and savage instincts.
overview_id: Saat sekelompok sahabat yang sedang berburu terlibat bentrokan mematikan dengan pemburu lain, mereka bersumpah untuk merahasiakannya. Namun ketika paranoia mulai merasuki dan sebuah geng kejam hendak membalas dendam, mereka harus berhadapan dengan moralitas, keluarga, dan insting liar mereka sendiri.

overview: Taeju and Seyun are on the verge of divorce. But when a drunken comment from Taeju gets Seyun kidnapped, everything changes. Even worse, he's now the prime suspect. Forced to go on the run, Taeju must rescue his wife on his own. To save her, he pushes himself to the absolute limit.
The return of corrupt judge Lee Han-young, who was a slave to a large law firm, to the past 10 years ago. He makes new choices to punish evil and implement justice.

In the turbulent era of the Republic of China, student Ye Pingjun takes a job at a Western Hunan meeting house to fund her mother’s medical care. However, she's unexpectedly caught in the crossfire of an assassination attempt against the powerful Yu family’s fifth son, Yu Changxuan, and ends up accused of a crime she didn’t commit. Pingjun strikes a bold bargain: if Changxuan cannot identify the true culprit within ten days, he must clear her name. What begins as a high-stakes investigation quickly evolves into a calculated courtship as Changxuan maneuvers to win her heart while hiding a complex web of secrets. Will their blossoming romance survive the encroaching shadows of war, or will the secrets of their past pull them apart?

Yi Qin'e is taken to the cultural troupe by her uncle Hu Sanyuan to learn to sing Qinqiang Opera. From then on, her life unfolds with ups and downs. She achieves glorious artistic accomplishments, yet also experiences a profound sense of loneliness beyond ordinary people's comprehension.
overview_id: Secara tak terduga, Yi Qin’e dibawa pamannya masuk ke dunia opera Qin. Dari seorang gadis penggembala biasa, ia perlahan tumbuh menjadi legenda panggung yang disegani. Di tengah perubahan zaman, jatuh bangun dunia seni, dan pergolakan hidup selama puluhan tahun, Qin’e harus bertahan menghadapi cinta, ambisi, dan kehilangan. Namun saat sorotan panggung mulai meredup, apakah ia masih mampu mempertahankan tempatnya sebagai sang bintang utama?

overview: A plastic-spoon man is on his way to becoming a legendary army cook—uncovering dark secrets within the base through his cooking skills.

In the legendary Nine Cities, noblewoman Fan Yun and cunning lord Qi Zheng join forces to overcome a looming crisis. As they fight for the people's welfare, their bond deepens into friendship and love to bring peace and prosperity to the realm.

Haunted by his mother’s unsolved death, Bai Zhongtian returns to Baiyun Town, where sinister legends of ghostly weddings and supernatural rituals begin to reappear. As strange sightings and rumors spread, he follows a trail of clues to uncover the truth hidden beneath the town’s eerie folklore.
overview_id: Ibu Bai Zhongtian tewas secara misterius sejak lama. Warga desa percaya ia “dibawa pergi” oleh siluman ular panjang. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, Bai Zhongtian kembali ke Desa Baiyun dan mendapati desanya diselimuti berbagai legenda aneh: pernikahan siluman ular, ritual guntingan kertas pemanggil arwah, rombongan sandiwara hantu, dan payung kertas merah yang menyeramkan. Saat seorang warga kembali menyaksikan pernikahan siluman ular di hutan, Bai Zhongtian mulai menyelidiki kejadian-kejadian tersebut dan perlahan mengungkap kebenaran di balik semua misteri itu.

overview: A millennium-era leak case shaping cross-strait dynamics hides a covert tug-of-war between foreign forces and Chinese agents. In the late 90s, rookie Chunxiao and star agent Ma Qi foil plots together, but as time passes, the case reshapes all involved amid era-defining shifts.
The Clyburns uproot their comfortable New York City lives to the wild, untamed beauty of Montana's Madison River Valley on a search for connection.

Explores the definitive story of the Burning Man festival, filmed over three years with the co-operation of the Burning Man Project, the non-profit behind it, and featuring archive from the last 30 years.
Before her death, Lucy creates a game for her sister, Greta, pushing her into a journey of self-discovery — and toward the charming Will Tucker.
A bandit leader's deputy and an opera troupe orphan seeking revenge become unlikely allies when they uncover a plot to trade a family treasure for opium and join forces to seize it.

After being betrayed and buried alive by his own father, wealthy young man Fan Sha’er escapes and is forced into a life of exile. Through a chain of misfortune and guidance, he stumbles into a bandit gang, rises to become its leader, and forms a brotherhood that fights for justice.
overview_id: Fan Sha'er, putra kaya yang polos dan ceroboh, nyaris tewas setelah dikubur hidup-hidup oleh ayahnya sendiri akibat menyerbu lumbung pangan. Dalam pelarian, ia bertemu Xiugu dan ayahnya, lalu tanpa sengaja terseret ke dunia perampok. Dari buronan menjadi pemimpin, Fan Sha'er membangun persaudaraan, menegakkan keadilan, hingga akhirnya bangkit sebagai komandan yang memimpin perlawanan melawan penjajah Jepang.

overview: A series of bizarre, seemingly unrelated murders in a declining industrial town in 1990s Northeast China reveal the intertwined fates of their victims, ultimately uncovering hope and humanity amid brutal survival.
A successful lawyer who has shut herself off from love after enduring betrayal and painful experiences finds her guarded life changed when a young man from her past returns after five years.
An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.
overview_id: Seorang pegawai kantoran biasa memenangkan lotre, tapi kehidupannya yang tenang justru mulai berantakan.

overview: Merlin, the immortal son of the bard Taliesin and Atlantean Princess Charis, is followed through his tragic upbringing, descent into madness, and shocking disappearance, leading to the legend that surrounds him. Set before King Arthur's birth, Merlin, assumed dead or a myth, reemerges in sub-Roman Britain to unite the fractured kingdoms under threat from Saxon invaders.
A woman determined to finally open her heart goes on a blind date with two very different men, and through the chaos and charm of it all, she ends up figuring out what love actually means for her.

The Program: Texas Tech gives unprecedented access into the Texas Tech University Red Raiders College Football Program - including exclusive interviews with head coach Joey McGuire, former quarterback Brendan Sorsby, Chairman of the Texas Tech University System Board of Regents Cody Campbell, and more - through one of the most consequential off-seasons in the history of the sport.

The caregivers and soldiers of Yan’an’s Second Nursery escort 136 children through war-torn lands to safety.
