Facing gunfire, harsh conditions, and constant danger, they sacrifice everything to protect the children, giving rise to the legendary “Children’s Long March” and an enduring spirit of courage and devotion that lives on today.
overview_id: Drama ini menceritakan peristiwa pada musim gugur dan dingin tahun 1946, ketika situasi perang berubah dan Panti Asuhan Kedua Yan’an diperintahkan membentuk sebuah tim untuk mengawal 136 anak ke daerah yang lebih aman. Perjalanan ini dikenal sebagai “Perjalanan Panjang Anak-Anak”. Para pengasuh dan tentara mempertaruhkan nyawa mereka untuk melindungi anak-anak, melewati hujan peluru dan kondisi alam yang sangat berat, hingga akhirnya berhasil menyelesaikan misi besar demi menyelamatkan masa depan anak-anak tersebut.

overview: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.
Singer Puna dreams of stardom and uncovering the truth behind her parents' deaths, forming an alliance with a police officer as the hunt turns personal.

After being falsely accused of a scandal that ruins her reputation, noblewoman Fu Tingyun escapes with the help of salt smuggler Zhao Ling. Together, they expose government corruption and navigate the treacherous world of court politics. As they seek justice and uncover the truth behind her past, their bond deepens, leading them to a new beginning.
overview_id: Zhao Ling, datang dari latar belakang yang biasa saja, tapi Ia memiliki ambisi yang besar. Kehidupannya berubah sejak tak sengaja bertemu Fu Tingyun, gadis dari keluarga bangsawan yang difitnah berselingkuh. Mereka terpaksa kabur bersama, tapi ujian dari keluarga dan istana terus menghantui mereka.

overview: A group of friends in Hong Kong's elite boating scene find their summer getaway descending into betrayal and power plays as hidden agendas surface.
“The Secret Friends Club” is a reality variety show where cast members secretly prepare a special gift for someone without revealing their identities.

Two estranged families reunite at the reopening of Hotel 88, until the former best friends behind it are found dead. Forced to share the inheritance, their children uncover buried secrets and the truth behind their fathers' mysterious deaths.
A low-born scholar rises to power to avenge his father, only to find an unexpected alliance and deep love with the defiant princess he once vowed to destroy.

17-year-old Bret Easton Ellis is in his final year at the elite Buckley prep school. Upending his world is the arrival of a mysterious new student, Robert Mallory, whose unsettling presence coincides with the activities of a serial killer known as The Trawler.

Four years after the Jianzhou Tunnel collapse, contractor allegations of corruption trigger a special investigation led by Geng Qing. When the case implicates his former classmate, Geng and his team face mounting resistance as they work to uncover the corruption network.
A very scared man navigates a barrage of absurd, terrifying, and hilarious dreamscapes, exploring fears that are both deeply personal and strikingly universal.

Growing up in Gilead is all they have ever known. As a new generation of young women grapple with the bleak future that awaits them, they will be forced to search for allies, new and old, to help in their fight for freedom.
Kama returns to her hometown and gets entangled in an old missing case. Family secrets, passions and crime reveal that the past never falls silent.

Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.
Three legal professionals with troubled pasts become entangled in complex criminal cases, where psychological warfare, hidden agendas, and long-buried secrets blur the line between hunter and prey.
The story follows Adolfo Novak, a powerful family patriarch, whose 80th birthday celebration uncovers decades of secrets, betrayals, loyalties, and a thirst for revenge.

The Forensic Unit of the Yunxi City Police Department is where the most major and baffling cases converge. Led by Captain Leng Qiming, a team of young, sharp investigative minds—including Ye Qian, Si Yuanlong, Jiao Lei, and Zhang Ziwu—tackles each puzzle. As they peel back the layers of one bewildering crime after another, they expose not just the truth but the raw nature of those involved. Yet just when one mystery seems solved, another emerges from within it. Step by step, as the truth comes to light, so too does the real face of human nature.
overview_id: Di Yunxi, Divisi Teknologi Kriminal menangani kasus-kasus paling rumit dan tak biasa. Dipimpin Leng Qiming, tim elit muda ini memadukan profiling tajam, forensik canggih, dan naluri berpengalaman. Saat mereka mengurai kematian demi menegakkan keadilan, kebenaran kelam pun terkuak, namun setiap kasus menyisakan satu pertanyaan besar...

overview: In the thriving but crime-ridden city of Shicheng, undercover officer Ling Che reluctantly joins forces with gangster Shen Yanlin. As they pursue the truth behind a series of criminal conspiracies, they uncover corruption, betrayal, and secrets that blur the line between law and crime.

A series of bizarre cases intertwines the fates of mystery blogger Shen Man and young detective Jiang Li. Together, they join forces to unravel the complexities hidden within layers of mystery to uncover the truth.
overview_id: Saat menyelidiki dugaan bunuh diri sang kakak, blogger Shen Man terseret ke dalam kasus aneh yang melibatkan seorang dokter kandungan bernama Ai Xia dan operasi pengangkatan rahim yang kontroversial. Tanpa diduga, Shen Man justru menjadi tersangka utama. Seorang polisi wanita, Jiang Li, membantu membersihkan namanya. Sebuah kartu pos misterius yang menghubungkan kedua kasus memaksa mereka bekerja sama. Namun, sebelum kebenaran terungkap, pembunuhan kedua terjadi, membuat misteri ini semakin gelap dan rumit.

overview: Yu Meng, an only child from Jiangsu Zhejiang Shanghai and a popular internet blogger, is admired as a woman with a perfect life. On her fifth wedding anniversary, the bubble of her seemingly flawless happiness shatters. Her model husband is no longer so perfect, and her marriage begins to crack, while she also faces the threat of being financially exploited. With the support of her friends, Yu Meng reexamines her life and fights to take back control.

Actor Park Bo-gum, who has a license in barbering, opens a barbershop in a remote village in South Korea together with fellow actors and real-life friends Lee Sang-yi and Kwak Dong-yeon, creating bonds and memories with the villagers

As the Javits Center construction project ignites a battle for profit in early 1980s Hell's Kitchen, a generational rift threatens the uneasy peace between violent Irish gang the Westies and the Mafia, and draws FBI heat.
A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.
When drug trafficking becomes rampant along the border, an anti-narcotics captain leads a team of young officers into dangerous undercover operations.
Gu Deyou and his master Cha investigate a series of murders in Republican-era Tianjin, uncovering a revenge plot amid a struggle between justice and evil.

Princess Danyang, Mu Wanyao, a formidable and arrogant royal, is married to Yan Shang, a cunning scholar of humble origins. Amid court intrigues, they move from rivalry and mutual suspicion to reconciliation, becoming powerful allies who join forces to break political deadlocks and safeguard peace.

After losing her husband and daughter in an explosion, full-time housewife Wen Xin discovers the ability to reverse time. With a twelve-day time gap, she races against fate, making relentless attempts to save her family.

To help support her family, Daran gave up her dreams of higher education to start working immediately after high school. Unfortunately, she struggles to find work, eventually taking a job as a security guard at a broadcasting company. But unexpectedly, she runs into her ex-boyfriend Rangsiman, now a powerful television executive. Daran and Rangsiman were deeply in love in their teens, but separated over painful misunderstandings and secrets kept from each other. Rangsiman himself is now engaged to another woman, but he finds himself drawn back to Daran, wanting to understand why she broke up with him and what led her to her current life circumstances. Can they find a way to forgive each other – and will they rekindle their old spark?

Hong Eun Jo leads a double life: a servant and healer by day and a Robin-Hood-like thief named Gil Dong by night. Grand Prince Do Wol, brother to the King, begins to investigate the case. An encounter with a monk leads to them swapping souls, and they are forced to navigate each other's complex worlds.

Wu Wei dreams of working in aerospace, but a failed interview leaves him assigned to the archives rather than the Flight Control Center. After earning a place on the elite Mu Xing team, he reunites with his longtime rival Ying Ziqi, and together they navigate the challenges of major space missions while growing from competitors into trusted teammates.

Gifted cellist Yi Lan, inspired by her mother’s influence and her childhood friend Tong Xiaole, forms a trio in her first week of high school to challenge the school orchestra and perform at the annual festival. Her fiery passion for music reignites Tong Xiaole’s own dream, and as they chase their ambitions together, love, friendship, and youth blend into a heartfelt symphony of growth and hope.

After a scam influencer’s fake fortune-telling sparks a strange kidnapping, a web celebrity, black-market criminals, and a ruthless moneylender are pulled into a 24-hour race where hidden secrets and competing agendas collide.
overview_id: Seorang influencer palsu yang mengaku bisa meramal tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus penculikan aneh. Dalam waktu 24 jam, misteri mulai terungkap dan membuka rahasia mengerikan. Tiga kelompok orang yang saling terhubung perlahan membongkar rencana tersembunyi. Seorang influencer, penculik, dan bankir licik terlibat dalam kekacauan ini, masing-masing berjuang untuk bertahan hidup atau menyelamatkan keadaan, namun justru memperlihatkan sisi memalukan mereka.

overview: Young Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess come into possession of a legendary pirate’s treasure map and are drawn into a deadly voyage across the Atlantic, where Jim is forced to navigate mutiny, violence and betrayal, leaving him forever changed.

Hao Yu, a police commissioner’s foster daughter, goes undercover in the criminal underworld and becomes romantically involved with mafia heir Ji Zhijie, who knows her secret yet risks everything to protect her. When her former lover, police officer Zhou Ziheng, returns, Hao Yu must confront a tense web of love, loyalty, and justice in a dangerous world.
overview_id: Hao Yu, anak angkat seorang komisaris polisi, menyusup ke dunia kriminal sebagai informan dan menjalin hubungan dengan putra bos mafia, Ji Zhijie. Meski tahu identitasnya, Ji Zhijie tetap melindunginya dengan taruhan nyawa. Saat mantan kekasih Hao Yu, Zhou Ziheng, kembali, kemanakah hati mereka memutuskan antara cinta, kebenaran dan keadilan?

overview: A look inside the United States Men’s National Soccer Team in the leadup to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America in June. Filmed over the course of four years, the series follows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah, Weston McKennie, and an array of U.S. players on their personal and collective journeys toward their sport’s biggest stage.
To keep their youngest brother alive, a state prosecutor becomes a double agent in her imprisoned older brother's gang.
When a young mother from a sheltered cult crosses paths with a mysterious stranger, she embarks on a risky affair that awakens desires and dark secrets.
overview_id: Saat seorang ibu muda dalam kultus tertutup bertemu orang tak dikenal yang misterius, ia memulai hubungan gelap berbahaya yang membangkitkan hasrat serta rahasia kelam.

overview: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.
overview_id: Liburan ibu dan anak ke luar negeri berubah jadi mimpi buruk ketika Gali ditangkap karena narkoba. Menolak percaya pada tuduhan itu, Orna nekat mempertaruhkan segalanya demi kebebasan putrinya hingga terseret ke dalam jaring rahasia Gali sendiri.

overview:
Morfa Halen is a tight-knit Welsh town precariously nestled between towering mountains and a fast-encroaching sea that threatens its very existence. As a once-in-a-generation storm begins to gather far out at sea, former detective turned teacher Jackie Ellis discovers the body of her 8-year-old pupil, Cefin, seemingly drowned.

The discovery sends shockwaves through the community, reviving the ghost of an unsolved cold case that rocked the town three years prior - the disappearance of Jackie’s niece, Nessa, which cost her career.

Seven touching stories that happen in Choi Hung Estate. Depicting different emotions and regrets, the stories reflect Hongkongers’ sentimental feelings towards public housing estates. Each of them reminds the viewers that the iconic estate is nearing its end as the characters intersect.
Korean celebrity chefs go undercover as junior chefs and must prove their skills to their bosses in only five days.

A retro office comedy depicting the chaotic events that unfold in the late 1990s when Sammo Hung, a 30-year-old elite securities supervisor who only cares about work, goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate employee at a securities firm where suspicious money flows are detected.

What do a thief, a tennis coach, a nurse, and a tollbooth worker all have in common? Coming from unique plots and a variety of characters, in each episode Martín Bossi plays a different protagonist, someone in search of an unexpected love story.
When the past catches up with two former spies, their biggest challenge isn't car chases, shootouts or fistfights — it's telling each other the truth.
overview_id: Saat masa lalu menghantui dua mantan mata-mata, tantangan terbesar mereka bukan kejar-kejaran mobil, baku tembak, atau perkelahian, melainkan saling mengatakan kebenaran.

overview: Several years after Jung Yu Mi, Park Seo Jun, and Choi Woo Shik became successful restauranters in another show, they've reunited to enjoy some time off of their normal jobs. The trio will travel all across South Korea, but there's a twist: they don't know exactly where they're going or how they're getting there, and they must travel to a new city every day. Loosely chaperoned by legendary television producer Na Yeong Seok, affectionately known as "Na PD," these actors are in for a journey they'll never forget as they're forced to make tough, yet entertaining choices along the way.

Eleven years after her father’s death destroys her family, a woman who changed her identity reunites with a tech entrepreneur and becomes entangled in a relationship that may be part of his decade-long plan or her own quest for revenge.
A sudden summer accident shatters the peaceful lives of two couples, dragging a happily married editor into a web of grief, human selfishness, and her husband's hidden secrets.
A stern officer and a sharp-witted investigator form a detective duo that solves eerie murders and uncovers corruption within the Tang Dynasty.

When a romantic getaway to Paris takes a dark turn with the sudden disappearance of her boyfriend Tom aboard a train to the south of France, Alice is plunged into a web of intrigue and danger, uncovering shocking secrets about the man she thought she knew.

Lu Wuyi, the youngest nine-tailed fox of the mysterious Formless Moon Sect, sets out on a mission with her friend Wu Wangyan to track down a fox demon on the run, Xiaowei. She infiltrates the Wei Mansion in Luo'an City, where she later crosses paths with Wu Shiguang, who holds a deep grudge, as well as Ji Ling and Li Jie, demon hunters from the Shilin Sect. In the process of uncovering the truth, they navigate between suspicion and cooperation, each driven by their own agendas. In their repeated struggles over the Dragon Deity's Power, their fates are changed time and again. To preserve peace in the world, they make painful sacrifices and ultimately subdue Jiu Ying, the lord of all demons, thus fulfilling an enduring quest of love and redemption.
overview_id: Lu Wuyi adalah Rubah Ekor Sembilan termuda dari organisasi misterius bernama Bulan Baru. Dalam misinya bersama sang kakak, Wu Wangyan, untuk mencari Xiaowei yang merupakan seekor siluman rubah yang melarikan diri, dia menyusup ke Kediaman Wei di Kota Luo’an. Secara bersamaan, beberapa orang lainnya juga menyusup ke kediaman tersebut, ada Wu Shiguang yang memikul dendam kesumat yang mendalam, serta Ji Ling dan Li Jie, penyihir dari sekte Shilin. Dalam upaya mengungkap kebenaran, mereka terlibat dalam aksi saling menguji sekaligus bekerja sama. Meskipun masing-masing memiliki tujuan tersembunyi yang berbeda, melalui perebutan demi perebutan atas Kekuatan Dewa Naga, mereka berulang kali mengubah alur nasib. Demi menjaga perdamaian dunia manusia, mereka harus membuat pilihan sulit dan pengorbanan yang berat.

overview: A bullied high schooler becomes an overnight sensation after a viral video. But when his newfound fame turns sour, he must learn to fight for himself.
overview_id: Setelah tak sengaja jadi viral karena berkelahi, seorang remaja miskin korban perundungan memulai saluran streaming untuk mendapatkan uang dan keluar dari keputusasaan.

overview: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.
A determined immigrant builds his way up from zero in Quebec's competitive 1990s business landscape, navigating challenges and opportunities while creating a successful enterprise.
When an English professor becomes obsessed with a handsome new colleague, her already complicated marriage and career are thrown into total chaos.
overview_id: Ketika seorang profesor Bahasa Inggris terobsesi dengan kolega barunya yang tampan, kondisi karier dan pernikahannya yang sudah bermasalah menjadi kacau balau.

overview: The story follows Walid (Faizal Hussein), a former leader of the deviant cult Jihad Ummah, who flees from the authorities and hides in a mountainous region to rebuild his influence. His attempt to rise again leads him to meet Habiburrahman (Aqasha), a charismatic preacher who conceals his true intentions behind eloquent words.
overview_id: Lanjutan dari series Bidaah. Setelah lolos dari penangkapan, mantan pemimpin sekte Walid bersembunyi di pegunungan untuk membangun kembali pengikutnya. Ia bersekutu dengan Habiburrahman, seorang pendakwah Indonesia yang kesalehannya menyembunyikan ambisi yang setajam ambisi Walid sendiri. Kerjasama mereka segera berubah menjadi persaingan halus untuk dominasi. Sementara itu, istri Walid yang telah berpisah, Ummi Hafizah, mencoba mengarahkan Jihad Ummah kembali ke jalan yang benar, tetapi ia mendapati dirinya tertarik pada kekuatan palsu yang pernah merusak Walid. Ustadz Fateh, guru lama Walid, kembali dari Kairo, bertekad untuk menyelamatkan mantan muridnya dan Ummi Hafizah sebelum mereka tersesat dalam kesombongan dan ilusi. Kisah mereka bertemu dalam konflik antara iman dan ego, memaksa masing-masing dari mereka untuk merenungkan makna kepercayaan, pengampunan, dan penebusan.

overview: Seven years later, Wanna One returns! In the dream hideout "Wanna-Base,” filled with Wanna One’s long-held wishes, a new chapter of their story begins. Members who had been active individually in their own paths gather at Wanna-Base laughing, playing, and making new memories together— becoming a stronger “us."
An anthology series set in the elite world of London law following two rival firms, Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne, as they face off in a different headline-making legal battle each season.
An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.
A quiet office worker reunites with her former high school delinquent classmate, only to discover that his polished new life hides a mysterious secret.

In Republican-era Shanghai, gifted painter Xu Yanzhen joins forces with bank accountant Jiang Xinyu after she is framed. Together, they risk everything to protect a priceless national treasure while uncovering a dangerous conspiracy.
overview_id: Di Shanghai era Republik Tiongkok, pelukis yatim piatu Xu Yanzhen bertemu Jiang Xinyu, kepala pembukuan bank yang dijebak dalam sebuah konspirasi. Demi menyelamatkan lukisan nasional dari tangan asing, mereka bersekutu dan menjalankan rencana berani dengan memalsukan karya seni. Di tengah intrik dan perebutan kepentingan, mampukah mereka menjaga kebenaran?

overview: An ambitious street urchin seizes the chance to impersonate a noblewoman and becomes a warlord's bride, but when her comatose husband awakens, she must navigate deadly schemes, win his heart through cunning, and uncover her royal heritage to triumph over rivals and rise from gutter to glory.
overview_id: Chou awalnya adalah gadis rendahan pengangkat kotoran malam di jalanan yang bisa diinjak-injak dan ditindas oleh siapa saja. Namun, hanya karena memiliki wajah yang sangat mirip dengan Wei Rao, putri kediaman bangsawan, dia secara tidak terduga menjadi pengantin pengusir kesialan bagi Lu Zhuo, sang putra pewaris dari Kediaman Adipati. Chou memiliki ambisi yang besar dan bertekad memanfaatkan kesempatan itu untuk naik pangkat. Suami yang hampir mati mendadak siuman dan tindakan mengambil alih posisi secara tidak sah ini memicu serangkaian bencana bertubi-tubi. Wei Rao membencinya karena merebut posisinya dan ingin menyingkirkannya secepat mungkin. Sementara itu, Lu Zhuo memandangnya sebagai wanita berhati kejam serta mewaspadai dan memperhitungkan setiap gerak-geriknya. Kediaman Adipati yang tampak harmonis di permukaan sebenarnya penuh dengan jebakan di setiap langkahnya.

overview: Two families share a close bond, but beneath the surface lies a series of concealed truths. As relationships evolve and tensions rise, each character’s hidden past and motivations begin to emerge.

During the Republican era, the theft of a jade Buddha relic and the murder of an opera troupe leader draw a young marshal, a celebrated opera performer, and a wealthy heiress into a deadly conspiracy. As long-buried secrets and an old murder case come to light, they uncover unexpected ties that reshape their relationships and destinies.
The mayor of a New England town resolves to turn it into the next tourist hot spot, despite local warnings that it's cursed.
overview_id: Wali kota sebuah kota kecil New England bertekad menjadikannya destinasi wisata populer, terlepas dari peringatan warga akan kutukannya.

overview: Twenty years after a baby-switching scheme separated the Mu family’s true heir from his birthright, Shen Jibai grows up in hardship while Mu Zhiyu returns as a renowned auctioneer determined to reclaim the family auction house from her stepmother. Manipulated into opposing each other, Shen Jibai and Mu Zhiyu are drawn into a web of power and deception, ultimately joining forces to uncover the truth and seek revenge.

In 2003, two young men emerge from the forests of British Columbia claiming to have been raised entirely off the grid. As a small town tries to help them, a mystery unfolds, testing how far people will go to believe the unbelievable.
Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.
Explores WWII from Germany's invasion of Poland through the atomic age, examining pivotal battles, wartime leaders like Churchill and Roosevelt, and the human cost of total war.
This intense documentary series details true stories of neighbors gone bad, from heinous fraud schemes to senseless acts of violent retribution.

It tells the story of Yang Xiaofang and Qi Xiaowei from the same village, who become pregnant before marriage. Yang's family rushes back to the village to strategize for Xiaofang. The Qi and Yang families have completely different attitudes, unexpectedly sparking a "marital storm." After negotiations between the two families fail, Xiaofang starts "blind dates while pregnant" — and surprisingly finds herself courted by the whole village, setting off a series of hilarious and laugh-out-loud events.

While a private investigator probes the disappearance of the young heir to a powerful fishery, he finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.
A materialist scholar strays into a demon's realm, only to rediscover a century-old soul-bond and a love predestined by fate.
In a quaint New England town, bestselling novelist Allie forms an unlikely alliance with aspiring writer and podcaster Andi to find the killer of a close friend.

Sherlock Holmes is a disgraced young man, raw and unfiltered, when he finds himself wrapped up in a murder case that threatens his liberty. His first ever case unravels a globe-trotting conspiracy that changes his life forever.
overview_id: Saksikan kisah asal-usul Sherlock Holmes yang legendaris dalam misteri penuh aksi yang menggelikan sajian Guy Ritchie pada masa awal petualangan sang detektif yang ikonis ini.

overview: Exiled from home, a man finds solace in Chiang Rai, where a guarded man helps him heal—and teaches him how to love in return.

Anna Kusakabe had it all: a high-powered career at a prestigious management consulting firm and a reputation for excellence. But when she abruptly resigns, she claims it’s to pursue financial independence and early retirement. In reality, her life is a chaotic patchwork of whims and temporary gigs. While organizing receipts for a struggling design studio, Anna crosses paths with Mizuki Seo, a brilliant yet notoriously ill-tempered character designer. Though she tries to keep her distance, she can’t ignore his tendency to accept exploitative work from shady clients. What begins as a simple attempt to intervene quickly spirals into an unexpected partnership. As Anna steps into the creative world to help Mizuki, the two polar opposites find their lives – and their professional futures – inextricably linked. Can Anna find the true independence she seeks, or will this messy collaboration change her life forever?
A heartbroken high school senior falls for his sister’s boyfriend during a summer of tutoring, first love, and self-discovery.
A 50-year-old divorcee searches for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.

When a man is found dead within the grounds of a shrine carrying a fragment of what appears to be a building blueprint, Heiji Zenigata begins investigating. While others dismiss the case as a simple robbery, Heiji suspects a much larger conspiracy. Meanwhile, the arrival of a popular traveling troupe in Edo brings new mysteries that may be connected to the murder.

Zhan Zhao, a fourth-ranked imperial guard, embarks on a solo investigation after receiving evidence of a cold case. Along the way, he encounters the strong-willed Miss Huo Linglong and the justice-driven Bai Yutang. The three like-minded companions join forces to uncover clues, uphold justice, and capture criminals. Together, they work to expose a dangerous web of power that has infiltrated both the court and the martial world, ultimately restoring peace to the people.

An exploration of the experiences of a Muslim-American family that must learn how to code-switch as they navigate the early 2000s: a time of fear, war, and the rapid expansion of the boy-band industrial complex.
overview_id: Dari kreator Ramy Youssef, hadir #1 Happy Family USA, sebuah serial animasi untuk dewasa tentang keluarga Hussein yang amat ceria - keluarga Muslim paling patriotik, paling damai, dan paling tak mencurigakan di "Amreeka" pasca-9/11. Dengan satire dan absurditas, film ini mendefinisikan kembali cara menemukan humor di masa sulit awal tahun 2000-an di bawah pengawasan ketat para tetangga yang takut.

overview: Yuki Kasuhara, a command officer in Yokohama's Fire Department, handles 119 emergency calls, balancing high-pressure crises and workplace challenges. Known for her quick thinking, she often defies norms by visiting accident scenes, sparking friction within the team.
Follow heroic first responders, as well as their family saga of power and glamour, in one of America's most diverse and dynamic cities: Nashville, Tennessee.

Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they’re innocent — but for the police, the call can reveal so much more than just the facts of the case. Find out which of them is the real killer in disguise.

After escaping a forced fate at a brothel, Chen Pan’er takes on a new identity and crosses paths with Wen Su, a nobleman who once saved her but is now bound to a powerful princess. Together, they navigate injustice and political intrigue, determined to clear their names and reclaim their freedom.
overview_id: Lahir dalam kemiskinan, Chen Pan’er dipaksa masuk ke rumah bordil oleh pejabat dengan dalih ritual dewa sungai. Ia melarikan diri, mengganti nama jadi Bao Yin, dan menjual diri sebagai pelayan untuk bertahan hidup. Ia bertemu Wen Su, pria yang pernah menyelamatkannya. Bersama, mereka menghadapi bahaya dan meraih sukses tertinggi.

overview: When Song Xiaoyu is unexpectedly pulled into a scripted world as a tragic heroine fated to be discarded by the villainous male lead, she tries to escape, only to be trapped in an endless loop of fatal outcomes each time she strays from the plot. No matter how hard she resists, the story keeps pushing her toward Nan Heng, the cold and calculating lead. As she navigates this paper-thin world where every character is bound by fate, Song Xiaoyu must fight not just for her survival, but for control over her own story.
overview_id: Song Xiaoyu tanpa sengaja masuk ke dunia naskah dan menjadi tokoh utama wanita yang ditakdirkan disakiti dan dibuang oleh pemeran utama pria; meski mencoba mengubah alur dan melarikan diri, ia terus terjebak dalam lingkaran kematian berulang, hingga akhirnya menyadari bahwa satu-satunya jalan keluar adalah melawan takdir dan menulis ulang kisah hidupnya sendiri.

overview: After a fall, food blogger He Qingqing wakes up in ancient times, where she builds a new life through hard work, unexpected love, and motherhood. Just as she finds success and happiness, she's faced with a difficult choice: return to her world or stay where her heart now belongs.
overview_id: He Qingqing, seorang food blogger, tanpa sengaja terlempar ke masa lalu dan hidup di desa sederhana. Ia harus bekerja keras melunasi hutang, menjalani pernikahan tak terduga yang berubah jadi cinta, serta membesarkan anak yang manis. Saat karier, cinta, dan keluarganya berjalan sempurna, ia dihadapkan pada pilihan sulit: tetap di masa lalu atau kembali ke dunia asalnya.

overview: After a devastating betrayal that costs her everything and nearly her life, Lian Xinru, a wealthy merchant’s daughter, returns years later disguised as a famous singer. Partnering with Pei Yuze, the enigmatic man who saved her, she embarks on a calculated and thrilling quest for justice and revenge.
overview_id: Lian Xinruo, putri saudagar kaya, kehilangan segalanya setelah keluarganya hancur dan ia hampir dikubur hidup-hidup. Diselamatkan Pei Yuze, ia bersumpah balas dendam. Lima tahun kemudian, kembali sebagai penyanyi Du Youmeng, ia bekerja sama dengan Pei Yuze untuk mengungkap kebenaran dan memulai permainan dendam yang gemilang.

overview: Depicts the story of two lustful women, a mother and daughter who were bound by blood and now meet as mother-in-law and fight a war of lies to take over the golden palace.
A losing basketball coach turns to a fierce online hate commenter to help improve the team's prospects.
A heartbreaking first love story of a man who was destined to be the fate of two women who were bus guides in the 1980s, and a melodrama-comedy of shining youths who were destined to be brilliant.

The murder of one of their own changes groups of friends forever. The tragic loss of a member of their inner circle — and their terrifying closeness to the killer — haunt them as they uncover secrets and confront the painful truth.

After a car accident leads Jin Daxi to be mistaken for his estranged twin brother Tong Sheng, the two switch lives, triggering clashes, unexpected romance, and tests of family loyalty. With the help of Jin Dahuan and Yan Yan, they work together to expose a dangerous scheme.

After the Gengzi Kingdom changed, the land of China was devastated, and young people with aspirations rose up to save their homeland. Aristocratic youth Liang Xiang, revolutionary party Yang Kaizhi, and Beiyang Wuyou Guardian Li Renjun became the first batch of progressive young people who went to Japan to study at a non-commissioned officer’s school. They met revolutionary exiles Yu Tianbai and Qiu Hong on a cruise ship. Since then, the five people have been fatefully linked.

In order to retrieve Heavenly Realm’s treasure, Goddess Wu Shuang descends to earth to assassinate Yuan Zhong, the high priest of Youhu Clan. In the process, Wu Shuang discovers other secrets, and the two fall in love and join hands to save the world.
overview_id: Dalam pertempuran antara dewa dan siluman, dewa pertama, Taihe, menggunakan mestika "Tangan Kiri Dewa" untuk menyegel dewa siluman. Namun, mestika itu jatuh ke dunia manusia dan para dewa tertidur panjang. Klan Hantu Perang memanfaatkan kekacauan ini untuk bangkit, memicu perang besar. Yuan Zhong dari Klan Rubah memperoleh mestika tersebut, mengalahkan Klan Hantu Perang, dan menciptakan era baru. Wu Shuang, yang disuruh langit untuk menjelma menjadi gadis manusia dan melayani Yuan Zhong, berusaha melindunginya dan membantu membuka segel, tanpa menyadari niat jahat Yuan Zhong. Setelah banyak rintangan, mereka akhirnya bersatu untuk mengalahkan kejahatan dan mengembalikan ketertiban dunia.

overview: For every celebration and season, tteok is a staple. Discover how this traditional rice dessert weaves through Korean life, heritage and culture.

During a historic Bangkok flood, Tui secretly moves his family-Nok and their daughter Gib-into a luxury show house. As they fake a perfect life online for Gib's elite school dream, their lies begin to unravel.

Hezekiah and Alec, two friends from Jamaica, finds themselves thrust into the criminal underbelly of London's East End. Here they meet Mary Carr, Queen of an all-female criminal gang known as the Forty Elephants, and run afoul of Sugar Goodson, criminal kingpin and notorious boxer.
The untold stories and human tragedy behind Latin America's deadliest air disaster are investigated in this three-part documentary series.

Three hundred years after immortal fairy Jin Li seals Demon Lord Jie Chuan, a celestial beast named Jin Li accidentally frees him and is taken to the Demon Realm for her rare power. As enemies bound by fate, their hostility slowly turns into love—until a shocking truth about Jin Li's origin threatens to tear them apart and rewrite their destinies.
overview_id: Tiga ratus tahun lalu, seorang dewi menyegel Raja Iblis Jie Chuan. Ratusan tahun kemudian, Jin Li tanpa sengaja membuka segel itu dan dibawa ke Dunia Iblis karena kekuatannya. Dari hubungan yang penuh konflik, keduanya perlahan saling jatuh cinta, hingga terungkap rahasia besar tentang asal-usul Jin Li yang memicu kisah cinta dan kebencian.

overview: Bound by a tragic love across lifetimes, Lu Anning and Ling Cang break free from fate’s control. From enemies to allies, they embark on a journey of cultivation to gain power and rewrite their destiny.
overview_id: Lu Anning dan Ling Cang, terikat oleh seribu kehidupan penuh cinta tragis, adalah boneka takdir, dari musuh sengit menjadi jiwa yang terbangun. Mereka bersatu dalam jalan kultivasi ilahi, berjuang untuk melepaskan diri dari permainan kejam takdir.

overview: Liang Shuo, a Communist underground operative with a head wound, awoke in a snowbound mountain, and his memory was gone. Facing multiple threats, he must navigate a dangerous path to reclaim his identity. With help from unexpected allies, he embarks on a quest to uncover and confront an impossible mission.

To revive the struggling film industry, Yiping Films launches a live-streamed cave exploration reality show. Actor Li Kaixuan and a group of participants set out on the adventure but soon encounter eerie events and deadly traps set by a mysterious figure. As they fight for survival, they face tests of human nature, leading to the shocking truth hidden within the darkness.

Lu Yan seeks justice for his parents but faces constant interference from Mu Lan. As their paths cross, he discovers she is his childhood love. Forced to work together, they uncover the secrets behind the enigmatic "Lu Chang He," who has been one step ahead of them all along.
overview_id: Untuk membalaskan dendam orang tuanya, Lu Yan diam-diam merencanakan pembalasan dedam. Namun, Mu Lan terus menggagalkannya. Setelah penyelidikan, Lu Yan menyadari bahwa Mu Lan adalah gadis yang disukainya saat masa kecil. Dari musuh menjadi sekutu, mereka menargetkan "Lu Changhe". Namun, "Lu Changhe" telah mengetahui semua gerakan mereka...

overview: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, the psychological expert and the detective in charge are all left asking: what really happened?
overview_id: Remaja berusia 13 tahun dituduh membunuh teman sekelasnya. Keluarga, terapis, dan detektif yang menangani kasusnya mempunyai satu pertanyaan: Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi?

overview: A group of twenty-somethings in New York trying to be good people, despite being neither "good" nor "people" yet.
In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative "Madame Aema."

When the mysterious deep space research vessel USCSS Maginot crash-lands on Earth, Wendy and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

After a tragic mistake leads to the downfall of her benefactors, orphaned Su Jinyuan returns seeking redemption. Her fate becomes entwined with Xie Yunyuan, the adopted son of the fallen family. Together, they defy betrayal, fight to survive, and ignite a passionate, fate-defying love as they seek justice and reclaim their destiny.
overview_id: Su Jinyuan, seorang yatim piatu, kabur dari pernikahannya, namun keputusan itu justru menghancurkan hidupnya. Saat kembali, ia mendapati keluarga yang pernah menolongnyate lah dibantai. Untuk menebus kesalahannya, ia bekerja sama dengan Xie Yunyan, putra angkat keluarga Xiao yang menggantikan saudaranya di hari pernikahan itu. Mereka berjuang bersama melawan para musuh, hingga tumbuh kisah cinta yang membara.

overview: Former tour rep Alison and son Aidan head to the Sunshine State - on a quest for family adventure in true American style. Can they go full-on Florida without breaking the bank?

In Chicago, Marissa Irvine arrives at 14 Arthur Avenue, expecting to pick up her young son Milo from his first playdate with a boy at his new school. But the woman who answers the door isn't a mother she recognizes. She isn't the nanny. She doesn't have Milo. And so begins every parent's worst nightmare.

You Haoyun, an amnesiac gambling prodigy, is taken in by a kind family, but his hidden skills spark conflict and uncover buried secrets. As his past unravels, he’s forced to gamble again to expose the truth and seek justice.

A group of law interns compete in a high-stakes "top offer" challenge, where the fierce competition forces them to navigate intense workplace dynamics. Along the way, each of them discovers an opportunity that could change their lives and ignite their passions.
overview_id: Di firma hukum bergengsi Jun'an, para intern harus saling bersaing. Ren Jia Tong, sosok dingin namun tegas, bertemu kembali dengan Jiang Chen, pria cerdas yang pernah berseteru dengannya karena urusan sewa rumah. Kini mereka bergabung di firma hukum yang sama, dan menjadi rival terbesar satu sama lain. Tapi di antara ambisi dan persaingan, mungkinkah muncul rasa yang tak mereka duga?

overview: A team of female divorce attorneys leave a male-dominated firm to open their own powerhouse practice. Fierce, brilliant, and emotionally complicated, they navigate high-stakes breakups, scandalous secrets, and shifting allegiances—both in the courtroom and within their own ranks. In a world where money talks and love is a battleground, these women don't just play the game—they change it.

Disguised as a man, commander Zhou Chu is betrayed by Xu Hanzhi upon her return. Rescued by rival Shang Kefeng, she becomes Xue Shisan, infiltrating Dengying Tower to uncover the truth and exact revenge.
A mother and son fleeing from their past form a found family while confronting a harsh landscape of freedom and cruelty in the American West.
overview_id: Seorang ibu dan anak yang kabur dari masa lalu membentuk sebuah keluarga baru sambil menghadapi lanskap kebebasan dan kekejaman yang keras di wilayah barat Amerika.

overview: When Jack's affair comes to light, his wife Betty hatches a bitter plan to strip him of the thing he loves most: The Jackal, his coffeeshop empire.
overview_id: Saat perselingkuhan Jack terkuak, istrinya, Betty, membuat rencana jahat untuk merebut hal yang paling Jack cintai: The Jackal, perusahaan coffeeshop besarnya.

overview: After being betrayed, CEO Zheng Nanfeng travels back to 1990 and, alongside his wife Zhou Zhiyi, uses his modern knowledge to overcome challenges, fight crime, and rebuild their relationship in a story of love and partnership.
overview_id: Dikhianati dan kembali ke tahun 1990, Zheng Nanfeng kehilangan segalanya dan harus memulai dari nol. Dengan pengetahuan masa depan dan dukungan istrinya, Zhou Zhiyi, ia bangkit menghadapi musuh, membongkar kejahatan penyelundupan, dan menemukan makna sejati kekuatan serta cinta.

overview: Aspiring narcotics officer Qin Lang is assigned to the anti-fraud division, reluctantly partnering with the composed Gao Man. As they crack cases, he grows into his role—until he discovers a shocking link between a fraud syndicate and the drug lord he’s pursuing.
overview_id: Qin Lang ingin jadi polisi narkoba, tapi justru ditempatkan di Unit Anti-Penipuan. Ia dipasangkan dengan Gao Man yang dingin dan cerdas. Saat mereka membongkar kasus demi kasus, Qin mulai tertarik dengan pekerjaannya—hingga ia menyadari bahwa dalang penipuan terhubung dengan musuh utamanya.

overview: Two young women advocate for wellness remedies to cure deadly illnesses, unraveling their lives as they unknowingly — and knowingly — mislead the world.
overview_id: Dua wanita muda mempromosikan pengobatan untuk menyembuhkan penyakit mematikan, mengungkap kehidupan mereka saat mereka tanpa sadar—dan dengan sadar—menyesatkan dunia.

overview: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.
When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.
overview_id: Saat dua wanita bersekongkol untuk mengakhiri pernikahan yang penuh KDRT lewat pembunuhan, seorang tamu tak terduga hadir dan berpotensi merusak semua rencana mereka.

overview: When their druid forgets how to prepare the magic potion, Asterix and Obelix must defend the village as Caesar plots to use a Gallic law against them.
overview_id: Ketika dukun mereka lupa cara membuat ramuan ajaib, Asterix dan Obelix harus melindungi Galia saat Caesar berencana memanfaatkan hukum kuno untuk melawan mereka.

overview: In 1979 Tokyo, four distinct sisters uncover their aging father's affair, causing their happy facades and bottled-up emotions to slowly unravel.
overview_id: Di Tokyo tahun 1979, empat saudari yang amat berbeda mengetahui perselingkuhan sang ayah yang sudah tua. Sandiwara bahagia dan emosi terpendam mereka perlahan terbongkar.

overview: When the path of free-spirited drug smuggler Max collides with JJ, an enigmatic outsider on the run, an unlikely friendship is formed. They're swept into a chaotic, high-stakes mission they never signed up for, trafficking highly enriched uranium across North Africa and the Middle East, with the CIA, MI6, and a global web of opposing forces closing in fast.

B:MY BOYZ aims to create a new global boy group. The show will feature 30 talents selected from Korea, Japan, China, Thailand, and beyond, with the goal to debut as the next generation idols. The participants will compete against each other in various fields including vocals, performance, and producing, with the current top idol seniors selecting the next idols.

Six employees are sent back to primary school for a retraining program, joining real fourth-grade students in Class 4S. As unlikely friendships form and personal growth unfolds, a rule-breaking incident threatens it all.
A collection of hilariously disturbing stories that push the boundaries of decency in ways only Tom Segura could imagine.
overview_id: Kumpulan cerita yang sangat vulgar dan mendobrak berbagai batasan kesopanan dengan cara-cara yang hanya bisa dibayangkan oleh Tom Segura.

overview: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.

Detective Renée Ballard plunges into a web of murder and corruption as she hunts a ruthless serial killer and uncovers a sinister police conspiracy that threatens everything she stands for. With her own demons nipping at her heels, Ballard must outwit both criminals and colleagues to bring long-overdue justice to the victims and their families.
overview_id: Detektif Renée Ballard terlibat ke dalam jaringan pembunuhan dan korupsi saat dia memburu seorang pembunuh berantai yang kejam dan mengungkap konspirasi polisi yang mengancam semua hal yang dia perjuangkan. Dengan masa lalu kelam yang terus mengintainya, Ballard harus mengalahkan penjahat dan komplotannya untuk memberikan keadilan yang telah lama ditunggu para korban dan keluarga mereka.

overview: A once-comatose divine general, Chu Beichi, hides his true identity and returns as a low-born son in his household. As he rises through the ranks with his wisdom and strength, he uncovers political conspiracies and quells rebellions across nations to unite the world under his command.
overview_id: Chu Beichi, Dewa Perang Kunlun, terbangun dari koma dan menyamar sebagai anak selir di Keluarga Chu. Diam-diam ia bangkit, membela keluarga, melawan bandit, dan membongkar misteri besar. Saat kerajaan gemetar, empat wanita kuat memperebutkan hatinya—dunia pun takluk di bawah kekuasaannya.

overview: Follow Batman, Alfred, and young Damian Wayne—who has taken on the mantle of Little Batman—alongside a few newcomers to Wayne Manor, as they navigate the fun and frustrations of life as a super family
overview_id: Film animasi aksi-komedi berdurasi 22 menit ini dibintangi oleh Damian dan Bruce Wayne. Film ini mengisahkan saat mereka dan keluarga mereka yang erat, yang terdiri dari orang-orang buangan, menghadapi tantangan kehidupan sehari-hari sembari melindungi jalanan Gotham.

overview: Ye Nanzhao is betrayed by her ex-husband and loses her daughter. Kidnapped while seeking justice, she's forced to assume a dead woman’s identity and becomes a concubine in a wealthy household, only to discover her ex-husband is now the family’s new son-in-law. Trapped in a web of lies and buried secrets, she must fight to reclaim her life.
overview_id: Dikhianati mantan suami dan kehilangan putrinya, Ye Nanzhao diculik dan terpaksa mengambil identitas wanita mati sebagai istri kedua keluarga Lu. Tak disangka, sang mantan kini jadi menantu keluarga itu—dan identitas barunya menyimpan segudang masalah yang harus ia hadapi.

overview: After her college entrance examination, Xu Zhi became the greatest winner in Ruijun Middle School, but she didn't expect that she was about to be defeated in love.
overview_id: Pada ujian masuk perguruan tinggi, Xu Zhi menjadi pemenang di Sekolah Menengah Ruijun. Namun, siapa sangka bahwa dia akan menghadapi kekalahan terbesar dalam cinta?

overview: After a century of cultivation, an ancient monster ascends, only to be destroyed by lightning tribulations. Merging with Zhao Feiyang, the useless fourth son of the Zhao family, they begin an extraordinary journey, starting with three marriage proposals and an exciting new life.
overview_id: Seorang master tua berlatih selama 100 tahun dan gagal saat hendak naik ke alam lebih tinggi. Jiwanya menyatu dengan Zhao Feiyang, anak keempat keluarga Zhao yang dianggap gagal. Tiba-tiba, tiga lamaran pernikahan datang, dan sejak itu, hidupnya berubah drastis dan penuh petualangan.

overview: It follows rags-to-riches CEO Noreen Alfonso who is out to take revenge on the people who have wronged her. She stakes her claim as a new beauty industry player, tearing down the empire that her enemies have built. Alfonso goes head-to-head against a crass but famous on social media CEO Shari de Jesus, who is being mentored by a powerful industry veteran Velma Imperial. But as she tears her opponent down on social media and they destroy each other's personal lives, it becomes evident that an invisible player is responsible for the bloodshed happening amidst the ongoing beauty wars.
Fresh out of college, ambitious cosmetic scientist Sara battles family struggles, office politics and a love triangle while saving a failing beauty firm.

A small riverside town faces submersion from a water conservancy project just as a heavy storm in 2002 brings forth a bizarre murder case, where a dead lover and a vanished husband both appear to be victim and culprit. As police unravel the mystery, long-buried secrets and the shadows of human nature are brought to light.

At the former Xuri Factory, a dismembered female body is discovered in an abandoned sewage pit. Veteran detective Lian Haiping and rookie officer Shi Qiangfeng, despite their differences, must work together to solve the case. Their investigation reveals unexpected social issues and brings to light an old case that complicates their personal and professional lives.
At a private school where gambling determines social status, a skillful new student with a mysterious past is shaking things up — and betting on revenge.
overview_id: Di sekolah swasta tempat judi menentukan status sosial, seorang murid baru berbakat dengan masa lalu yang misterius mengguncang segalanya—dan bertaruh demi balas dendam.

overview: Shi Fake, the pampered daughter of a high-profile family, encounters Lu Chi, a rugged and versatile second-generation bandit who has come down from the mountains searching for his little sister.
Ready to step into the dating world, lifelong singles get expert help for style, health and confidence. Will they manage hiccups on their way to love?
A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

After being killed in a deadly betrayal, Yu Yingwan is reborn and stays in the City Lord’s manor to uncover the truth—only to discover her husband Mu Yunqing has also returned from death. Together, they must face the hidden mastermind and fight to change their tragic fate.

Panic grips the city as a ruthless predator targets social media influencers in a wave of terrifying attacks. Inspector Chitra Basu leads a high-stakes manhunt to dismantle a dangerous scheme of control. The ultimate shock strikes when she unmasks the mastermind behind it all.
A rising-star restaurateur is forced into New York's criminal underworld when his chaotic brother returns to town with loan sharks on his trail.
overview_id: Pengusaha restoran yang sedang naik daun terpaksa terjun ke dunia kriminal bawah tanah New York saat saudaranya yang bermasalah—dan dikejar lintah darat—kembali ke kota.

overview: During a visit to her childhood home, the imperial consort is found dead under mysterious circumstances in the peach blossom forest. With a wandering swordsman named Yan Shiyi as the prime suspect, the manor is sealed off under strict orders. As the investigation unfolds, long-buried secrets emerge, and the truth becomes increasingly difficult to uncover.
overview_id: Kematian selir di tengah Taman Bunga Persik memicu penyegelan manor. Yan Shiyi, sang pendekar pengembara, jadi tersangka utama. Di balik kelopak yang memesona, tersembunyi dosa dan rahasia yang mengancam segalanya. Kebenaran? Semakin dikejar, kian menghilang...

overview: Mystery video blogger Yang Zhenghui investigates the long disappearance of his ex-girlfriend Liu Wei, uncovering connections to ceramic artist Zeng Jie and events from a year ago.  As Yang Zhenghui digs deeper, the dark logic behind the truth begins to surface.
overview_id: Perjalanan Yang Zhenghui mencari mantan kekasihnya yang telah menghilang selama tiga tahun, mengarah pada seorang seniman keramik bernama Zeng Jie. Sesuatu yang kelam tersembunyi dalam kebakaran misterius di studio Zeng Jie. Namun saat mencari Zeng Jie, Yang Zheng Hui bertemu dengan istri Zeng Jie, Bai Xiao Ling, dan jatuh cinta padanya.

overview: After being betrayed in both love and career by her boyfriend, a traditional incense maker named Jian Xiangxiang discovers mysterious on-screen messages that predict her grim future. Determined to change her fate and seek revenge, she sets out to seduce Gu Jingshi - her ex’s powerful, wheelchair-bound uncle. What starts as a calculated plan for vengeance turns into an unexpected entanglement of passion and power.

In the eighth year of the Tianyuan era, Yue Qianxue is betrayed and killed in battle, followed by Hua Qingming’s failure to protect the capital, leading to widespread chaos. To change this tragic fate, Zhuge Renfeng sacrifices his lifespan to send them back two years in time. Reborn in the sixth year of Tianyuan, Yue Qianxue and Hua Qingming must join forces to rewrite destiny and save their world from destruction.
overview_id: Yue Qianxue tewas dijebak musuh, lalu setahun setelahnya Hua Qingming juga gagal melindungi ibu kota. Dunia pun kacau dan penuh penderitaan. Seorang tabib sakti mengirim mereka kembali ke masa lalu. Di kehidupan kedua ini, Qianxue dan Qingming berjuang bersama untuk mengubah takdir dan menyelamatkan dunia.

overview: After time traveling to the Joseon era, a talented chef meets a tyrant king. Her modern dishes captivate his palate, but royal challenges await her.
overview_id: Setelah melintasi waktu ke era Joseon, seorang chef berbakat bertemu seorang raja tiran. Hidangan modernnya memikat selera sang tiran, tetapi tantangan istana menantinya.

overview: A young couple moves into a mysterious bungalow, where the line between warmth and control blurs under the watchful eye of the enigmatic Nona. As secrets unravel, haunted pasts, forbidden rooms, and disappearing tenants, the tenants find themselves trapped in a web of manipulation, obsession, and psychological torment, controlled like a puppet.

Gabriel Book, proprietor of an antiquarian bookshop, relies on his vast collection to unravel baffling cases. He nurtures a group of lovable yet troubled individuals, providing informal protection and guidance.
After impulsively joining the U.S. Marine Corps, a bullied teen finds new purpose — and unexpected brotherhood — with his motley team of fellow recruits.
overview_id: Seusai masuk Korps Marinir AS secara impulsif, remaja korban perundungan menemukan tujuan baru, sekaligus persaudaraan tak terduga, dengan tim rekrutan yang amat beragam.

overview: Song Dianxin, a female general, is betrayed and wrongfully executed. After being reborn, she seeks revenge and ends her engagement. Her fiancé, also reborn, tries to regain her love while uncovering the truth behind their betrayal.

NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a job with the Boston PD and is paired with Detective Lena Silver, part of a law enforcement family comprised of District Attorney Mae Silver, Police Superintendent Sarah Silver, rookie cop Jonah Silver and Rev. Edwin Peters. Reagan hopes to reconnect with his son, Sean, in Boston.

Jiang Yingxian, the second daughter of the Jiang family, defies societal norms by taking over the family business. She hires Fu Cheng, a principled but low-born man with his own hidden agenda, as her personal bodyguard. Despite their differences, a forbidden romance blossoms. However, as she faces an arranged marriage and he enlists in the army, their love is tested by duty, ambition, and the chaos of their nation.
overview_id: Putri Ketiga Keluarga Jiang yang bertekad menghancurkan prasangka dunia dan mewarisi bisnis keluarga, demi melindungi diri sendiri, mempekerjakan tokoh utama pria dari latar belakang rendah sebagai pengawalnya. Dunia mereka sangat berbeda. Sikap liar tokoh utama wanita terus menguji batas kesabaran tokoh utama pria, sekaligus menggoda hatinya hingga jatuh ke dalam cinta yang mendalam hingga kenyataan memisahkan mereka. Tokoh utama wanita dipaksa menikah dengan orang lain, sementara tokoh utama pria pergi menjadi tentara. Saat negeri hancur dan tokoh utama wanita terpuruk, tokoh utama pria kembali, menyelamatkannya dari penderitaan, dan akhirnya keduanya mengungkapkan perasaan mereka yang sesungguhnya.

overview: When her longtime partner Zhong Wei goes missing during a case, stoic detective Han Qing refuses to give up the search. As she investigates a new murder, she uncovers a connection to Zhong Wei’s disappearance and a hidden criminal network involving murder, abductions, and drug trafficking. With her team, Han Qing races to unravel the truth and bring the syndicate to justice.
overview_id: Han Qing, polisi wanita dingin dari Tim Investigasi Kriminal Sanhe, menyelidiki hilangnya rekannya, Zhong Wei, yang lenyap saat membuntuti tersangka. Saat menangani kasus pembunuhan baru, ia menemukan benang merah yang mengarah pada jaringan kriminal besar terkait orang hilang, pembunuhan, dan narkoba. Dengan ketekunan dan kerja tim, kebenaran terungkap dan para pelaku berhasil ditangkap.

overview:
From the amazing views towards the Welsh mountains to the bucolic village byroads around Tarporley; Cheshire is like a picture- postcard.

This four -part series showcases the charms of Cheshire through some of the county's proud residents as they live, work and play in the beautiful county they call home. From traditional cheese makers to the famous zoo we follow the locals as the county pops with wonderful Autumn colour. Exploring the county's industrial and artisanal past, this series reveals a deep history that the residents of Cheshire are proud to be a part of.

Shen Qingru, shamed by her mother’s past, seeks redemption with the mute Shen Cheng and to protect him, she marries the clan leader’s son. After surviving a near-death ordeal, Shen Cheng returns years later as a cold, ruthless young marshal to protect her.
overview_id: Bertahun-tahun lalu, ibu Shen Qingru dihukum mati dengan cara ditenggelamkan oleh pemimpin klan karena perselingkuhan. Sejak itu, Shen Qingru harus hidup dengan julukan "perempuan hina" dan menyimpan dendam atas kematian ibunya. Dia tumbuh dalam penderitaan, dihina dan dicemooh oleh penduduk kota, hingga suatu hari seorang pemuda bisu bernama Shen Cheng muncul dalam hidupnya. Keduanya menjadi penyelamat satu sama lain, tetapi juga kelemahan terbesar satu sama lain. Hubungan mereka terikat dalam batasan "kakak-adik" yang semakin goyah, tetapi tetap tidak bisa dilanggar. Di hadapan semua orang, Shen Qingru bersumpah dengan air mata bahwa ia tidak akan jatuh cinta.

overview: David Jung, a mysterious former US intelligence operative living in hiding in South Korea, has his life blown to pieces when the consequences of an impossible decision from his past come back to haunt him, and he finds himself hunted by Rebecca, a deadly young assassin, and Caddis, the sinister spy organization she works for.
overview_id: Kehidupan David Jung, mantan agen intelijen AS misterius yang bersembunyi di Korea Selatan, hancur berkeping-keping ketika konsekuensi dari keputusan mustahil di masa lalu kembali menghantuinya dan dia mendapati dirinya diburu oleh Rebecca, seorang pembunuh muda yang mematikan, serta Caddis, organisasi mata-mata jahat tempat Rebecca bekerja.

overview: A 26-year-old waitress's life spirals after her accidental hit-and-run video goes viral, transforming her into a justice-obsessed influencer who sacrifices morals for online fame, only to become the target of a vengeful online hate campaign.

In the bucolic town of Delphi, Indiana, 13-year-old Abigail Williams and 14-year-old Liberty German set out for a walk on a warm February afternoon in 2017 - and never came home. Their bodies were discovered the next day in a wooded area not far from the trail, setting off a five-year-long search that gripped the nation and haunted this close-knit community.
An ordinary man who inherits super strength discovers a greater evil out to steal his power. The one catch? Every use drains money from his wallet.
overview_id: Pria biasa yang mewarisi kekuatan super mendapati ada pihak jahat yang ingin mencuri kekuatannya. Masalahnya, tiap kali kekuatan itu dipakai, uang di dompetnya terkuras.

overview: Holly Willoughby hosts this competition show set in the Costa Rican jungle, where 12 celebrities become prey for legendary survival expert, Bear Grylls.
overview_id: Holly Willoughby memadu acara kompetisi yang diadakan di hutan di Kosta Rika ini. Di sana, 12 selebritas menjadi target si ahli bertahan hidup legendaris, Bear Grylls.

overview: Eight years after an unforgivable mistake nukes his promising college football career, hotshot quarterback Russ Holliday tries to resurrect his dreams by disguising himself as Chad Powers - a talented oddball who walks on to the struggling South Georgia Catfish.

Hijiri has loved Koyori since childhood, and she feels the same, but they’ve kept their feelings hidden. At 26, they finally give in to their emotions, leading to a night together. Hijiri wants to deepen their relationship, but Koyori is torn between love and preserving their close friendship.

Let's raid the Antarctic base's storage shed and serve warm meals to the thousands of researchers living in isolation, separated from their families, in Antarctic stations across more than 30 countries, driven by a sense of mission!
Miniseries that follow the life and career of Mexican actor, comedian and producer Roberto Gómez Bolaños, known for being the creator of El Chavo del 8, El Chapulín Colorado and Chespirito.
With Hawaii's four kingdoms divided by war, the ferocious warrior Kaʻiana embarks on an epic mission to unite his people—as an existential threat approaches their shores.
overview_id: Dengan empat kerajaan Hawaii terpecah karena perang, prajurit ganas bernama Kaʻiana memulai misi hebat untuk menyatukan rakyatnya di saat ancaman eksistensial mendekati pantai mereka.

overview: Bai Xiaoduo, accustomed to protecting herself with lies due to her low self-esteem, meets Su Yancheng, a genius cartoonist who despises dishonesty. Despite their differences, they support each other through a series of events, gradually healing one another's inner wounds.

A gruesome crime has taken place in La Pedrera – Casa Milà: a burned body is found on the facade of Gaudí's iconic building. Inspector Milo Malart, previously suspended for misconduct by the Mossos d'Esquadra (Mossos of the Squadron), returns to Barcelona to find the perpetrator along with Sub-Inspector Rebeca Garrido.
A man in the midst of a mid-life crisis moves his family to a remote Scottish village, only to find himself entangled in a dangerous friendship with a sinister neighbour.

Zhong Qinyang and assistant prosecutor Song Su pursue justice in cases involving minors. Along the way, Zhong Qinyang befriends high school student Li Songyan, and together they uncover the truth behind Zhong Qinyang ’s parents' fatal car accident. As the real culprit is brought to justice, they begin a new chapter filled with hope and renewal.

Former high school lab partners Marshall and Frances begin to unravel a conspiracy involving big pharma and the federal government to suppress knowledge of a rare mushroom that may hold the key to curing all the world’s diseases.
Tells the story of an unbroken apartment becoming a place for barter in a world that has been ruined since the earthquake.

In the late 1940s, the Shanhai Gang rises as a key force in the local Chinese community. Retired leader Cheng Hui returns to rebuild the gang amid external threats, internal power struggles, and colonial interference, shaping its fight for survival and legacy.
overview_id: Di tepi Sungai Malaka era 1940-an, para perantau membentuk Geng Shan Hai, kelompok legendaris yang jadi pusat kekuatan. Ketika pengkhianatan, perebutan kekuasaan, dan ancaman kolonial mengguncang, bisakah mereka mempertahankan jalan hidup mereka?

overview: Set in the mystery-shrouded Peak District, the series follows two mismatched young detectives: affable local Ben Cooper and guarded newcomer Diane Fry. Thrown together to investigate a string of mysterious deaths they must learn to work together to get results. As their personal lives begin to intertwine, a unique friendship begins to form... but it won't always be easy.

Shen Wan, the daughter of the minister of Dali Temple, relied on her superb medical and forensic skills to join hands with Prince Yan Chi to solve unsolved cases and find the real culprit in order to vindicate her father.
overview_id: Shen Wan, putri dari pejabat tinggi Shen Yi yang keluarganya dibantai karena kasus Pangeran Jin, melarikan diri ke Jingzhou dengan menyamar sebagai Qin Wan, Nona Kesembilan dari Keluarga Qin. Dari gadis lemah lembut, Qin Wan berubah menjadi ahli pengobatan dan otopsi yang cerdas, sekaligus mengendalikan keluarga Qin yang penuh intrik. Dalam penyelidikan kasus, ia bertemu Yan Chi, Putra Mahkota Raja Rui, yang memiliki tujuan sama untuk membersihkan nama Pangeran Jin. Bersama-sama mereka memecahkan berbagai kasus misterius dan akhirnya mengungkap rahasia besar yang tersembunyi di dalam istana.

overview: When an officer with the Department of Homeland Security is murdered in broad daylight, LAPD detective Mark Meachum is recruited to a secret task force, alongside undercover agents from all branches of law enforcement, to investigate. But the hunt for the killer soon uncovers a plot far more sinister than anyone could have imagined, kicking off a race against time to save a city of millions.
overview_id: Ketika seorang petugas Departemen Keamanan Dalam Negeri dibunuh pada siang bolong, detektif LAPD Mark Meachum direkrut ke satgas rahasia bersama agen badan penegak hukum lainnya untuk menyelidiki. Namun, pencarian pembunuh itu ternyata mengungkapkan rencana yang jauh lebih mengerikan, sehingga mereka harus berpacu dengan waktu untuk menyelamatkan sebuah kota yang berpenduduk jutaan.

overview: Host Julia Zemiro and an expert team of criminologists and comedians dive beneath the surface of crime to discover the science and psychology behind it all.
In this mystery showdown, players engage in layered scenarios as either suspects or detectives — each striving to outsmart others and uncover the truth.

Captain Gu Zhen and his team tackle a series of intricate cases, but he soon becomes the target of revenge from a past victim’s family. As danger looms, he must confront a relentless adversary to protect his loved ones and uphold justice.
overview_id: Kapten Tim Investigasi Kriminal, Gu Zhen, memimpin timnya menyelidiki serangkaian kasus kejahatan, memecahkan kasus sulit dengan kecerdasan. Di saat yang sama, Gu Zhen mengetahui dirinya menjadi sasaran balas dendam keluarga korban dari kasus lama. Untuk melindungi orang-orang dan keluarganya, dia menghadapi pelaku dan memastikan mereka dihukum.

overview: In 1948, officers from the Third Field Army infiltrate Nanjing to aid the underground Communist Party in protecting intelligence, securing supplies, and undermining enemy forces, paving the way for the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign and the nation’s liberation.
Bunny is a talented sculpture student with a warm personality but struggles with low self-esteem due to a failed first love.

Princess Mingzhu ruins Su Qianqian’s family to secure a marriage into the General’s household, but Su Qianqian fights back by marrying in as well. With young General Chu Junyao’s help, she seeks revenge while charming others with her culinary skills.
overview_id: Demi menikahi sang jenderal, Putri Mingzhu berencana mencelakai keluarga Su Qianqian. Namun akhirnya Mingzhu dan Su Qianqian masing-masing menikahi jenderal. Akhirnya, Su Qianqian bersama dengan suaminya, jenderal Chu Junyao bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan rencana balas dendam, dan memenangkan hati semua orang dengan keterampilan memasaknya.

overview: When her client dies on the eve of his wedding, a florist sets out to find the killer, unearthing high society's dark secrets — while keeping her own.
overview_id: Saat kliennya tewas di malam pernikahan, penjual bunga ini mencari si pembunuh, menguak rahasia-rahasia kelam masyarakat kelas atas—sambil menyimpan rahasianya sendiri.

overview: To avenge his father, Xu Beisheng goes undercover as the warlord’s adopted son, plotting to sabotage an arranged marriage between the Xu and Zhou families by getting close to Zhou Menghuan. But as genuine feelings grow, their relationship spirals into a destructive cycle of love and revenge, culminating in a tragic downfall amidst the turmoil of war and power struggles.
overview_id: Xu Beisheng menyamar di sisi jenderal musuh demi membalas kematian ayahnya. Untuk menggagalkan perjodohan dua keluarga, ia mendekati Zhou Menghua, namun cinta tumbuh di antara mereka. Saat penyamarannya terbongkar, Zhou membalas dendam. Mampukah cinta bertahan di tengah tipu daya dan kebencian?

overview: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.
overview_id: Matt Murdock berjuang memperjuangkan keadilan, sementara Wilson Fisk mengejar ambisi politiknya. Keduanya berada dalam konflik yang tak terhindarkan.

overview: A fun and heartwarming reality show where celebrities introduce their real single best friends and cheer them on as they try to find love. Over five days and four nights, these singles get to know each other, go on dates, and explore romantic connections with their famous friends supporting them every step of the way.

Two generations of detectives stumble through challenges, unwavering in their pursuit, as they search for a killer in maze-like alleyways, ultimately finding their way out of the dead ends in their own lives.
Two "best friends" and rivals reignite a years-long rivalry that only grows more intense when a beautiful young woman enters the mix.
overview_id: Luo Man dan Chen Kai Xi adalah teman sekelas di perguruan tinggi. Setelah lulus, mereka menjauh. Satu menjadi penulis skenario sukses, yang lain menjadi ibu rumah tangga kaya. Setelah sepuluh tahun, mereka bertemu lagi dan saling tidak ingin melihat yang lain gagal atau sukses. Luo Man tidak puas dengan kariernya dan berharap menikah dapat membuatnya setara dengan Chen Kai Xi, yang terjebak dalam pernikahan. Dalam persaingan mereka, Zhong Qing Cheng yang muda dan cantik menjadi sosok "kunci".

overview: When a long-missing heir returns with lost memories, love and suspicion entwine. Is he truly Hongrang, or a stranger disturbing hearts and family ties?
overview_id: Ahli waris yang lama hilang ini kembali, tetapi hilang ingatan. Cinta dan kecurigaan pun beradu. Ini Hongrang, atau orang lain yang mau merusak hati dan ikatan keluarga?

overview: After three years working as a secretary, Lin Han decides to resign and start a new life. His boss, the poised CEO Qin Meili, tries her best to make him stay, but he’s determined to move on. As they prepare to say goodbye, both realize how much they’ve come to mean to each other.
overview_id: Seorang CEO wanita cantik dan dominan bertemu dengan sekretarisnya yang rapi, berpengalaman, dan lulusan luar negeri. Terpaksa bekerja bersama, interaksi awal di antara mereka justru memicu benih-benih cinta yang tak terduga, membawa keduanya dari rival menjadi pasangan seumur hidup.

overview: Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.
The story of James Garfield, who rose from obscurity to become America's 20th President — and Charles Guiteau, the man who assassinated him.
overview_id: Kisah James Garfield, yang naik dari orang biasa menjadi Presiden Amerika ke-20—dan Charles Guiteau, pria yang membunuhnya.

overview: Ye Meng, seeking a fresh start after career setbacks, returns to her hometown for a quieter life. There, she meets the mysterious Li Jinyu, whose reserved nature and deeply expressive eyes intrigue her. As their connection deepens, they embark on a journey of mutual healing and unexpected love.

When their convenience store-magnate father suddenly dies, a pair of pampered Pakistani American brothers lose everything and are forced to reckon with their Baba's secret life of crime as they attempt to take up his mantle in the underworld.
A brash but brilliant cop becomes head of a new police department, where he leads an unlikely team of misfits in solving Edinburgh's cold cases.
overview_id: Si polisi kasar nan brilian menjadi kepala departemen baru. Ia memimpin tim beranggotakan orang-orang yang tak terduga untuk memecahkan kasus-kasus lama di Edinburgh.

overview: Quirky and clever Qiao Manman, the manager of the all-purpose shop, is entrusted with sabotaging a political marriage alliance with the Xilin Kingdom. She keeps getting into comical mix-ups with Fu Chengjin, who’s pretending to be lame to avoid a power struggle for the throne. Sparks fly as they grow closer. But with secrets of their past and a looming crisis over the imperial throne, where will their love go from here?
overview_id: Gu Manman, pemilik toko serba bisa yang cerdik dan unik, ditugaskan menggagalkan perjodohan dengan pangeran negeri Xilin. Ia pun terlibat kekacauan kocak dengan Fu Chengjin, pangeran yang pura-pura pincang demi menghindari perebutan takhta. Tapi saat perasaan tumbuh dan rahasia besar terungkap…

overview: After being betrayed, violated, and buried alive, Su Hua returns under the guise of courtesan Qing Yan to infiltrate the Xiao family, rescue her persecuted sisters, punish the guilty, and reunite with her true love, General Xiao Yun.
overview_id: Gadis muda Su Hua melarikan diri dan jatuh cinta dengan Jenderal Xiao Yun, namun dijebak oleh kakaknya sendiri dan diperkosa serta dikubur hidup-hidup oleh Xiao Ye, adik kedua Xiao Yun. Su Hua “terlahir kembali” sebagai pelacur terkenal bernama Qing Yan, lalu menikah dengan Xiao Yun melalui sebuah kesepakatan untuk masuk ke kediaman keluarga Xiao demi membalas dendam. Dalam perjalanannya, ia berjuang keras menyelamatkan para saudari yang juga menjadi korban, hingga akhirnya keluarga Xiao menerima hukuman. Pada akhirnya, identitas Su Hua dipulihkan dan ia kembali bersatu dengan Xiao Yun.

overview: After timecaster Luo Jie accidentally transmigrates into the body of a tycoon’s illegitimate son, he gains the power to manipulate time. While investigating the original owner's death, he becomes entangled in gang conflicts and uncovers a deeper conspiracy tied to a mysterious force and a looming future disaster.
overview_id: Luo Jie, ahli sihir ruang-waktu, tiba-tiba terjebak dalam tubuh Alang, anak haram orang kaya. Kekuatan waktunya jadi jam saku. Saat menyelidiki kematian Alang, ia terseret konflik geng dan diburu banyak pihak. Ia pun menemukan bahwa semua ini terkait dengan sosok misterius dan bencana masa depan.

overview: In this epic battle of good vs. evil, the lines are blurry as hell. But a devilishly handsome demon hunter could be the world's best hope for salvation.
overview_id: Batasan menjadi kabur saat kebaikan bertarung epik melawan kejahatan. Namun, pemburu iblis yang tampan ini mungkin adalah harapan terbaik untuk menyelamatkan dunia.

overview: Set 10 weeks after Dexter: New Blood, Dexter Morgan chases a missing Harrison to New York City, where Captain Angel Batista is hot on their trail from way down in Miami.

Dr. Amy Larsen must navigate an unfamiliar world after a brain injury erases the last eight years of her life. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience.
Former pediatrician Kanenari Naruki runs a secretive doctor job agency while uncovering his father’s death and exposing the dark side of the medical world.

As the Great Ning Dynasty falls into turmoil, Pei Shenzhi manipulates the late emperor’s edict to place Ning Jinyi on the throne as a puppet ruler. Though she appears obedient, Ning Jinyi secretly builds her power and pushes for reform. Impressed by her intelligence, Pei Shenzhi becomes entangled in her rise as she purges the court.
overview_id: Dinasti Ning berada di ambang kehancuran. Pei Shenzhi mengubah dekrit wasiat dan mengangkat Ning Jinyi sebagai kaisar. Ning Jinyi berpura-pura patuh sambil diam-diam mengumpulkan kekuatan dan meluncurkan kebijakan baru. Pei Shenzhi, yang tertarik dengan kecerdasannya, mendukungnya secara diam-diam. Akhirnya, dia membersihkan istana dan bangkit menjadi permaisuri yang hebat.

overview: Three 41-year-old friends—a former TV host turned housewife, an art center manager in a strained marriage, and a fashion editor chasing love—navigate the messy mix of career, desire, and identity in midlife.
Rookie officer Saiki Yuto joins a secret narcotics unit and teams up with his tough instructor to take down a dangerous new drug spreading across Japan.
Two lifelong friends in Philadelphia pose as DEA agents to rob small-time drug dealers. It's a perfect grift—until they choose the wrong mark and become targets of a massive narcotics enterprise.
overview_id: Dua sahabat karib dalam penipuan Philadelphia sebagai agen DEA untuk merampok pengedar narkoba kelas teri. Itu penipuan sempurna, hingga mereka memilih sasaran yang salah dan menjadi incaran organisasi narkotika besar.
