overview: A brilliant painter, Lu Li, goes undercover in a powerful corporation to solve his parents’ murder and gets close to the chairman’s secretive daughter, Qin Yuebai. As they uncover each other’s true identities, their dangerous alliance turns into a deep love that helps them heal and find redemption together.
overview_id: Lukisan adalah senjatanya. Luka masa lalu adalah bahan bakarnya. Demi menyelidiki pembunuhan orang tuanya, sang jenius seni, Lu Li, menyusup ke Grup Silun dan mendekati Qin Yuebai, putri tidak sah pemiliknya. Awalnya saling memanfaatkan, perlahan hubungan mereka berubah. Rahasia demi rahasia terkuak, hingga keduanya saling menyembuhkan luka masing-masing… atau justru menambahkannya?

overview: When her unfaithful ex-husband and ex-best friend reappear, single mother Xu Kaixin rises to the challenge - protecting her children, reclaiming her home, and rebuilding her life. Along the way, she meets Mei Chengyi, a single father of two, and together they navigate the chaos of parenting four kids, growing closer through life’s unpredictable twists.
overview_id: Mengisahkan pertemuan antara seorang ibu tunggal dan ayah tunggal yang masing-masing memiliki dua anak. Seiring waktu, mereka mulai mengenal satu sama lain dan berusaha menciptakan kehidupan yang lebih hangat bersama. Namun, apakah benar keluarga baru ini bisa lebih dari sekadar gabungan dua orang tua dan dua anak?

overview: When a child goes missing in the aftermath of a house explosion, a concerned neighbor teams up with a private investigator to find them. As secrets unravel and a military conspiracy emerges, all hell is unleashed on South Oxford's sleepy suburbs.
overview_id: Ketika seorang anak menghilang setelah terjadinya ledakan di suatu rumah, seorang tetangga yang cemas bekerja sama dengan detektif swasta untuk mencarinya. Seiring terungkapnya berbagai rahasia dan konspirasi militer, kekacauan melanda suburban Oxford Selatan yang sunyi.

overview: Born into a life of scorn as a lowborn daughter, Feng Zhilou dreams of one day fighting alongside the powerful Dragon Clan. Meanwhile, Crown Prince Chu Moshang rejects a political marriage meant to unite forces against the demon tribe, choosing instead to battle alone. When their paths cross, these two kindred spirits defy expectations and forge a bond through hardship, one strong enough to change the course of destiny itself.

That winter, a horrific crime left veteran police captain Peng Zhaolin deeply shaken. A decade earlier, he had unknowingly crossed paths with the suspect, Deng Ligang, missing a crucial chance to stop the crime spree. Despite a relentless pursuit, the criminals vanished without a trace. Years later, a new clue emerges, prompting Peng Zhaolin and young officer Zhen Zhen to reopen the case and seek justice for the victims.
overview_id: Kisah ini menceritakan seorang Kapten Detektif Peng Zhaolin, yang tetap teguh dalam komitmennya terhadap keadilan. Dalam pengejaran selama satu dekade yang mencakup ribuan mil, ia tanpa henti memerangi kekuatan kegelapan, yang akhirnya membawa pembunuh yang sangat obsesif dan kejam ke pengadilan. Drama ini dibintangi oleh aktor dengan keterampilan akting yang hebat, Guo Jingfei, Wang Qianyuan, dan Zhao Jinmai, serta disutradarai oleh Cao Kai dan ditulis oleh Chen Ping. Drama ini menyoroti keyakinan dan kegigihan polisi rakyat yang tak tergoyahkan, yang mewujudkan kemenangan kebaikan atas kejahatan dan kekuatan keadilan yang abadi.

overview: In 1972, the first Black female FBI agent heads to the Southwest and recruits a gutsy getaway driver in a bold effort to take down a growing crime syndicate.
A passionate fling in Jeju ends abruptly — until fate reunites an heir and a young woman when she joins his company, disguised as a married mother.

Campus golden boy Gan Yang falls for the hardworking Ding Zhitong, who has no time for love until his warmth wins her over. Despite their different backgrounds, their romance flourishes—until Gan Yang secretly shoulders his family’s financial downfall and breaks up with her. Heartbroken and feeling betrayed, Ding Zhitong’s life takes a drastic turn, leaving her with deep resentment. Six years later, their paths cross again in the business world, where she must secure investment from his company. With love and resentment intertwined, can they overcome the past and find their way back to each other?

Ambitious Zhou Ruoxi sacrifices love for power, but palace intrigue leads to her and Li Yan’s death. When time miraculously resets, she must right her past mistakes and protect Li Yan - facing her greatest rival: her former self.
overview_id: Zhou Ruoxi demi ambisi meninggalkan cinta dengan Pangeran Li Yan dan menikah dengan putra mahkota, namun rencana dan intrik istana berujung pada kematian keduanya. Saat hidupnya kembali ke awal, Zhou Ruoxi bertekad memperbaiki kesalahan dan melindungi Li Yan, hanya untuk menghadapi musuh terbesarnya: dirinya sendiri dari tiga tahun lalu.

overview: Edward Lee and his three friends set out on a culinary journey to find the taste of their grandmother's cooking! They travel around the country, taste seasonal winter ingredients, and reinterpret the recipes of country grandmothers. Will Edward Lee's country cooking be recognized by K-grandmas?

Follow the three members of a mega-famous pop group, Electric Bloom, as they look back and tell the story of their band and friendship, starting with the day they all met in middle school. The girls go on a journey to becoming the biggest band in the world and the best friends in the universe.

Anya, abducted from wealth, endures life in a brothel. Xinniang, once a child beggar, blossoms into a refined lady. Anna, cast away as a jinx, returns to upend their lives. As secrets unravel, love and kinship are tested—will they rise above fate?
Prosecutor Lin Zhitiao and assistant Bai Enyu lead a juvenile prosecution team, fighting against the darkness of human nature to protect minors and seek justice to find redemption.
overview_id: Lin Zhitiao, jaksa penuh empati, bersama asistennya Bai Enyu, membentuk tim perlindungan hukum anak. Mereka menghadapi kasus-kasus kelam yang mengguncang nurani. Mampukah mereka menyelamatkan anak-anak di tengah kelamnya sisi gelap manusia?

overview: When the play “The Bloom and a Thousand Bees” is in being remade, it calls for a serious casting for the lead female role. Now, everyone in showbiz scrambles for and it seems they will do whatever it takes. Thus, the watchful eye of a certain group looms over this audition. What no one knows is that there’s a dangerous secret lurking behind the curtain, and whatever black magic is called upon.

Lawyer Sena Koyama, a realist disillusioned by love, teams up with idealistic newcomer Yu Matohara, who believes in love and sincerity. Despite their clashing views, the two grow closer as they navigate love-related cases and debates in court.

After being betrayed in her past life, Xu Wannian is reborn, determined to protect her biological child and exact revenge on those who wronged her. As she confronts dark secrets and crosses paths with Pei Heng, an investigator linked to her past, they uncover a deep connection that spans lifetimes.
overview_id: Setelah dikhianati suami dan kehilangan anak kandungnya, Xu Wanning terlahir kembali untuk membalas dendam dan melindungi anaknya. Dalam usahanya, ia bertemu Pei Heng, pria yang menyelidiki racun misterius. Tanpa disangka, takdir mereka ternyata sudah terikat sejak kehidupan sebelumnya.

overview: WWE star Braun Strowman travels America, attempting to eat every item on restaurant menus during his WWE tour stops.

Shi Xiaofan, a modern engineer, transmigrates into a fictional dynasty as Shi Feifan, a notorious playboy, and secretly uses his advanced knowledge to protect his family, build power, and reshape the empire. While pretending to be irresponsible, he quietly amasses wealth, outsmarts political enemies, and rises from “good-for-nothing” to a hidden military force pivotal to the kingdom’s survival.
overview_id: Shi Xiaofan, seorang pria sains yang hidupnya tengah jatuh, tiba-tiba terlempar ke dunia lain dan menjadi Shi Feifan, pewaris kaya yang terkenal sebagai pemboros. Demi melindungi keluarganya, ia berpura-pura tetap menjadi pemuda nakal, namun diam-diam memakai pengetahuan modern untuk meraih kekayaan, membangun kekuatan militer, menyelamatkan banyak pihak, dan menggagalkan berbagai ancaman. Berkat izin dari kaisar, ia akhirnya memimpin penataan pasukan di Barat dan berubah dari “pemuda tak berguna” menjadi sosok penting yang diam-diam memegang kekuatan besar.

overview: The forest watches as two sisters confront personal truths - and what lurks in the dark.

Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

A former national security agent, haunted by his comrade’s death, retreats into a quiet life as a fish vendor. But when duty calls, he goes undercover in a Taiwanese gang to expose a smuggling network, only to find himself caught between violent turf wars and the high-stakes dangers of espionage.

After losing her parents in a suspicious car accident, Qiao Yan infiltrates the powerful Gu family to uncover the truth. Her prime suspect is her cold and mysterious younger uncle by title only, Gu Jingyuan. Together, they confront the dark past of the Gu family and fight for justice and a future of their own.
overview_id: Qiao Yan, menjadi yatim piatu setelah kecelakaan tragis orang tuanya, kembali ke keluarga Gu untuk mencari kebenaran dan beradu taktik dengan paman angkatnya, Gu Jingyuan. Dalam perjalanan itu, mereka jatuh cinta meski menghadapi konspirasi dan rintangan, saling melindungi satu sama lain dalam kisah cinta terlarang penuh ketegangan dan emosi.

overview: In a quiet coastal town, two mysterious murders disrupt the peaceful lives of single mother Li Xiulan and her daughter Li Yan, as an unexpected police investigation draws them into a chilling web of secrets.
overview_id: Dua pembunuhan aneh mengguncang sebuah kota pesisir yang tenang, menghancurkan kehidupan damai seorang ibu tunggal, Li Xiulan, dan putrinya, Li Yan, ketika polisi datang mengetuk pintu mereka...

overview: After losing her memory in battle, skilled archer Fu Yixiao is taken in by a noble family and unexpectedly reunited with her former enemy, Prince Feng Suige—the man she once struck with an arrow. As they face the dangers of Yujing together, trust replaces suspicion and a deep bond begins to form. Caught in a web of past betrayals and political intrigue, the two must confront their shared history while fighting for survival, freedom, and each other.

Li Qingyue, the Four Spirit Immortal, and Bai Jiusi, the powerful Dacheng Lord, are caught in a turbulent love-hate relationship. As hidden truths come to light, they overcome their misunderstandings and join forces to protect the world from impending danger.
overview_id: Menceritakan tentang Empat Roh Suci Li Qingyue dan Master Agung Bai Jiusi, yang terlibat dalam hubungan cinta-benci, hingga akhirnya menyelesaikan kesalahpahaman dan bersama-sama mengatasi malapetaka untuk menyelamatkan rakyat.

overview: Friday night. 7pm. Film Club Week 198. Evie hasn't left the house in six months after a 'wobble', and Film Club is her escape. A weekly chance to create a world of wonder, deck the garage out in whatever the movie calls for and spend a few uninterrupted hours with Noa - her best friend and one of the few mates who still shows up. But tonight, things are different. Noa's got big news. A dream job is taking him across the other side of the country, which means that all of this is ending.

The "Filter Bracelet" allows Su Chengcheng to transform her appearance and use her new identities to help others. As she navigates these changes, she and Tang Qi work together to develop a unique Chinese beauty brand, promoting "natural, confident, real beauty." Through their journey, Su Chengcheng learns that true beauty lies in authenticity and facing challenges with determination.
overview_id: Sebuah produk teknologi-super memberikan Su Cheng Cheng kemampuan untuk mengubah penampilannya. Tang Qi, yang memiliki hubungan dengan Su Cheng Cheng, mengungkap kebenaran tentang identitasnya yang berubah. Keduanya harus menghadapi situasi ini bersama-sama.

overview: Twenty-five athletes, most retired, compete to win 30M yen to launch their second career. Can they overcome tough physical and psychological challenges?
First Dates takes its matchmaking magic to Spain and a stunning beachside setting for cocktails and flirting by the pool.
Just two months before the president-elect is sworn in, he demands a divorce from his wife – but she dreamed of becoming the first lady.

After a mysterious soul swap, Chen Jing'an and Zhu Niannian wake up in each other's bodies - one becoming a wealthy heiress, the other the sister of her secret crush. As they search for the cause with the help of Chen Changning, unexpected complications arise, and the truth leads them down a path they never anticipated.
overview_id: Suatu pagi, Chen Jing'an dan Zhu Niannian bangun dan menyadari jiwa mereka tertukar. Chen Jing'an kini jadi “putri konglomerat”, sementara Zhu Niannian menjadi “adik perempuan” dari pria yang diam-diam ia sukai. Bersama Chen Changning, mereka pun mulai menyelidiki penyebab pertukaran tubuh ini. Namun tanpa mereka sadari saat semakin dalam mencari tahu, situasinya malah semakin rumit!

overview: Kong Hou, a neglected princess from the mortal world, accidentally enters the realm of cultivation. Determined to grow stronger, she sets out on a journey and meets Huan Zong, a frail but determined young man. As they fight side by side and overcome countless trials, their partnership blossoms into a deep and heartfelt bond.
overview_id: Kong Hou, seorang putri yang tak sengaja masuk ke dunia para dewa dan menjadi pusat perhatian semua orang. Dari guru hingga murid, semua memanjakannya. Ingin membuktikan dirinya, ia turun gunung dan bertemu Huan Zong, pria lemah lembut yang menyimpan rahasia besar. Siapa sangka, pertemuan itu justru membuka jalan menuju cinta dan kekuatan…

overview: Kaede Ikushima and Jun Ichinose, a couple living together for nearly a year, appear happy but hide lies from each other. Their seemingly perfect life unravels, leading to a dramatic transformation.
An aspiring stand-up comedian turns her struggles into heartfelt humor as she balances work and relationships while caring for her aging father.
Springfield and Fortnite universes converge. Chaos ensues as Homer sets out to transform the world, wielding a powerful alien energy.

He Fang, a struggling pig farm owner, and Jin Xiao, a privileged billionaire heir, who accidentally swap lives. He Fang must navigate the luxurious world of wealth, while Jin Xiao is forced to manage the farm. Both men face new challenges as they adapt to their drastically different worlds.
Ming Liang, a young man working away from home, must return to take over his ailing foster mother's failing restaurant, where he rediscovers his true self.
overview_id: Ming Liang, lulusan akademi seni, terpaksa menunda impiannya melanjutkan studi karena ibu angkatnya jatuh sakit. Ia pun mengambil alih “Restoran Delima Merah” dan berjuang mengatasi berbagai tantangan untuk menjadikannya restoran berkualitas. Sambil menyalurkan semangat seni dalam setiap hidangan, Ming Liang pun tumbuh menjadi pribadi yang lebih matang. Di tengah perjuangannya itu, ia bertemu kembali dengan teman masa kecilnya, Gulinar, sosok mandiri dan tegas yang perlahan membuka kembali hatinya.

overview: In 2003, rock singer Bertrand Cantat killed his partner, actress Marie Trintignant. This documentary revisits the case that divided a nation.
overview_id: Pada 2003, Bertrand Cantat si penyanyi rock membunuh pasangannya, aktris bernama Marie Trintignant. Dokumenter ini mengulas lagi kasus yang memecah belah sebuah negara.

overview: Using a time-traveling umbrella, Maya goes back to the past to save her marriage, but fate has its own plan.

When a scam leaves Keung bankrupt, he becomes a taxi driver to support his family. As his wife turns to fraud and his son chases risky ideas to recover their losses, the family must adapt and hustle to reclaim the life they once had.
A flavorful exploration of Mexico's street food scene, where the beloved garnacha takes center stage, sparks debates and unites fans with every bite.

Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo are back with a hilarious new spin-off of the beloved “GBRB” series!

GBRB: Joy Pops Laugh Pops,” which will follow the trio as they set off on a whirlwind trip to Mexico in search of fresh perspectives and experiences.

The program is a spinoff of “GBRB Spinoff: Cafeteria Operation,” where the KKPP Food employees successfully completed their missions and earned the chance to go abroad for an insight trip to help the company grow. It also marks the second spinoff of “GBRB: Reap What You Sow.”
After a thousand years, a quirky genie returns to grant wishes to a woman born without feelings. Can his magic bring love and wonder to her world?
overview_id: Setelah seribu tahun, jin unik kembali untuk mengabulkan permintaan wanita yang lahir tanpa perasaan. Bisakah sihirnya menghadirkan cinta dan keajaiban bagi wanita itu?

overview: An aspiring drummer suddenly loses her spot in the band. But when a brilliant musician recruits her for his new band, her life takes a passionate turn.

After being framed in an old murder case, rising magistrate Lu Jianglai loses everything. Rescued by tea magnate’s daughter Rong Shanbao, he is forced into servitude as part of her revenge. As they navigate power struggles and hidden agendas, they uncover secrets, solve mysteries, and transform the tea trade—ultimately forging an unexpected bond that changes their fates.

After betrayal leaves him for dead, Chen Yuan gains extraordinary powers and, with three formidable allies, embarks on a vengeful quest to defy fate, crush powerful clans, and protect the world from destruction.
overview_id: Chen Yuanqi, pemuda miskin yang dikhianati kekasihnya hingga nyaris tewas, terbangun dengan kekuatan ilahi. Ia bersumpah menentang takdir dan menapaki jalan balas dendam. Bersama putri suci yang dingin, ratu iblis memesona, dan gadis roh lincah, ia menghancurkan bangsawan, membasmi sekte iblis, bahkan menantang langit demi membebaskan umat manusia dari belenggu nasib.

overview: An eccentric man named Forrest Fenn sets off a real-life treasure hunt when he hides a chest of gold in the Rockies — and leaves clues in a cryptic poem.
overview_id: Forrest Fenn, pria yang eksentrik, memulai perburuan harta karun sungguhan dengan menyembunyikan peti emas di Pegunungan Rocky dan menaruh petunjuk dalam puisi misterius.

overview: After escaping a troubled past, Sou begins a new life as an administrative manager at a senior care facility, only to discover the residents hold the real power. As he navigates the quirky personalities and tensions within the staff, he must fight to protect his newfound life.

Though very different, simple wallflower Via and the charming Arkin have been best friends since they were kids. But when that friendship turns into love, will it be strong enough to keep them together through Arkin’s fame that’s bound to lead them to very different roads?
This tense true-crime series examines the hunt for the Long Island serial killer through the perspective of his victims, their loved ones and the police.
overview_id: Serial kriminal nyata yang menegangkan ini menilik perburuan pembunuh berantai di Long Island dari sudut pandang para korban, orang-orang tercinta mereka, dan polisi.

overview: A Midwestern couple adopts who they believe to be a little girl with dwarfism, but gradually start to believe she may not be who she says she is.
Olympic medalists join the police force through a special recruitment program, trading medals for badges as they tackle violent crimes and injustices with their athletic skills.
overview_id: Setelah 11 tahun, Kepolisian kembali melakukan perekrutan khusus mantan atlet nasional. Dahulu dianggap pahlawan, para peraih medali kelas dunia ini kini menatap kenyataan pahit. Di tengah kesulitan keuangan, tragedi tak terduga, dan diskriminasi dalam kepolisian, para atlet yang kisahnya beragam ini bersatu dalam satgas khusus yang menangani kejahatan besar dengan keberanian dan kepiawaian atlet.

overview: A music project program where G-Dragon completes the song of the year with people from various fields.

Labeled as tainted after four years in prison, Shen Wanqing is destroyed by the Liu family to protect their reputation. Reborn with a new face as Lan Mengyan, she marries into the Liu household to seek revenge, drawing both father and son into her trap. But as her plan places her in growing danger, the mysterious Qin Moxiu—who has been watching from the shadows—steps in.
overview_id: Setelah dipenjara empat tahun dan dicap tidak suci, Shen Wanqing dibunuh demi nama baik keluarga Liu. Ia terlahir kembali sebagai Lan Mengyan dan masuk ke keluarga itu lewat pernikahan, menggunakan pesonanya untuk memikat ayah dan anak Liu demi membalaskan dendam. Saat bahaya mulai mengancamnya, Qin Moxiu yang selalu mengawasinya diam-diam akhirnya turun tangan.

overview: Participants living in a mansion for 10 days vie for a cash prize that increases by $1 each second they’re in the game. As contestants compete in physical and mental challenges, more money will be added to “the pot,” with up to $1 million at stake.

When Hampton is released from prison, his long-awaited family reunion doesn't quite go as he hoped. In his absence, Hampton's wife and sons formed an unconventional family unit, and his return spins their world into chaos.
overview_id: Saat Hampton dibebaskan dari penjara, reuni keluarga yang telah lama dinantikannya tak berjalan sesuai harapan. Selama ketidakhadirannya, istri dan putra Hampton menjadi keluarga yang tak lazim, dan kepulangannya mengacaukan kehidupan mereka.

overview: When four members of a suburban garden club get entangled in a scandalous murder, they're forced to bury the body – in their own well-manicured flower beds. In this juicy drama everyone's got dirt… but some secrets never stay buried.
Filmmaker Zhou Pin-yu interviews a serial killer in prison — an encounter that triggers a string of mysterious events tied to a buried past.
Police officers Xu Xiao and Lin Guoqiang team up to investigate a dismemberment case, uncovering a link to an ancient immortality ritual, with the mastermind being a seemingly harmless young woman.
overview_id: Sebuah kasus mutilasi mempertemukan dua polisi dengan gaya bertolak belakang: Xu Xiao yang berpengalaman dan Lin Guoqiang yang muda dan impulsif. Saat menyelidiki, mereka menemukan ritual kuno demi keabadian... tapi siapa sangka dalangnya adalah sosok yang paling tak terduga?

overview: The story of Melissa Reed, daughter of Keith Jesperson, aka the Happy Face Killer. After decades of no contact, Keith forces his way back into his daughter’s life, and Melissa must find out if an innocent man is going to be put to death for a crime her father committed. In the process, she must face a reckoning of her own identity.
After inheriting a hotel from her late brother, a single mom moves in with his good-natured ghost — and high-maintenance guests who will never check out.
overview_id: Setelah mewarisi hotel mendiang abangnya, seorang ibu tunggal pindah ke sana bersama hantu abangnya yang baik hati—dan para tamu ribet yang tidak akan pernah mau pergi.

overview: Wu Ming, heir to a traditional Chinese medicine family, sets out to save his fiancée’s life but is drawn into a high-stakes mission when a billion-yuan reward is offered to cure a dying CEO. His journey becomes one of danger, opportunity, and unexpected romantic entanglements, forcing him to navigate both temptation and destiny.
overview_id: Wu Ming, ahli pengobatan tradisional, turun gunung untuk menyelamatkan tunangannya. Tanpa sengaja, ia bertemu bos besar yang sedang sakit parah dan butuh tabib dengan imbalan besar. Perjalanannya penuh tantangan, kesempatan, dan godaan dari banyak wanita. Wu Ming harus memilih jalan hidupnya.

overview: A teenage shaman determined to change fate sets out to save a mysterious boy destined to die. As danger looms, their fated encounter sparks a powerful first love that defies darkness and reclaims hope.
overview_id: Seong-A seorang murid saat siang dan dukun saat malam. Meski diremehkan karena melihat dan berurusan dengan hantu, dia tetap tersenyum dan gigih. Dia terbiasa menjadi berbeda. Gyeon-U yang tampan, rentan bak api lilin diterpa angin dan dibayangi kesialan. Seong-A bersumpah akan melindunginya sejak dia datang ke kuil dalam posisi terbalik. Ini kisah cinta pertama - dan bukti kekuatan cinta.

overview: After life's ups and downs, a loving couple separated by death reunites in heaven — only to discover he's in his thirties while she's in her eighties.

The son of a fallen official teams up with a talented princess to investigate strange occurrences linked to witchcraft and celestial phenomena. As they delve deeper, they uncover a prophecy from an ancient celestial text that warns of a looming disaster threatening the realm.
overview_id: Seorang pemuda mengikuti petunjuk dari catatan ayahnya dan bekerja sama dengan Putri Kesembilan yang pandai mengobati. Mereka menyelidiki kejadian aneh seperti kutukan, petir gaib, dan bencana alam. Semua petunjuk mengarah pada ramalan kitab langit tentang “Dua Ikan” yang bisa membawa kehancuran negeri.

overview: Hee-su hides his love for his best friend—until that friend falls for someone else, and silence starts to hurt.

A group of ten true crime obsessives are invited to the opening weekend of the newly renovated Cold River Motel, the site of a 30-year-old unsolved satanic mass murder. History repeats itself when the guests get stranded and start getting knocked off one by one during a murder spree that grows exponentially more gruesome than the original with each kill.
The story follows a character from the Joseon Dynasty who travel 400 years into the future to the modern era and unwittingly open a restaurant, leading to a series of comedic and chaotic events.

Liu Yan, a retired boxer, refuses to back down as she fights to succeed in the male-dominated worlds of boxing and culinary arts. With unwavering determination and Lu Tianchi’s support, she overcomes obstacles to transform her life.
overview_id: Petinju jenius Liu Yan kehilangan kariernya karena menolak rekayasa pertandingan. Di saat bersamaan, kabar kematian sang ibu datang dari luar negeri. Saat ia datang untuk mengurus warisan, yang ia temukan justru utang besar dan adik tiri yang harus diasuh. Tapi benarkah ibunya sudah tiada…?

overview: After being framed and tortured to death, Zhang Wange is reborn three years in the past with memories of her previous life. Determined to uncover the truth, she teams up with police captain Lu Ye, whose dreams begin revealing key clues. As they follow these leads, their fates become deeply intertwined.
overview_id: Dijebak dan disiksa hingga tewas, Zhang Wange terbangun kembali ke 3 tahun di masa lalu. Dengan ingatan masa lalunya, ia mendekati Kapten Lu Ye yang mimpi-mimpinya menawarkan petunjuk misterius, demi mengungkap kebenaran. Ketika semua ilusi sirna, Lu Ye dihadapkan pada kebenaran yang menghancurkan. Dalam mimpi, satu peluru menembus dua hati, membuat satu terjebak di masa lalu sementara yang lain melangkah menuju masa depan.

overview: Wandering scholar Xie Yuan accidentally enters a matriarchal kingdom where women take multiple husbands. Admired for his looks, he’s forcibly taken by the eldest princess to become her consort. Refusing to yield, Xie Yuan plans his escape, but when the gentle second princess aids him, he’s drawn into a dangerous struggle of power and deceit within the royal palace.
overview_id: Xie Yuan terseret ke dalam kerajaan yang dipimpin wanita dan dipaksa menjadi suami Putri Sulung karena ketampanannya. Saat mencoba melarikan diri, ia dibantu oleh Putri Kedua yang tampak baik, namun ternyata justru membawanya ke dalam intrik berbahaya di istana.

overview: Reborn into the past, a young woman teams up with a celebrity to get revenge on those who hurt her – and falls in love along the way.
overview_id: Shu Yan, seorang wanita muda yang selalu mengutamakan orang lain daripada dirinya sendiri, sampai di titik terendah setelah kehilangan keluarga dan kariernya. Ia menghadapi serangkaian perubahan, tetapi saat ia kembali bangkit, ia mulai meyakinkan dirinya dan memulai hidup baru. Melalui perjalanan transformatif ini, ia menemukan cinta sejati dengan Shen Weizhou.

overview: Born with a fierce appearance but a kind heart, Gou Lingfeng dreams of becoming a great hero. However, he accidentally learns demonic skills and begins his journey in the martial world. Though facing prejudice and hardships, he never gives up on his dream. Along the way, he becomes friends with Ma Yingdan, the Floral Knight from Poison Valley, and Zhuge Heng, the son of the Sword Saint. After solving many mysterious cases with them and bringing justice to the martial world, he gradually learns the truth, “Justice comes in all forms, and martial arts bear no label of good or evil.” In the end, he really becomes a true hero.
overview_id: Lahir dengan wajah menyeramkan tapi berhati mulia, Gou Lingfeng bermimpi jadi pendekar. Namun, tanpa sengaja ia malah mempelajari ilmu sesat dan terjerumus ke dunia persilatan. Di tengah prasangka dan segala aral rintangan, mampukah ia membuktikan dirinya sebegai seorang pendekar sejati?

overview: When Chatfah, the youngest daughter of the wealthy Buppajinda family, mysteriously falls from a vacation home and vanishes just before her wedding, her three older sisters become the prime suspects. As suspicion and tragedy mount, the sisters return to their childhood mansion to uncover the truth behind Chatfah’s disappearance—even if it means confronting the possibility that one of them is responsible.
Follows the investigation into the murder of an anti-narcotics officer, exploring the darker and lighter sides of human nature.

Jiang Zhen, a former special forces instructor, goes undercover to investigate his sister’s death in a self-driving car crash, teaming up with former partner-turned-enemy Bai Fan to uncover a tech corporation’s deadly conspiracy.
overview_id: Instruktur Jiang Zhen menyamar ke Zijing Group demi mengungkap kecelakaan mobil tanpa pengemudi yang menewaskan adiknya. Ia dipertemukan kembali dengan mantan rekan yang kini jadi musuh, Bai Fan. Bersama Nong Qianya, mereka membongkar konspirasi dan menggagalkan rencana jahat ketua Zijing Group.

overview: After transmigrating into the body of a burial concubine destined to die, modern graduate Lu Zhen'er refuses to accept her fate. When she discovers that the puppet emperor Xiao Wenjing is from her hometown, the two become entwined in a dangerous struggle against destiny—one in which he may be the only person who can change, or seal, her future.
overview_id: Lulusan baru Lu Zhener terjebak ke dalam sebuah cerita sebagai selir korban pemakaman hidup. Tanpa diduga, ia menemukan bahwa Kaisar Xiao Wenjing ternyata berasal dari kampung halaman yang sama dengannya. Dihadapkan pada takdir berbahaya yang telah ditentukan, ia menolak menyerah dan bersumpah untuk melawan nasib. Namun, tanpa ia sadari, justru Xiao Wenjing lah yang memegang pena atas jalan hidupnya…

overview: For the first time ever, experts identify Hitler’s DNA. What do his genes reveal about Hitler's heritage and origins, his neurology and drives?

Intellectual Yi Gaoyuan and Tibetan girl Gesang Meiduo fall in love while studying at Tibet’s first modern school, against the backdrop of Tibet’s peaceful liberation and the region’s transformative journey into a new era.

Legendary Hong Kong police officer Ho Ho-fai, known for his role as one of the Three Tigers, faces a dramatic fall from grace after a failed mission. Joining the Special Duties Unit, he and his team, including young officer Siu Tzu-tsun, fight to uncover and thwart a plot against Hong Kong’s financial system.
overview_id: Ho Hofai, polisi legendaris Hong Kong yang terjebak dalam perangkap gangster saat menyelamatkan mentornya, membuatnya jatuh dari puncak karier dan menjadi aib kepolisian. Setelah bergabung dengan Unit Darurat, ia bersama timnya berjuang di garis depan, mengungkap dalang kejahatan besar yang mengancam Hong Kong. Lewat berbagai rintangan, mereka berhasil menggagalkan konspirasi kekuatan asing yang ingin merusak sistem keuangan dan menggoyahkan "satu negara, dua sistem".

overview: Cheng Yu, trapped as a canary under Zhou Jin's control, seeks to break free. During a staged cheating incident, she encounters male model Pei Zheng. She teases him, offering chances to play the hero, while he gradually goes from indifferent to taking charge. Initially, they both use each other for their own purposes, but over time, their feelings become genuine.
When the British prime minister's husband is kidnapped and the French president starts receiving threats, both leaders must face an impossible choice.
overview_id: Ketika suami perdana menteri Inggris diculik dan presiden Prancis mulai menerima berbagai ancaman, kedua kepala negara itu harus menghadapi pilihan yang pelik.

overview: Shortly after Daniel, or DD as everybody knows him, starts working at the hotel, one of the owner’s daughters disappears. He must do whatever it takes to find her and bring her home while still solving the ever-changing problems of the exclusive hotel guests.

Tells the story of the ascent of the biblical figure, David, who becomes the most celebrated king of Israel. The series follows the once-mighty King Saul as he falls victim to his own pride. At the direction of God, the prophet Samuel anoints an unlikely, outcast teenager as the new king.
overview_id: House of David Musim Satu menuturkan kisah tentang kebangkitan tokoh Alkitab, Daud, yang akhirnya menjadi raja Israel paling terkenal. Raja Saul yang pernah berjaya menjadi korban kesombongannya sendiri. Atas firman Tuhan, nabi Samuel mengurapi seorang remaja buangan sebagai raja baru. Ketika seorang pemimpin tumbang, bangkitlah pemimpin baru.

overview: Dublin, 1868. The Guinness family patriarch is dead, and his four children — each with dark secrets to hide — hold the brewery's fate in their hands.
overview_id: Dublin, 1868. Kepala keluarga Guinness meninggal dunia, dan keempat anaknya—masing-masing punya rahasia kelam yang tersimpan—mewarisi nasib pabrik bir di tangan mereka.

overview: Two people struck by lightning at the same time gain the ability to see the future and use their gift to help people cheat death.

A tragic event intertwines the lives of Sara, Ahmer, and Saim. When Saim becomes victim of an incident, he suspects Sara's involvement despite her denials. Their paths merge as they face truths and seek answers.
A prominent female forensic investigator suffers from antisocial personality disorder and the process in which the shadow of the father she killed threatens her honor and life.

After a large-scale police crackdown, narcotics officer Yang Yipeng seizes a critical lead with captured but defiant ringleader Mou Haidong. Alongside rookie officer Zhi An and informant Duo Zai, Yang follows a trail back to Mou Sen’s new synthetic drug operation, uncovering a complex web of drug networks. But as they delve deeper, the true mastermind remains elusive, hidden behind layers of secrecy

Seok, an eager yet genius neurosurgeon is reunited with Deokhee, the professor who ruined her life long ago. Once, the two surgeons cared for each other more than anyone else. But now with nothing but hatred toward each other, Seok is furious that he is back in her life and vows to take revenge.
The story of model student Se-hoon, who goes to the student council elections as a running mate to renew his image, and gradually becomes the core of the election.
Don Lee's extreme boxing survival. Who will survive to be the champion standing in the ring?
After a meet-cute ends in a whirlwind romance, a couple must learn to navigate the messy reality of married life that's nothing like a fairy tale ending.
overview_id: Setelah pertemuan manis yang berujung pada romansa penuh liku, pasangan ini harus menjalani pahitnya realitas pernikahan, yang jauh berbeda dengan kalimat akhir dongeng.

overview: Embark on a journey to celebrate all things Filipino — from art and architecture to culture and cuisine — in this immersive series.

A codependent friend group navigates life and love in Los Angeles. With aspirations of becoming a talent manager, Maia is stalled out as an assistant while living with her boyfriend...until her longtime best friend and frenzied influencer Tallulah returns.
overview_id: Sekelompok teman yang ambisius menjalani kehidupan dan cinta di LA.

overview: After losing his memory in an accident, martial arts heir Ye Wuming works as a driver until fate pairs him with top actress Song Yiran. As her bodyguard, he helps fight off powerful enemies and gradually uncovers the truth behind his forgotten past.

Set in 1635, 35 years after the Battle of Sekigahara, Japan appears peaceful. But a monstrous creature called 'Gun-kyo' that devours humans disrupts this calm. The shogunate burns down villages where Gun-kyo appears to hide the truth. Orin, a former ninja living quietly with her stepdaughter, is drawn back into battle after encountering Gun-kyo while seeking medicine. Meanwhile, Shiro, a Gun-kyo who retains human consciousness, sets out to uncover his origins and the creature's secret.
Maeng Se-na, a top star criminal lawyer who has been a fangirl for fifteen years, tries to prove her favorite idol’s innocence, who is suspected of murder.

In Haidong Province, prosecutors uncover a false accusation against Zhang Wenqing while reviewing the “Wan Group Gang Case,” exposing deep corruption among judicial officials. Using a whistle-blower tip as their entry point, the team dismantles the criminal network and brings the corrupt officials behind it to justice.

Cheng Ge, an elite assassin, infiltrates the palace as a personal attendant to Emperor Shi Yu, but becomes caught in court power struggles and haunted by dark secrets from the past, forcing a critical choice between mission and survival.
overview_id: Seorang pembunuh bayaran ulung bernama Cheng Ge menyamar sebagai pelayan sederhana untuk Kaisar Shi Yu demi menjalankan misi paling mematikan dalam hidupnya. Namun, saat ia terjerat dalam perebutan kekuasaan istana yang mematikan dan rahasia masa lalu yang kelam, rencananya mulai berantakan. Kini, sang pemburu yang terperangkap dalam permainannya sendiri harus membuat pilihan terakhir: menyerang atau melindungi.

overview: Content creators scheme, sabotage and spend in wild challenges to win up to $1M in the first US series from British YouTube collective the Sidemen.
overview_id: Para kreator konten membuat rencana, menyabotase, dan menguras uang di tantangan liar demi meraup hingga $1 juta di serial Amerika pertama grup YouTube Inggris, Sidemen.

overview: A wealthy entrepreneur's tangled love life with his wife, mistress, and girlfriend spans four decades and generations. But when a social media scandal costs him everything, their true values and worldviews are put to the test.

In 1962, amid a spate of unexplained disappearances of local children, a group of misfit friends begin to suspect a long-buried ancient evil lurking. As the kids set out to determine what's really going on, a rising unease prompts several townspeople to work together to restore peace – all while a U.S. military operation seeks to exploit Derry for its own objectives.
overview_id: Pada tahun 1962, sepasang suami istri beserta putra mereka pindah ke Derry, Maine, tepat saat seorang anak laki-laki menghilang. Sejak kedatangan mereka, hal-hal buruk mulai terjadi di kota tersebut.

overview: Yasemin is a young woman battling a fatal heart condition, with her obsessive stepbrother Tufan as her only support. Her struggle to make it onto the transplant list draws them into dark networks and morally fraught choices.
This jaw-dropping documentary goes behind the scenes of America's most controversial talk show to expose its biggest scandals, both on- and off-camera.
overview_id: Dokumenter mencengangkan ini menguak kejadian di balik layar talk show paling kontroversial di Amerika dan mengungkap skandal terbesarnya—di depan dan di belakang kamera.

overview: Rare videos and exclusive interviews reveal the genius, sacrifices and duality between the public and private lives of iconic singer-songwriter Juan Gabriel.
overview_id: Video langka dan wawancara eksklusif menguak kegeniusan, pengorbanan, dan dualitas antara kehidupan publik dan pribadi sang penyanyi-penulis lagu ikonik, Juan Gabriel.

overview: A down-and-out salaryman, fired and divorced, lands a bizarre job requiring him to fake a marriage with a stranger to save the world.

Jiang Zhiyu, a celestial maiden, and Jiang Jinghuai, a boy from the Li Zu tribe, fall in love but face opposition due to their class differences. As they confront challenges set by Nangong Xiao, they uncover the truth of their misunderstanding and work together to save the world.
overview_id: Dewi Cangyun Jiang Zhiyu dan siluman rakun Jiang Jinghuai saling jatuh cinta, tetapi karena perbedaan, mereka ditentang oleh pemimpin suku Cangyun Nangong Xiao, yang memasang jebakan agar cinta mereka berubah menjadi kebencian. Namun seiring berjalannya waktu, mereka perlahan-lahan mengetahui kebenarannya. Cinta sejati di antara mereka akhirnya muncul kembali?

overview: Upright and incorruptible Judge Chun Yue is forced to cover up the truth after his son causes a hit-and-run that injures the son of a notorious gang leader. Seeking vengeance for his son's injuries, the ruthless crime boss unleashes a wave of bloodshed across the city. Meanwhile, determined police officer Tong Huen remains resolute in her pursuit of justice, relentlessly chasing the truth behind the web of corruption and revenge.

Senior prosecutor Duan Hongshan from the city prosecutor's office is tasked with handling a case involving a woman accused of killing her abusive husband. Young prosecutor Fang Lingyuan from the provincial office is assigned to assist. As they investigate, they discover connections to a case from Duan’s past. Guided by facts and legal principles, they navigate complex issues of justice, sentiment, and law to reach an accurate conclusion in the case.
overview_id: Duan Hongshan, jaksa senior di Kejaksaan Kota, menangani kasus seorang perempuan yang membunuh suaminya setelah mengalami kekerasan dalam rumah tangga. Untuk membantu penyelidikan, jaksa muda Fang Lingyuan dari Kejaksaan Provinsi ditugaskan mendampingi. Dalam proses penyidikan, keduanya menemukan bahwa kasus ini berkaitan erat dengan kasus "pembelaan diri berlebihan di lingkungan sekolah" yang pernah ditangani Duan Hongshan empat belas tahun silam, melibatkan Li Mufeng, Mei Zheng, dan Jiang Ting. Berlandaskan fakta dan hukum, mereka bersama-sama menimbang keadilan, kemanusiaan, dan aturan negara, hingga akhirnya berhasil memberikan klasifikasi hukum yang tepat atas kasus tersebut.

overview:
Kaarzar-e-Dua is a timeless love story about two people who are deeply in love but are torn apart by conspiracies and unexpected twists of fate. Despite everything, their love stays strong and keeps pulling them back to each other.

Raazi is a kind and sincere young man who lives with his uncle and aunt. Their daughter, Tanno, is deeply in love with him and dreams of spending her life by his side. Although they are already married, the family is waiting for Raazi to become financially stable before holding the final wedding ceremony.

After a courageous general named Fu Yunyun time-travels into the body of a wealthy heiress, she becomes entangled in a web of love and deception. As she searches for the truth behind an ancient promise, Fu Yunyun must rely on her strength and wit to find her place in a world both familiar and strange.
overview_id: Karena sebuah janji ribuan tahun lalu, seorang jenderal wanita bereinkarnasi menjadi istri muda dari keluarga kaya, Fu Yunyun. Untuk membersihkan namanya, ia berpura-pura lembut di depan suami CEO-nya yang dingin, sambil menghadapi adik ipar licik dan prajurit setianya yang ikut melintasi waktu. Di tengah perebutan cinta dan intrik keluarga, ia berjuang menemukan kebenaran dan cinta sejatinya.

overview: When upright cop Arjun Maitra takes on Kolkata's feared don Bagha and his henchmen, he must battle a broken system and navigate bloody gang wars.
overview_id: Ketika melawan Bagha dan para kaki tangannya yang ditakuti di Kolkata, Arjun Maitra si polisi jujur harus memerangi sistem yang buruk dan menghadapi perang geng berdarah.

overview: Madhu moves into a hostel in Delhi to start afresh, but her room hides a sinister presence that begins to get stronger each day, alarming the other women on her floor. They know what the room hides and desperately want her gone before it is too late for them all.
overview_id: Madhu pindah ke asrama di Delhi untuk memulai hidup baru, tetapi kamarnya menyembunyikan sosok menyeramkan yang makin hari makin kuat, membuat wanita lain di lantainya khawatir. Mereka tahu yang disembunyikan kamar itu dan sangat ingin Madhu pergi sebelum terlambat bagi mereka semua.

overview: On a remote island, Kian84 hosts a quirky B&B escape, where BTS' Jin and Ji Ye-eun lead guests through playful exploits and delightful chaos.

After losing her parents to a powerful tycoon’s scheme, You You returns years later under a new identity to seek revenge. Teaming up with Qi Dong, her former enemy and the tycoon’s discarded son, they unite against a shared past, unaware that a greater threat looms.
overview_id: Youyou kehilangan ibu dan ayah karena An Guoxuan. Ia tanpa sengaja membuat Qi Dong buta, lalu diselamatkan dan dibawa ke luar negeri. Qi Dong bangkit dan mendirikan perusahaan untuk melawan An Guoxuan. Kembali sebagai arsitek ternama, Youyou mendekati Qi Dong untuk balas dendam, namun keduanya menyadari musuh yang sama. Bersatu, mereka melawan An Guoxuan, namun ancaman lebih besar mengintai.

overview: Set in the siege of Terra itself, Kill Lupercal follows a Warlord Titan and its crew as they seek to end the war for the Throneworld in a single devastating blow.
A Southern prince and a Northern assassin, bound since childhood, struggle with love and betrayal as political intrigue threatens to tear them apart.

Kimora Lee Simmons, the single mom of five, who runs the Baby Phat brand, will be dealing with the whims of her model daughters, cheering at her sons’ championship games and celebrating her own major milestones.

Harold of Wessex and William of Normandy are two men destined to face each other at the Battle of Hastings in 1066. Two former allies, neither of whom had aspired to the British throne, are forced, by circumstances and their personal obsession, to wage war over possession of the crown.

Experience thrilling highs and crushing lows as the world's best chefs pursue the ultimate accolade: a Michelin Star. These anonymous inspectors have never let anyone in on their mysterious ways, until now.
overview_id: Rasakan suka dan duka ketika para koki terbaik dunia mengejar penghargaan tertinggi: Bintang Michelin. Para inspektur anonim ini tidak pernah memberitahukan metode misterius mereka, hingga sekarang.

overview: An assistant director at a news station faces the challenges of pursuing his dream of becoming a reporter while navigating personal growth, work struggles, and moments of romance with his colleagues.
Haunted by her past, a nightclub singer begins to rediscover her worth and faith through an unexpected bond with a devout new neighbour.
In the early Meiji era, Shujiro, once known as an undefeated samurai, decides to participate in a deadly survival game to save his family and villagers.
overview_id: Di awal era Meiji, Shujiro—yang dulu dikenal sebagai samurai tak terkalahkan—nekat mengikuti permainan bertahan hidup yang mematikan demi keluarga dan para penduduk desa.

overview: Every summer reunion between twin brothers and their neighbor blossoms into unspoken love, until adulthood and a past tragedy change their lives forever.
Story of a lawyer who is known for his good appearance and straightforward personality and is working with Gyeongmin Law Firm for 9 years.
When her husband leaves her for another woman, a resilient Southern mom starts over with the support of her loving, but unfiltered family.
overview_id: Saat sang suami meninggalkannya demi wanita lain, seorang ibu tangguh dari Selatan memulai lembaran baru dengan dukungan keluarga yang penuh kasih, tetapi blak-blakan.

overview: Two young men born on February 29 try to uncover the secret behind their leap year birthday curse before they lose people close to them.

This romance follows two unlikely souls bridging vast differences through secret lessons. A strict high school teacher, raised in a rigid household, begins tutoring a kind-hearted but illiterate nightclub host. As their bond deepens, societal judgment, jealousy, and prejudice threaten their forbidden connection.

Set in the early Ming Dynasty, martial arts factions battle to claim the Four Sacred Artifacts. Hero Gao Lingfeng, while uncovering the truth about his past and a city's destruction, teams up with Sun Chenxi. Together, they thwart a conspiracy, recover one of the artifacts, and take on the mission to find the remaining ones to protect the world.

Migrant worker Li Gouwa suddenly finds himself in the world of the wealthy, seeking justice for his brother. What begins as revenge becomes a deadly conspiracy that sparks a fierce battle for the Dongcan Group inheritance. As an unlikely underdog, Li navigates the treacherous power struggle, ultimately toppling the corrupt system and uncovering the truth behind the plot.

A female general with a gentle appearance but a strong inner spirit, and a male general with a cold exterior and internal but with stronger martial prowess. The two join forces to combat deceit, assist the weak, and eliminate external threats.
overview_id: Seorang jenderal wanita dengan penampilan lembut namun memiliki semangat yang kuat di dalam, bertemu seorang jenderal pria dengan sikap dingin tetapi memiliki kemampuan bertarung yang lebih kuat. Keduanya bergabung untuk melawan kezaliman, membantu yang lemah, dan menghancurkan ancaman.

overview: "Legend of Zang Hai" follows the son of Imperial Astronomer Kuai Duo. Consumed by vengeance, he spends a decade honing his skills. Assuming the name Zang Hai, he ventures into the capital to uncover the truth, avenge his family, and restore justice.

Luo Lingyu, a fallen noblewoman, travels to Yuezhou with her sister to seek refuge. On the way, she rescues a destitute man but later forces him to jump overboard due to societal norms. Unaware that the Lu family's third young master is the man she pushed into the water, she tries to win his favor—only to be repeatedly thwarted. He watches her struggle, exposing her every move, yet when she turns to someone else, he refuses to let her go!

Psychological expert Li Mochou joins the Baizhou Police Department, enhancing criminal team leader Ding Wei’s investigative skills. Together, they solve a series of bizarre cases and uncover the long-hidden truth behind a major crime.

Gu Nian gets a chance to rewrite her past through a high-tech life reboot. She’s shocked to wake up in the body of a strange man. As she faces her younger self from seven years ago, Gu Nian must navigate life in her new form and guide her past self through a series of life-changing decisions.

Disguised as a courtesan, assassin Zhen Xu crosses paths with Zhou Musheng, a man on a secret mission. Though they start by using each other, their bond deepens through peril and betrayal. Facing deadly threats together, they ultimately unite to expose the Chamber’s crimes.
overview_id: Menyamar sebagai penyanyi terkenal, pembunuh bernama Zhen Xu bertemu Zhou Musheng, anggota kamar dagang yang punya misi rahasia. Awalnya saling memanfaatkan, mereka justru jatuh cinta dan bersama-sama melawan kejahatan untuk memulai hidup baru.

overview: Ye Sibei has always endured her parents' favoritism toward her brother, choosing to avoid conflict. Her husband, Qin Nan, deeply loves her but grows frustrated with her reluctance to stand up for herself and files for divorce. However, after Sibei faces a traumatic experience, Qin Nan returns to support her, encouraging her to seek justice.
overview_id: Ye Sibei terus mengalah pada orang tuanya yang pilih kasih, hingga suaminya Qin Nan tak tahan dan minta cerai. Namun saat Ye Sibei mengalami kejadian tragis, Qin Nan kembali mendukungnya mencari keadilan. Mampukah mereka bangkit dan menata hidup dari awal?

overview: Rivals Fang Li and An Hang accidentally get trapped in a virtual world, becoming a married couple. With opposing system missions, they must defeat each other to return to reality. As they battle it out, they start to fall for each other. Can they rewrite the system's rules and find a way out?

After surviving a brutal massacre, Qin Shiyue is taken in by Commander Dai Shiyao and finds herself caught between two brothers: A Sheng, whose feelings evolve from greed to love, and Dai Shiyao, who moves from suspicion to affection. As war erupts, they challenge their destinies through sacrifice and loyalty, while Qin Shiyue uncovers the truth behind her father’s wrongful death and discovers a new beginning.
overview_id: Untuk mengungkap kebenaran di balik tuduhan palsu ayahnya, ia berhadapan dengan dua saudara: Sheng, yang beralih dari obsesi kejam menjadi cinta; dan Dai Shiyao, yang kecurigaannya berubah menjadi gairah. Saat perang berkobar, mereka menentang takdir: Sheng memilih cinta, Dai Shiyao mengorbankan cinta demi tugas, dan Qin Shiyue menemukan kebenaran di tengah pertumpahan darah.

overview: Dr Jim Swire tragically loses his daughter when Pan Am Flight 103 exploded over a small town on 21 December 1988. Travelling across continents and political divides, Swire embarks on a relentless journey that not only jeopardises his stability, family and life, but completely overturns his trust in the justice system. As the truth shifts under his feet, Swire's view of the world is left forever sullied.

After a betrayal, heiress Jian Cheng enters a contract marriage with her ex-fiancé’s uncle, Zhou Tingyan. As they navigate family tensions and business battles, their fake marriage blossoms into true love, uncovering past secrets and leading to mutual growth and redemption.
overview_id: Dikhianati oleh tunangannya, Jian Cheng memutus pertunangan dan secara impulsif menikah kilat dengan paman sang mantan. Pernikahan yang awalnya hanya demi membalas budi perlahan berubah menjadi cinta sejati, di tengah konflik keluarga dan rahasia kelam masa lalu. Di bawah perlindungan Zhou Tingyan, Jian Cheng tumbuh dari gadis manja menjadi wanita mandiri, sementara cinta yang lama terpendam akhirnya menemukan jalannya.

overview: From the creator of "BoJack Horseman" comes this animated comedy about a family over time, following siblings from childhood to adulthood and back again.
overview_id: Kreator "BoJack Horseman" mempersembahkan komedi animasi tentang sebuah keluarga yang mengisahkan hidup kakak-beradik dari masa kecil hingga dewasa, dan kembali lagi.

overview: Best friends Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman gear up for their fourth Long Way series—this time going from Ewan's home in Scotland to Charley's in England. They'll take the scenic route, of course, through 17 European countries on cranky old bikes.
overview_id: Dua sahabat Ewan McGregor dan Charley Boorman bersiap untuk seri Long Way keempat mereka, kali ini berangkat dari rumah Ewan di Skotlandia ke rumah Charley di Inggris. Tentu, mereka mengambil rute pemandangan, melalui 17 negara Eropa dengan motor tua yang penggerutu.

overview: After his wife’s death, retired professor Shen Zhuoran reluctantly returns to dating. He meets four very different women: a compassionate nurse, a brilliant but ill scientist, a strong-willed union leader, and a woman who reminds him of his late wife. Through these encounters, he faces love, loss, and personal growth, ultimately transforming his perspective on life and deeply affecting his family.

After her family is massacred, General’s daughter Xu Chuyun enters the capital to uncover the truth. Suspecting the wheelchair-bound Crown Prince Jiang Yunsheng, she marries into his household to investigate. As they work together, misunderstandings fade, and they join forces to solve mysteries and ultimately uncover the truth, united by their shared quest for justice.

Fang Yi, an ordinary city dweller, accidentally falls into a martial arts world, expecting adventure and heroism. Instead, she encounters Rong Shuang, a once-great swordsman now struggling with lost skills. Rescued by the ruthless bounty hunter Yan Shao, she is taken to the enigmatic Yuchi Manor, where she discovers a world filled with intrigue and hidden emotions.
overview_id: Fang Yi si gadis rumahan tidak sengaja masuk ke dalam novel yang dikeluhkannya. Di dalam novel ia bertemu Chu Tianyao, pemilik pondok di buku itu. Setelah beberapa tikungan dan belokan, Fang Yi mengubah hidupnya melawan langit berbekal kecerdasannya sendiri. Dia dan Chu Tianyao juga saling menyembuhkan dan tumbuh dalam cinta. Keduanya akhirnya menulis kisah cinta yang indah.

overview: Si Yichen, son of King Zishang, loses his entire family in a massacre on his wedding day. To seek revenge, he assumes the identity of Mu Han and gains the trust of the Eldest Princess. Meanwhile, his fiancée, Hang Anning, believing him to be dead, infiltrates the palace by swapping faces with the princess. Under the same roof, their hidden identities lead to unexpected emotions, love and vengeance become inseparable.

Chong Yang, a member of the Yongye Clan, plants the Noctrose to end his life, but it refuses to bloom until he meets Ji Nanxing, a cursed girl from the Yan Tribe who must marry him to survive. One longs for death, while the other fights to live, forcing their fates to intertwine. As love and sacrifice collide, their bittersweet journey of redemption unfolds.
overview_id: Chong Yang dari Klan Yongye sudah lelah hidup abadi. Untuk melawan keabadiannya, ia menanam bunga Noctrose agar bisa mengakhiri hidupnya. Tapi bunga itu tak pernah mekar—sampai ia bertemu Ji Nanxing, gadis dari Klan Yan. Ji Nanxing dikutuk akan mati muda, dan satu-satunya cara untuk bertahan hidup adalah menikah dengan Chong Yang. Satu ingin mati, Satu ingin berjuang untuk hidup, bagaimana kelanjutan nasib mereka?

overview: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Song Qiyue returns to Wuxi to reclaim their guesthouse and start over. With the unexpected help of Gu Cian, a mysterious businessman, she renovates the inn and rediscovers purpose and love. But when she learns Gu Cian is the executive behind a redevelopment project threatening the guesthouse, their growing bond is put to the test.
On a 7-day journey, eight boys face BL tasks, real emotions, and one big question: who will they choose when it’s time to confess?
Jian Dan, a kind-hearted village girl, helps Han Yansheng, a gifted but traumatized math genius, heal and rediscover his strength. Together, they grow through friendship, love, and shared courage.
overview_id: Gadis desa bernama Jian Dan bertemu jenius matematika Han Yansheng di kampus. Saat Yansheng mengalami trauma, Jian Dan hadir memberi kekuatan. Di tengah perjuangan dan dukungan itu, tumbuhlah benih cinta… Tapi apakah cinta cukup untuk menyembuhkan segalanya?

overview: It tells the story of Dongfang Huaizhu and Wangquan Hongye, the leaders of two major families, the Dongfangs and the Wangquans. In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation in order to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, their fates intertwine like the sheaths of two swords, never to be separated. They pick up the most heartwarming promise and tell a story that has endured for generations.
overview_id: Menceritakan tentang bagaimana Dongfang Huaizhu dan Wangquan Hongye sebagai juru mudi dari masing-masing keluarga yang berada dalam situasi di mana manusia dan siluman tidak dapat hidup berdampingan, mereka berusaha dan berjuang untuk menghidupkan kembali aliansi Yiqi dan menstabilkan situasi. Pada hari ketujuh bulan ketujuh lunar, ada paviliun Bambu di Sungai Huai; akan mengandalkan satu sama lain dan tidak akan pernah berubah walaupun menghadapi rintangan. Menceritakan sebuah janji yang paling menyentuh dan sebuah kisah yang lebih panjang.

overview: At the annual Qingyun Conference in the Hexu Six Realms, Ji Bozai, a warrior from the Jixing Abyss with a past as a convict, defeated Ming Yi, the cold warrior goddess who had reigned supreme for seven consecutive years. Overnight, Ji Bozai became the hottest new star in Jixing Abyss. Meanwhile, Ming Yi, hiding her true identity, disguised herself as a dancer to get close to Ji Bozai. Under their carefully crafted personas, the two engaged in a thrilling dance of deception and attraction, fighting for justice and fairness, and ultimately found a deep and moving love.
overview_id: Pada "Turnamen Qingyun" tahunan Enam Alam Hexu, Ji Bozai (diperankan oleh Hou Minghao), seorang petarung Jurang Jixing yang berasal dari latar belakang narapidana, secara mengejutkan mengalahkan Ming Yi (diperankan oleh Lu Yuxiao), seorang dewi perang dingin yang telah memenangkan pertandingan selama tujuh tahun berturut-turut. Dalam semalam, dia menjadi bintang paling bersinar di Jurang Jixing. Sementara itu, Ming Yi menyembunyikan jati dirinya dan menyamar sebagai penari untuk mendekati Ji Bozai. Keduanya, dengan identitas tersembunyi, terlibat dalam pertarungan penuh semangat dan romansa, memperjuangkan keadilan, dan akhirnya mendapatkan cinta yang mengharukan.

overview: In a loveless arranged marriage, Fu Yancheng and Sheng Mian plan to divorce.  However, an unexpected intimate encounter leads to deeper misunderstandings when Fu Yancheng discovers that Sheng Mian is actually Penny. Regretting his actions, Fu Yancheng works to win her back
overview_id: Dalam pernikahan bisnis tanpa cinta, dua orang yang belum pernah bertemu berencana mengakhiri pernikahan mereka setelah tiga tahun. Namun, Fu Yancheng tahu bahwa Sheng Mian adalah Penny, lalu berusaha memperbaiki hubungan mereka dan memutuskan untuk bersama selamanya.

overview: Entrepreneur Jiang Anlan secretly joins a virtual game to track down his first love, Yao Yuan, rekindling their relationship and bringing it into the real world. Just as their wedding plans begin, long-standing family grudges and unexpected hardships threaten to break them apart. Facing misunderstandings and illness, they must fight for each other and their future to prove that true love can withstand even the deepest grudges.

A group of singles who want to be loved for who they are will have the opportunity to search for their soulmate without the distractions of the outside world and will choose someone to marry without ever meeting them face-to-face. When their wedding day arrives, will real-world realities and external factors push them apart, or will they marry the person they fell blindly in love with?

A divorce lawyer Aiko and vet Kai bond over their dogs, while Korean conglomerate heir  Seo-ha approaches Kai on a mission. Their paths collide in a love story about connection and growth sparked by their pets.
Following everyone’s favorite Season 6 Islanders around Los Angeles as they navigate new careers, evolving friendships, newfound fame, and complex relationships outside of the Love Island villa.

Surgeon Gu Nian saves a drug dealer and is pulled into a deadly underworld, where they fall in love. After he vanishes in an explosion, she later meets a man who looks just like him but claims to be someone else. As she searches for the truth behind her mother’s death, hidden identities and buried secrets slowly unravel.

High deity Jin Xiu sets out to help the camellia spirit Hong Ning achieve immortality, but their journey forges a bond that spans a thousand years—until, in a twist of fate, Hong Ning leads Jin Xiu to embrace life as a mortal.
overview_id: Menceritakan kisah Dewa Jin Xiu yang mencoba membantu roh bunga kamelia, Hong Ning, untuk mencapai keabadian. Namun, terbentuk ikatan selama seribu tahun di antara mereka dan pada akhirnya, Hong Ning membantu Jin Xiu berubah menjadi manusia.

overview: Gu Qingcheng, a young florist, unknowingly absorbs the flower spirit of Lyu Gengyun, a thousand-year-old half-demon. Mistaking him for the Floral Immortal, she takes him as her master, while he stays by her side to uncover his past. As they grow closer through magical adventures, fate, hidden identities, and the arrival of the true Floral Immortal put their bond to the test.
overview_id: Di kota Ping, "Ibu Kota Bunga," Gu Qingcheng, seorang penanam bunga, tanpa sengaja menghirup roh peony putih yang ternyata adalah Lyu Gengyun, makhluk setengah siluman berusia seribu tahun. Sejak kecil, Gu Qingcheng bertekad menghidupkan 9.999 bunga demi memenuhi pesan terakhir ayahnya—menanti Dewa Bunga untuk membawanya ke langit.  Ketika Lyu Gengyun terbangun dari dalam peony raksasa, Gu Qingcheng yakin dialah Dewa Bunga yang dinantikannya dan memohon menjadi muridnya. Sementara itu, Lyu Gengyun menyembunyikan identitasnya demi menemukan cara melepaskan roh bunga dari tubuh Gu Qingcheng serta mengungkap tragedi keluarganya. Namun, Gu Qingcheng ternyata adalah "Pencuri Bunga" yang ditakuti banyak orang.  Di tengah perjalanan ajaib mereka, ikatan mulai terjalin, tetapi kemunculan Dewa Bunga yang sebenarnya membawa tantangan dan pilihan yang tak terduga.

overview: Su Yishui, a talented young cultivator, had his destiny changed by his master Mu Qingge eighteen years ago. Mu Qingge, known as the "female demon," was also branded with a bad reputation and presumed dead. Eighteen years later, Mu Qingge transforms into Xue Ranran, and Su Yishui, now the head of the West Mountain Sect, takes the critically ill Ranran as his disciple, vowing to protect her for life. Thus, the roles of master and disciple are swapped, and various amusing and unusual stories unfold between them.
overview_id: Seorang Pertapa abadi yang memiliki bakat spesial, Su Yishui, diubah takdirnya oleh tuannya, Mu Qingge delapan belas tahun yang lalu. "Iblis Wanita" Mu Qingge, yang selalu memberontak, meninggal karena nama buruk yang ditanggungnya. Delapan belas tahun kemudian, Mu Qingge berubah menjadi Xue Ranran. Su Yishui, yang berhasil menjadi kepala Sekte Xishan, membawa Ranran yang lemah dan sekarat ke dalam sektenya, bersumpah untuk melindunginya seumur hidupnya. Sejak saat itu, identitas guru dan murid tertukar. Kisah lucu apa yang akan terjadi di antara keduanya?

overview: After an assassination attempt, estranged couple Xiao Jingyang and Lin Mingxuan swap souls and return to the past before their marriage. As they search for a way back, they uncover hidden dangers and secrets, forcing them to confront their fate together.
overview_id: Setelah upaya pembunuhan, Xiao Jingyang dan Lin Mingxuan yang hendak bercerai justru bertukar jiwa dan kembali ke masa sebelum mereka menikah. Mereka bekerja sama mencari cara kembali, tapi setelah semuanya hampir terselesaikan, Jingyang justru memilih untuk menjauh. Saat rahasia terungkap dan bahaya mengintai, Mingxuan memilih bertahan di sisinya.

overview: Yoo Eun-ho, a single dad armed with perfection, becomes the secretary of Kang Ji-yun, the CEO of a popular headhunter company, who doesn't do anything except work.
Rakumoto Ai, a romance novelist, meets Muto Kaishin, a free-spirited islander, during his stay. Their unexpected encounter stirs something in Ai he can’t quite ignore.

Renowned anchor Xu Yan and urban elite Shen Haoming appear to be the perfect couple but struggle to fit into each other’s social circles due to their differing backgrounds. When conflict arises, Xu Yan leaves, prompting Shen Haoming to realize his deep love for her and attempt to win her back. On their journey, they face challenges, shed their facades, and rediscover their true selves.
overview_id: Xu Yan, seorang pembawa acara terkenal, dan Shen Haoming, seorang elit, adalah pasangan yang dikagumi banyak orang. Meskipun terlihat sangat serasi, perbedaan latar belakang mereka membuat sulit untuk benar-benar menyatu. Xu Yan, dengan identitasnya yang glamor dan latar belakang yang "dipoles", berhasil menikah dengan Shen Haoming, yang sebenarnya telah mengendalikan segalanya. Ketika konflik muncul, Xu Yan memutuskan untuk meninggalkan Shen Haoming dan tidak ingin kembali. Namun, Shen Haoming menyadari perasaannya pada Xu Yan, akankah mereka menemukan satu sama lain?

overview: A single mom and her medical student daughter have entered an unexpected second act in their lives. A story of love that is not an end but a beginning that comes to them as they decide to live happily today instead of tomorrow.

After a university merges its modeling and computer engineering departments, the charming model Min-hak and the perfectionist coder Yeon-san, polar opposites in every way, unexpectedly fall for each other.
A romance anthology featuring 10 different love stories, each with its own unique tone and charm. It has an ensemble cast.

Talented painter Xin Yi returns to her hometown to uncover the truth behind a family tragedy. Posing as a rising artist, she targets a powerful collector linked to her past. When his son offers a secret alliance to gain power, the two enter a dangerous game of deception, unleashing turmoil in a seemingly quiet town.
overview_id: Xin Yi, pelukis jenius, kembali ke kampung halaman untuk mengungkap kematian ayahnya dan trauma adiknya akibat pabrik seni palsu. Ia berpura-pura bekerja untuk kolektor Guan Shanhai. Saat mencari kebenaran, putra Guan, Guan Huai, membantunya demi ambisi pribadi. Mereka pun terlibat dalam konspirasi berbahaya.

overview: A dangerous story of rough people obsessed with shameless greed who gather together with their own greed and logic to find underwater artifacts off the coast of Shinan.

Master carpenter Li Mudun, famed for his skill with ancient Luban techniques, becomes the prime suspect in a series of eerie, superstition-filled murders. Determined to clear his name, Li teams up with detective Yang Zong and forensic doctor Su Qingyun. With reason and justice, the trio races to stop a new wave of killings and expose the truth behind the so-called “supernatural.”
overview_id: Li Mudun, tukang kayu terbaik di Kota Kabut, dituduh sebagai pelaku hilangnya para pengantin. Bersama seorang detektif dan ahli forensik, ia menyelidiki kasus yang dipenuhi perangkap mekanis dan misteri gelap, hingga akhirnya jejak itu mengarah pada saudaranya sendiri. Mereka harus mengungkap kebenaran di tengah kota yang semakin kacau

overview: Su Leyu, a noblewoman marries Yin Changyan, the prince who seized the throne, and gets caught in palace intrigue. Committed to a vision of equality, Su Leyu uncovers the truth behind the coup and teams up with Yin Changyan to overthrow the old regime and transform the kingdom.
overview_id: Drama ini bercerita tentang Su Leyu, putri bangsawan yang dipaksa menikah dengan Kaisar Yin Changyan, berjuang melawan sistem kekuasaan lama untuk memperkenalkan reformasi, termasuk ujian pegawai negeri untuk perempuan, sekaligus menantang dominasi empat keluarga bangsawan yang menindas rakyat.

overview: On a quest for vengeance, a young woman infiltrates a wealthy real estate family, plotting to destroy them as their wary matriarch grows suspicious.

Tommy Lynley, an aristocratic detective, and Barbara Havers, a working-class maverick sergeant, share little in common; except a passion for justice. His intellect and her instincts make them an unlikely but formidable team.
An aspiring entrepreneur breaks new ground with the launch of a startup courier service that brings new opportunities — and powerful enemies.
overview_id: Seorang calon pengusaha memulai langkah baru dengan meluncurkan layanan kurir baru yang menghadirkan peluang baru dan musuh-musuh yang kuat.

overview: In 1970s South Korea, follow two men on opposite sides of power — one driven by ambition, the other by justice. As their worlds collide, greed, loyalty, and survival intertwine in a battle that will shape a nation.

Jules Maigret is a rising star in the Police Judiciaire, relentless in his investigations, with an uncanny ability to get under the skin of the criminals he is chasing and a matchless knowledge of Paris and its inhabitants

In the south of France, the leader of a gypsy community and her two sons fight to save their clan, threatened with eviction by rising waters. To survive, they must cross the lines of legality and fight in a dark and dangerous world... all while hiding the unspeakable secret that has haunted their family for seven years.
A charming tutor infiltrates a wealthy family's life, revealing a sinister agenda.
As Christmas approaches, a blundering-all-the-way dad juggles housesitting a posh London penthouse with an unexpected pickle: caring for a lost baby.
overview_id: Menjelang Natal, seorang ayah yang ceroboh harus menjaga griya tawang mewah di London sambil menghadapi sebuah masalah yang tak terduga: mengurus bayi yang tersesat.

overview: While expanding her e-commerce business abroad, Chinese entrepreneur Guan Mengmeng is swept into royal intrigue in the Kingdom of Manbo. A contract marriage with Crown Prince Song Pai turns into a powerful partnership, as she helps him fight for the throne and he backs her mission to bring digital change to his country.
When a series of ritualistic murders shakes a small town, a detective and an ex-cop must investigate a mystery with deep ties to their pasts.
A docuseries that reveals the decades of abuse and deception of Father Marcial Maciel, the infamous leader of the Legionaries of Christ.

Kang Ma Ri has always longed for her father, but her search takes an unexpected turn when three men suddenly step into her life. This leads to the birth of an eccentric new family, one that proves stronger than blood and more persistent than DNA.
Follow the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit as they conduct high-stakes combat exercises in the Pacific.

On her wedding night, wealthy heiress Liang Yi is betrayed by her husband, disfigured, and cast into a river. Rescued and given a new face, she assumes the identity of courtesan Xu Yin and draws close to gang leader Lin Yun, determined to take her revenge.
overview_id: Pada malam pernikahannya, sang pewaris kaya raya, Liang Yi, disiksa hingga wajahnya rusak dan dibuang ke sungai oleh suaminya. Tak disangka, dia diselamatkan dan dipaksa mengganti wajahnya menjadi Xu Yin, seorang wanita penghibur dari dunia malam. Dengan identitas barunya, Liang Yi kembali ke dunia luar sebagai Xu Yin dan mendekati ketua geng Lin Yun untuk memulai jalan balas dendamnya.

overview: When a young woman wants to revive her deceased fiancé's jewelry brand, she partners with an influencer – who happens to look just like him!
overview_id: Untuk menghidupkan kembali perusahaan perhiasan mendiang tunangannya Tang Jingxing, Istrinya Mi Chuxia bekerja sama dengan seleb internet Louis. Keduanya secara bertahap jatuh cinta saat kerja bersama, tetapi kemudian Mi Chuxia menyadari bahwa Louis adalah Tang Jingxing, dan kebenaran tentang kecelakaan mobilnya tiga tahun lalu akhirnya terungkap.

overview: Xia Nuan travels to South Asia to help her sick stepsister, only to uncover a plot to steal her kidney. Betrayed by her family and rescued by an underground fighter, she returns to expose the truth at the funeral they planned for her.
overview_id: Xia Nuan yang baik hati pergi ke luar negri untuk membantu adik tirinya yang sakit ginjal. Namun ternyata ginjal yang dibutuhkan adalah miliknya sendiri. Saat nyaris diambil paksa, ia diselamatkan oleh Zhong Xinyang. Xia Nuan lalu kembali secara mengejutkan di pemakamannya sendiri!

overview: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.
A black comedy about a doctor who illegally helps terminally ill patients with euthanasia and a detective who tracks down her illegal activities.

Xie Tianxing, a chivalrous thief from a fallen noble family, unexpectedly finds himself thrust into a new life when he takes on a mission that leads to him assuming the identity of a wealthy merchant. As he navigates his sudden transformation, he discovers that beneath his newfound fortune, danger and deception lurk at every turn.
Maya has waited 15 years. Now, she’s back to take down the family that destroyed her—one by one, no one escapes the fire she’s bringing.
Somebody wants to kill CEO Bárbara Hidalgo. Can she find the culprit as her family schemes ruthlessly for control of their Colombian business empire?
overview_id: Dapatkah Bárbara Hidalgo, sang CEO, menemukan pelaku yang ingin membunuh dirinya saat keluarganya dengan kejam berencana mengendalikan kerajaan bisnis mereka di Kolombia?

overview: A movie buff falls for an aspiring director, igniting a romance that fizzles out too soon. When their paths cross again, can love find its way back?
overview_id: Seorang penyuka film jatuh hati kepada calon sutradara, menyulut api asmara yang padam terlalu dini. Ketika mereka bertemu lagi, bisakah cinta menemukan jalan kembali?

overview: Within the exclusive enclaves of Palm Beach County, follow a group of women navigating the unspoken rules, inherited traditions and high-stakes hierarchies of America's most rarefied social circles. In this manicured world of privilege and private clubs, reputations are built over brunch, alliances shift over champagne, and while wealth is ubiquitous, power, influence and access are the true currency.
After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death — embarking on a relentless path of revenge.
overview_id: Setelah putus hubungan dengan gengnya, seorang mantan gangster kembali untuk mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian adik lelakinya—memulai balas dendam yang tiada henti.

overview: After being attacked while trying to cure a plague, Gu Xiaofeng wakes up in the modern world. Determined to uncover the truth behind her time travel, she stays close to Dr. Ren Yi, the man whose figure she glimpsed before losing consciousness, unfolding a story that bridges two worlds.

Three best friends — gay gentlemen of a certain age – decide after an unexpected death to spend their golden years living together in Palm Springs where the wealthiest one lives with his mother. As a chosen family, they prove that no matter how hard things get, there’s always someone around to remind you it would be better if you got your neck done.

Li Tian, an IT genius, is transported back to the early 2000s, waking up as a broke man with a mysterious wife. As he rebuilds his life and starts a business from scratch, a former friend turns into a rival, and the secret behind his time travel begins to surface.
