overview_id: Li Tian, jenius IT, terlempar ke tahun 2000-an dan bangun sebagai pria berutang dengan istri yang tak ia kenali. Bersama sahabatnya, ia bangkit membangun bisnis. Namun, kesuksesan justru memicu perang dengan saudara yang dulu ia percaya, sambil perlahan terkuak misteri pertukaran jiwanya.

overview: Amid a crumbling marriage, Yan Lidong and Mu Chenxi face the brink of divorce due to misunderstandings and conflicts. When Yan Lidong is injured saving Mu Chenxi, his memory reverts to his 19-year-old self. As they navigate this unexpected twist, Mu Chenxi reflects on her past neglect and begins to rediscover the love and connection they once shared.
The daughter of a genius shogi player channels the pain of her father's abandonment and her mother's death to become an elite competitor.
Philadelphia is the City of Brotherly Love, but in the '90s, it was a bloodbath. Two warring mob factions battle for control in this true-crime series.

In Hua'ao City, a brilliant detective with a flawless track record faces his toughest case yet when a string of seemingly perfect murders shakes the city. With no evidence, no witnesses, and a killer who vanishes without a trace, he must race against time to uncover the truth. As hidden dangers lurk in every corner, the line between hunter and hunted begins to blur.
overview_id: Seorang detektif jenius di Kepolisian Kota Hua’ao dikenal karena kebijaksanaan dan keberaniannya dalam memecahkan berbagai kasus besar. Namun, ketika serangkaian pembunuhan sempurna terjadi tanpa meninggalkan jejak pelaku, ia harus menghadapi misteri yang mengguncang batas kemampuannya, di tengah kota yang dipenuhi intrik dan ancaman tersembunyi.

overview: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

After a tragedy strikes her family, Alizay seeks revenge against the wealthy Hamdani family, whose pride and greed have caused irreparable damage to her modest but once-happy life with her mother and sister.

After sabotaging a blind date, Xin Tong—a job-hopping part-time queen—becomes the contract girlfriend of wealthy heir Wen Pei’an to help him evade an arranged marriage, leading to a chaotic and comedic cohabitation romance.
overview_id: Seorang Ratu Part Time tanpa sengaja menjadi pacar kontrak pewaris konglomerat, lalu terjebak dalam kisah cinta pura-pura yang berubah jadi nyata di tengah pengawasan ketat orang tua dan situasi kocak yang tak terduga.

overview: In a tale of fate and resilience, the troubled Crown Prince of Li Dynasty and the wise and courageous Princess Yuexi grow from acquaintances to deep confidants. They silently support and heal each other, bravely confront enemies, uncover the truth, and face life’s challenges together, driven by their love for one another.
overview_id: Seorang mahasiswi tanpa sengaja terjebak ke dalam novel dan menjadi peran pendukung kejam, Putri Yue Xi, yang tewas dalam tiga bab. Untuk menyelamatkan hidupnya, dia menjauh dari plot. Namun, setelah beradaptasi, Ning Chuxi malah terlibat lebih dalam dan berusaha menyelamatkan karakter lain yang mati. Berhasilakh ia kembali ke dunia nyata?

overview: The shocking true-life tale of Ed Gein, the infamous murderer and grave robber who inspired many of Hollywood's most iconic on-screen killers.
overview_id: Kisah nyata mencengangkan tentang Ed Gein, pembunuh dan penjarah makam terkenal yang menginspirasi banyak karakter pembunuh paling ikonis di layar Hollywood.

overview: In Joseon, a vengeful crown prince and a memory-lost merchant mysteriously swap bodies, unraveling a web of chaos, secrets, and unexpected fate.

Bai Shuo, the youngest daughter of the General's Mansion, aspires to cultivate immortality in order to repay a favor. On her journey to seek immortality, she accidentally rescues the great demon god Fan Yue. As the saying goes, healthy fights strengthen relationships, and they go from mutual manipulation to mutual affection as they fall in love with each other, navigating a love affair intertwined with sweetness and cruelty. Even though they face countless difficulties, their love is strong enough to overcome all limitations, allowing them to truly embrace each other.

Feng Zuoren, a skilled assassin, disguises herself as a beautiful stepmother to infiltrate a noble family and eliminate the former crown prince. However, her mission becomes complicated when she develops a tense and unexpected bond with her clever stepson, uncovering secrets that challenge everything she thought she knew.
overview_id: Feng Zuoren, pimpinan pasukan rahasia, mendapat perintah untuk menyusup ke keluarga bangsawan dan membasmi sisa pewaris kekaisaran lama. Namun saat berhadapan dengan Xue Hexu, putra keluarga itu, keduanya saling menantang hingga benih cinta tumbuh di antara pertarungan dan tipu daya. Tapi di balik semua itu, ada konspirasi yang jauh lebih besar menunggu untuk terungkap.

overview: Mei Zhuyu, a calm and reserved nobleman from a lesser branch of the Mei family, arrives in Chang'an as an official at the Bureau of Mystic Investigations. During a banquet, he meets Wu Zhen, the bold and unruly younger sister of the Empress and secret Guardian of the Demon Underworld. Both hide their true identities. Wu, a half-demon striving to keep peace, and Mei, a skilled demon slayer, seek the truth behind the fire 18 years ago. As bone demons rise and unrest grows, they fight side by side, forming a bond that deepens into love until the Changxi Palace launches a purge, forcing them to face each other's secrets and the past they share.
The unbelievable true story of a boy once named by the FBI as one of the most dangerous hackers in the world.

A woman with a unique upbringing in a motel in the countryside leaves her hometown at 20 to pursue her career in Seoul. Twelve years later though, she returns home to heal her heart and experiences twists and turns as she reunites with her first love, a now eligible bachelor and veterinarian.

After moving to Ironwood, siblings Caitlyn and Zac Torres are drawn into a thrilling car culture where street racing reigns and high school status is all about your ride. Haunted by their father's dark past, they join forces with loner Curtis and outcast Marcel to rebuild his legendary car.
overview_id: Motorheads: Taruhan Mobil, Taruhan Cinta bercerita soal cinta pertama, patah hati pertama, dan memutar kunci mobil pertamamu. Berlatar belakang kota yang dulu makmur dan kini mencari secercah harapan, serial ini adalah kisah penuh adrenalin tentang sekelompok orang luar yang membentuk persahabatan unik karena kecintaan yang sama akan balap jalanan, sambil menavigasi hierarki dan aturan SMA.

overview: Takashi Mikami, a University of Tokyo graduate, joins the Ministry of Education to reform Japan's education but is disillusioned by its reality. Transferred to a private high school, he takes a stand against the authorities, using his role as a teacher to push for change.
A bodyguard hides in a village as a kindergarten teacher to avoid her boss' enemies – but faces a new challenge in a skeptical strawberry farmer!

Maggie and Alex enjoy a lavish life of privilege as members of one of South Carolina's most powerful legal dynasties. But when their son Paul is involved in a deadly boat crash, the family is faced with a test unlike any they've ever encountered. As details come to light and new challenges emerge, the family's connections to several mysterious deaths raise questions which threaten everything Maggie and Alex hold dear.
Detectives chase leads, prosecutors face defense attorneys, and juries wrestle with decisions.

In a high-tech future, a rogue security robot secretly gains free will. To stay hidden, it reluctantly joins a new mission protecting scientists on a dangerous planet... even though it just wants to binge soap operas.
overview_id: Dalam suatu masa depan futuristis, robot sekuriti pemberontak diam-diam mendapatkan autonomi. Agar tak ketahuan, ia terlibat misi melindungi ilmuwan di planet berbahaya, padahal ia hanya ingin menonton opera sabun.

overview: The domineering CEO, Yi Ning, must marry to inherit her family business. Thus, she chooses a “supportive husband” — the charming private chef, Shen Qianze to start a contract marriage. Following their role reversal, Yi Ning finds herself falling for him. However, little does she know that Shen Qianze harbors a shocking secret. As he deliberately draws closer, she unknowingly surrenders to his love...
overview_id: Yi Ning harus menikah untuk mewarisi bisnis keluarga, jadi ia membuat pernikahan kontrak dengan Shen Qianze, koki tampan yang dianggap suami idaman. Yi Ning bekerja sebagai CEO sedang Shen Qianze jadi bapak rumah tangga. Seiring waktu, perasaan mulai tumbuh. Namun, Qianze menyimpan rahasia besar. Apakah itu?

overview: Gao Feng, a retired tycoon disguised as a delivery man, is hired by CEO Su Qingyan to be her fake husband, unaware he’s the real boss she wants to impersonate. As they enter a contract marriage, their hidden identities and growing feelings complicate everything.
overview_id: Gao Feng, bos besar dunia finansial, menyamar jadi kurir dan pura-pura jadi suami CEO Su Qingyan. Diam-diam, ia pakai kekuasaannya untuk melindungi Su dari berbagai masalah. Meski awalnya hanya sandiwara, benih cinta tumbuh di antara mereka, hingga Su mulai curiga pada identitas asli sang "kurir".

overview: Baek Su-jeong leads a planning team at a renowned department store. She meets her new boss, Ban Ju-yeon, her first love from an online game 16 years ago, stirring up memories of when he confessed his feelings but she rejected him.

Wrongfully accused on her wedding night, Shen Jiangli is forced into an unwanted union and confined. Years later, she returns to the Lu family to save her sick son, uncovering the truth behind her past betrayal. As she fights for justice, she unexpectedly rekindles her love with Lu Jingming, with a little help from their clever son.
overview_id: Malam pernikahan Shen Jiangli berubah jadi aib saat dijebak tidur dengan Lu Jingming, lalu dikurung dan difitnah. Saat melahirkan, nyawanya nyaris melayang—dan kini, demi menyelamatkan anaknya yang sakit keras, ia harus kembali ke rumah Lu untuk mendapatkan obat. Mampukah Ia kembali menghadapi luka pahitnya?

overview: A terminally ill father prepares his chaotic family to care for his two young kids and face life without him — but they must put old quarrels to rest.
overview_id: Seorang ayah yang sakit parah menyiapkan keluarga besarnya untuk merawat dua anaknya dan menjalani hidup tanpanya—tetapi mereka harus berdamai dengan semua masalah lama.

overview: After the Fox Clan is wiped out by Prince Xiling Xuan of Xiling Kingdom, the clan’s sacred maiden Tu Shanyue survives as a wandering soul and possesses the body of the late Empress Jiang Xin'er. Determined to take revenge, she infiltrates the palace—only to uncover a shocking truth that changes everything.
overview_id: Seluruh klan rubah dibantai oleh Pangeran Sayap dari Kerajaan Xiling, Xiling Xuan. Hanya Tushan Yue, sang gadis suci dari klan rubah, yang berhasil mempertahankan sebagian jiwanya. Ia mengejar Xiling Xuan hingga ke istana kerajaan untuk membalas dendam. Jiwa Tushan Yue kemudian bersemayam di tubuh Permaisuri Jiang Xiner, yang meninggal secara misterius. Namun, seiring rencana balas dendamnya berjalan, Tushan Yue perlahan mengungkap sebuah kebenaran mengejutkan yang mengguncang keyakinannya.

overview: A cold-natured engineer falls for his kind senior after she warms him up on a rainy day, sparking a sweet office romance.

Orphaned Zhao Chuxi leaves his mountain village for Jiashi City after losing his loved ones. Determined to honor his guardian Li Chengqian, he navigates a materialistic world, staying true to his values while striving to improve his village and fulfill his dreams.
overview_id: Dibesarkan sebagai yatim piatu di Wan Jing Shan, Zhao Chuxi bertekad mewujudkan impian almarhum ayah angkatnya. Ia meninggalkan desa demi mencari nafkah di kota, tapi justru terseret dalam konflik berbahaya. Ketika segalanya hancur, ia bangkit lebih kuat. Namun, saat kembali ke kota untuk membalas dendam, akankah ia tetap setia pada impian awalnya?

overview: A romantic comedy that follows the story of a top actress who, after reaching the peak of her career and even winning the youngest-ever Best Actress award, suffers an accident and finds herself transported 25 years into the future.
The story of Sun Woo-hae and Sung Je-yun, who reunite after 15 years, struggling and living fiercely in their respective stages.
As SEVENTEEN is getting ready to celebrate their 10th anniversary, SEVENTEEN will be making some unforgettable memories with HOST NA!

When his security company is attacked, Tony and Ziva must go on the run across Europe, try to figure out who is after them and maybe even learn to trust each other again so that they can finally have their unconventional happily ever after.

Beloved Mexican soccer team Club Necaxa strives to reclaim their place as one of Mexico's top teams, while their Mexican-American owner Eva Longoria tries to breathe new life into the team by enlisting the help of her high-profile friends including new co-owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds.

Jae-yoon, a late military enlistee, and his girlfriend, Young-joo, break up over the phone over growing misunderstandings. But a zombie outbreak rocks the world. A national emergency is declared, a plane crashes in the city center, and Jae-yoon and his unit get trapped on top of a Seoul skyscraper. Young-joo risks the zombie-filled streets to find him. Can their love survive the apocalypse?

A hateful romance between a professional detective actor who wants to become a melodrama master and a female reporter who was demoted from a political reporter who won the Reporter of the Year award to the entertainment department.
Ten years after discovering her murdered uncle, Ena and Detective Hansaem must cooperate to stop a series of similar murders - each linked by strange puzzle pieces.

One phone call was enough to shatter one's entire world. For unknown actress So Min, everything collapses when a voice phishing scam tears her family apart. She is thrust into the darkest side of technology as her missing mother, father's death, and even the stolen voice of her late mother become weapons in a shocking scheme. With nothing left but the will to take revenge, she turns to deepfake technology as her ultimate weapon, infiltrating a vast and merciless syndicate. Along the way, she encounters Ma Seok Gu, a ruthless boss hungry for power, Jeong Hun, a cop torn between truth and loyalty, and Do Jin, a hacker with a sinister smile. Plunging into a web of betrayal and danger with the fake identities she forges, will she exact vengeance, or will they destroy her?
A mother faces stigma and a painful separation when her husband takes their children abroad, forever changing her life.
overview_id: Seorang ibu menghadapi stigma dan perpisahan nan pedih saat suaminya membawa anak-anak mereka ke luar negeri, yang mengubah hidupnya selamanya. Terinspirasi kisah nyata.

overview: From Italy, Germany and the UK to Senegal, South Korea and Borneo, Antoni takes celebs on epic journeys to explore their ancestral and culinary roots.

A mismatched legal duo uncovers hidden contradictions in a high school girl's murder case while confronting parallel evidence tampering, as an unyielding prosecutor dismantles a web of judicial deceit.

The story revolves around several boys and girls who grew up together along the canal, after leaving to make their own growth, reunite after many years. After experiencing competition and the pressures of life, they rediscover the hope for a new life.
overview_id: Drama ini bercerita mengenai beberapa anak laki-laki dan perempuan yang tumbuh bersama di tepi kanal, dan bersatu kembali setelah bertahun-tahun meninggalkan tepi kanal tempat mereka dibesarkan. Setelah menghadapi persaingan dan tekanan hidup, mereka mendapatkan kembali harapan untuk kehidupan baru. Melalui para remaja Jiangnan ini: kita tidak hanya melihat pertumbuhan mereka, namun juga merasakan perubahan sejarah Grand Canal dari yang perkembangannya terhenti sampai bangkit kembali menuju kehidupan baru selama seratus tahun terakhir; membuat kita mengapresiasi budaya kanal Tiongkok yang beragam yang terus berkembang di Tiongkok.

overview: Young singles spend ten days in a foreign country, relying on fate alone to fall in love. Without any digital devices, will they be able to find the one?
overview_id: Para lajang muda yang berada di negeri asing selama sepuluh hari ini hanya mengandalkan takdir untuk jatuh cinta. Mampukah mereka menemukan cinta tanpa perangkat digital?

overview: No Mu-jin is a labor attorney who happens to see ghosts. After coming back from the brink of death, he begins solving labor problems requested by ghosts.
Nihal's affluent life comes under threat when a self-made tycoon with an eye for money — and an even sharper one for love — shakes up Istanbul's elite.

After losing her family, Shen Qingtang is taken in by the powerful Pei family and raised as the heir Pei Congzhi’s adopted sister. Enduring years of mistreatment and emotional manipulation, she decides to escape the oppressive household and the dangerous bond with Pei Congzhi, determined to take control of her own fate.
overview_id: Shen Qingtang, yang keluarganya hancur saat dia masih muda, diasuh oleh Pei Congzhi, putra tertua dari keluarga Marquis Chengping, dan menjadi putri angkat di keluarga Pei, hidup sebagai saudara perempuannya. Selama bertahun-tahun, dia mengalami perlakuan tidak adil dan penindasan. Dengan tekanan terus-menerus dari keluarga Pei, Shen Qingtang memutuskan untuk meninggalkan Pei Congzhi, dan melarikan diri dari kehidupan yang penuh bahaya dan ketidakpastian...

overview: A former model student, pushed by domestic abuse and bullying, joins a group that stands up to school violence and defends its victims.

After a career-ending injury, Taekwondo star Zhiyao falls into gambling and is forced to become a prison administrator, tasked with overseeing the notorious boss Chihuahua under the watchful eye of instructor Jiang Yijie. Amid the harsh, absurd conditions, Zhiyao and his colleagues form bonds of friendship, trust, and love, finding meaning and resilience in their challenging work.
An interior designer has a one-sided crush on her former college senior – but his best friend is secretly in love with her.
A director with no future and an actress with no tomorrow fall into a love story that cannot wait.
Twin sisters, whose similarities end with their looks, swap identities amid personal struggles — embarking on a journey to rediscover love and life.

From the battlefields of World War I to the rugged Highlands of 18th century Scotland, two fated couples must defy the forces that seek to tear them apart, unfolding in surprising and unforeseen ways in this romantic saga that unfolds across time.
Struggling in poverty, Elina fights to overcome life's obstacles with the help of two men who love her.
The tranquility in a serene, wealthy community inhabited by some of the world's most prominent individuals explodes when a shocking murder occurs and a high stakes investigation unfolds.
Global sports and entertainment superstars Jake and Logan Paul are pulling back the curtain for their latest venture: a family reality TV show.

Pehli Barish is a story of love that spans generations, a tale of joy, longing, and heartbreak that seems to repeat itself.

Years ago in Lahore, strangers Behzad and Maleeha met and a spark of love lit between them. But fate had other plans and tore them apart, leaving hearts scarred.

Decades later, Behzad lives a settled life with a family, yet the past never truly leaves him. His son, Maani, falls for Nimra and the shadows of old heartbreak loom large. As Behzad watches history threatening to repeat itself, he must face his own past to protect Maani and perhaps confront the love he lost long ago.

Will Maleeha return to Behzad’s life? Will Behzad save his son from the same heartbreak he experienced? Can Maani and Nimra’s love win against all odds?

In the bustling capital of Bianjing during the Northern Song Dynasty, Madam Li moves her family in search of better marriage prospects for her five beautiful but quirky daughters, whose love lives have long been her worry. Each daughter, though famous for her beauty and wit, comes with unique quirks: the eldest, Shou Hua, has no interest in remarrying after early widowhood; the third, Kang Ning, is fierce and headstrong; the fourth, Hao De, is well-meaning but blunt; and the youngest, Le Shan, is spoiled and selective.  Challenges abound as they face unexpected setbacks, including a cold reception from the already-married sister they came to visit. As the family reestablishes their business, they navigate a series of humorous and heartwarming misadventures, ultimately finding love and fulfilling their mother’s hopes in this lively tale of family and romance.

After scheming her way to the throne and meeting a tragic end, Bai Xiyue is reborn as her former sister, Bai Xiyao. Now facing her younger, ruthless past self, she must endure the very schemes she once orchestrated, seek redemption, and navigate the complexities of love and fate.
overview_id: Bai Xiyue, putri selir dari Kediaman Menteri, terkenal licik dan ambisius. Ia menjebak dan membunuh kakaknya, Bai Xiyao, putri sah dari istri utama, lalu merebut hati Adipati Yun Yichen hingga akhirnya naik tahta menjadi permaisuri. Namun, pada hari penobatannya, ia tewas karena racun. Bai Xiyue terlahir Kembali dalam tubuh kakaknya sendiri, Bai Xiyao. Dengan seluruh ingatan masa lalunya, ia kini harus menghadapi versi muda dari dirinya sendiri: kejam, penuh siasat, dan tanpa belas kasihan. Segala trik yang dulu ia gunakan, kini menimpa dirinya. Di kehidupan barunya, Bai Xiyue harus menjaga diri dengan bijak, menebus dosa, dan menghadapi konflik cinta yang rumit.

overview: After being betrayed and killed in a fire, Princess Sheng Yunlin is reborn and sets out to reclaim her power. Using her wit and courage, she gathers allies, exposes corruption, and seeks justice for her family, all while navigating a dangerous love with the proud Grand Tutor Xie Fei amid courtly intrigue and political battles.
overview_id: Ia adalah Putri Agung yang sangat berkuasa, tetapi dikhianati oleh orang yang paling ia cintai hingga tewas terbakar. Setelah terlahir kembali, pria yang dulu ia cintai kini tunduk di bawah kekuasaannya, sementara seorang pangeran dari negeri musuh rela menjadi alat rahasianya. Dianggap permaisuri sebagai musuh yang ditakdirkan, ia kembali bukan hanya untuk merebut kekuasaan, tetapi juga seluruh negeri. Jika dulu ia bermain dengan cinta, kini ia mengendalikan segalanya dengan kekuasaan. Cinta dan dendamnya akan menjadi jalan menuju mahkota.

overview: Elite athletes from eight countries battle for national pride. After grueling tests of raw strength and endurance, only one flag can claim victory.
overview_id: Atlet-atlet elite dari 8 negara bersaing demi kebanggaan bangsa. Setelah melewati ujian kekuatan dan ketahanan sejati yang berat, cuma satu negara yang akan jadi juara.

overview: Cui Ye is an ordinary Go teacher whose life spirals into chaos after an accidental entanglement in a crime. As he gradually descends into illegality, his police officer brother, Cui Wei, relentlessly pursues him.
overview_id: Menceritakan hidup seorang guru Go biasa, Cui Ye, yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam sebuah kasus kriminal. Perlahan, ia terjerat dalam dunia kejahatan, sementara sang kakak, Cui Wei, seorang polisi, tak henti mengejarnya. Bisakah saudara ini bertemu di jalan yang sama?

overview: When Joni was 14, her best friend Gracie Darling disappeared during a séance. Some 27 years on, the local kids in a small town get their kicks with a game of 'Playing Gracie Darling' – but the seemingly innocent game turns sinister when another girl disappears. Joni, by then a child psychologist, returns to the town and partners with a police sergeant Jay to uncover the truth, while Gracie's sister Ruth faces a mother's worst nightmare when her own daughter vanishes under hauntingly similar circumstances.
Three women, each facing troubled marriages, unite after one confesses to killing her husband, leading them on a path of revenge and self-discovery as they fight to reclaim their happiness.
The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.
overview_id: Orang paling menyedihkan di Bumi harus menyelamatkan dunia dari kebahagiaan.

overview: In Rong City, the elite Mobile Squad of the Criminal Investigation Division takes on a series of high-profile cases—from a staged celebrity suicide to a complex drug operation. No matter how cunning the criminals, the detectives’ keen instincts always reveal the truth.
overview_id: Di tengah hiruk-pikuk kota Rongcheng, berdiri Unit Gerak Cepat, tim taktis elit di bawah Divisi Investigasi Kriminal. Mereka selalu menjadi yang pertama tiba di setiap TKP — mulai dari kasus bunuh diri selebritas yang mencurigakan, perampokan besar yang direncanakan dengan sempurna, hingga penggerebekan sarang narkoba yang tersembunyi rapat. Bahkan ketika penjahat menyiapkan jebakan dan tipu daya, para detektif Unit Gerak Cepat selalu mampu membongkar kebenaran dengan ketajaman insting dan strategi mereka.

overview: A brilliant math student is on the verge of a major breakthrough when a shadowy enemy tries to stop him. Fighting for answers—and his life—he teams up with a government agent to unravel a high-stakes conspiracy.
overview_id: Seorang matematikawan muda brilian berada di ambang terobosan besar ketika dia menyadari musuh misterius mencoba menghancurkan idenya. Bersama dengan agen pemerintah yang telah melacaknya, dia mulai mengungkap konspirasi yang mengganggu.

overview: After being betrayed by the man she gave everything up for, Dongfang Xi, a wealthy heiress, discovers she's the villainess in a novel and makes a deal with a mysterious system to change her fate—only to find that the system itself hides a long-buried secret of love.
overview_id: Dongfang Xi menyembunyikan identitas dan bekerja demi Ye Yunzhou, tapi dikhianati. Menyadari dirinya hanya tokoh antagonis novel, ia bertaruh dengan sistem untuk mengubah takdir. Di pesta keluarga, ia membongkar Ye Yunzhou dan menemukan kakaknya, Dongfang Yan, ternyata jelmaan sistem. Apa yang kelanjutan yang menanti Dongfang Xi?

overview: When a respected judge's world falls apart overnight, he joins a top law firm's pro bono team — where hope and purpose wait in humble, unexpected places.
A smug TV host and a small-town ufologist work to uncover the origins of an alleged UFO sighting, splitting the nation in a storm of doubts and beliefs.
A group of ER residents navigate medical crises and personal drama amid a divisive allegation at their Miami hospital.
overview_id: Sekelompok residen IGD menghadapi krisis medis dan drama pribadi di tengah tuduhan yang memecah belah di rumah sakit mereka yang berlokasi di Miami.

overview: In the tenth year of the Zhanghe era, rebellious crown prince Xia Qiguang is sent to study under the scholar Mo Wang, unaware that his teacher is the legendary general Mo Qingchuan in disguise. As they bond through trust and sacrifice, they fight to restore honor to fallen heroes and protect their kingdom.
overview_id: Pada tahun ke-10 Zhanghe, secara kebetulan Xia Qiguang diatur oleh ayahnya, Raja Jing, untuk berguru pada Mo Wang. Sang Pangeran awalnya meremehkan guru yang disebut-sebut sebagai guru terbaik di dunia. Namun, ia sangat mengagumi Mo Qingchuan, seorang jenderal wanita yang melindungi keluarga dan negara. Tanpa diketahuinya, Mo Wang yang ada di hadapannya tak lain adalah Mo Qingchuan itu sendiri. Dalam proses saling menyelamatkan dan melindungi, guru dan murid ini membangun kembali Pasukan Mo. Mereka memulai perjalanan untuk mengembalikan kehormatan pasukan pahlawan ini.

overview: Five women face extreme situations that will unleash their rage.

Heiress Bu Yan disappears after a fateful night with boxer He Yuchen. Six years later, she returns with twin children and reunites with He Yuchen, whose career has been derailed by scandal. To save her son, they enter a contract marriage, but their bond deepens as they work together to uncover dark secrets from their past.

After discovering his wife's betrayal, a straight-laced husband dives into the hidden world of paid intimacy as a twisted act of revenge. Clueless and out of his depth, he stumbles through misadventures that mix awkward hilarity with raw self-discovery - forcing him to question his notions of love, manhood, and morality.
Passions run deep in a small Texas town, as three ranching dynasties fight for their land, their legacies and the people they love.
overview_id: Hasrat menggelora di sebuah kota kecil di Texas saat tiga dinasti peternakan bertarung demi tanah, warisan, serta orang-orang yang mereka cintai.

overview: A modern deliveryman Li Chengyu is transported to ancient times, where he disguises himself as a farmer to investigate rebels, becoming the son-in-law of village chief Chen Xinrou and unexpectedly finding love while using his modern knowledge to turn the tides.
SI Vetri investigates a medical team that is trying to cover up deaths of clinical trial participants by staging them as accidents. Can Vetri put an end to this sinister plot before it's too late?

15-year-old Qian Jiayue enters a prestigious high school and faces academic challenges while navigating friendships and family dynamics. As she bonds with her new friend Chen Mo, both girls grow through their shared experiences. Meanwhile, their families grapple with life changes and generational conflicts, but the warmth of family and community support remains unchanged.
overview_id: Qian Jiayue, gadis 15 tahun yang patuh, memulai masa SMA dengan cinta bertepuk sebelah tangan pada tetangganya, Xiao Han. Ia berteman dengan Chen Mo yang pemberani, di tengah konflik dalam keluarganya. Tiga generasi perempuan dalam keluarganya berjuang dengan masalah, kehilangan, dan rekonsiliasi. Mampukah Ia menjaga kehangatan dalam hidupnya?

overview: First-year OBGYN residents at Yulje Medical Center navigate the chaos of their work and personal lives, all in their quest to become exceptional doctors.

Lu Ming and Xu Xin’s marriage weakens over time due to daily conflicts. After Xu Xin falls into a coma from a car accident, Lu Ming discovers her novel about an idealized husband, forcing him to confront his shortcomings and regret his past mistakes.
overview_id: Xu Xin jatuh koma setelah kecelakaan, menyisakan Lu Ming dengan sebuah novel yang penuh rahasia hatinya. Saat membaca, ia menyadari cinta yang dulu ia abaikan. Ia pun menulis ulang kisah mereka, namun apakah kenyataan akan berakhir seindah itu…?

overview: Yu Chuxin's once-happy marriage is shattered by betrayal, leaving her devastated and on the brink of death. Determined to seek justice, she fakes selective amnesia, pretending to remember only the early days of her marriage. Returning to the Zhou family, she carefully gathers evidence to bring those who wronged her to justice.

Heiress Ye Haimeng returns under a new identity to unravel the dark secrets behind her arranged marriage to the powerful Lu family. But when she crosses paths with the mysterious second son, Lu Siyu, their twisted fates spark a dangerous romance neither of them saw coming.
overview_id: Xu Haimeng, pewaris Grup Yunhai, mengalami kecelakaan tragis saat berbulan madu namun berhasil selamat dan kembali untuk merebut kendali perusahaannya. Hal ini membuatnya berhadapan dengan keluarga Lu, terutama Lu Siyu, putra kedua yang menyelidiki identitasnya dan kematian sang kakak. Dari pertarungan penuh intrik dan pengungkapan kebenaran mengejutkan, Xu Haimeng dan Lu Siyu yang awalnya bermusuhan perlahan saling bergantung. Namun rahasia kelam keluarga Lu kembali mengguncang segalanya, memaksa keduanya menghadapi pengkhianatan, merebut Yunhai, dan akhirnya menapaki jalan baru bersama.

overview: After his family is massacred, Li Jianwei hides as a courtesan to seek revenge while drawing dangerously close to his unsuspecting target.
overview_id: Pada malam Tahun Baru Imlek, keluarga Jenderal Li dibantai, hanya Li Jianwei yang selamat. Ia menyamar dan menyusup ke Lembah Hantu untuk balas dendam, lalu berteman dengan pewaris lembah, Chen Xiaoxi. Saat rencananya berjalan lancar, Jianwei menemukan bahwa musuhnya adalah Pasukan Zhongyong, prajurit setia yang difitnah dua dekade lalu. Kebenaran masa lalu mengguncang keyakinannya, memaksanya memilih antara dendam, kebenaran, dan takdir.

overview: Lin Suisui is transported into the broken plot of My Fair Princess and becomes a maid in the Empress’s palace. To return home, she must fix the story, while unexpected complications from a mysterious guard threaten to derail everything.

On one miraculous day in rural Wisconsin, the recently deceased suddenly rise from their graves. But this is no zombie story, as the 'revived' appear and act just like they once were. When local officer and single mother Dana Cypress is unexpectedly thrown into the center of a brutal murder mystery of her own, she's left to make sense of the chaos amidst a town gripped by fear and confusion where everyone, alive or undead, is a suspect.
In New York City, four strangers navigate life's challenges while their separate paths unexpectedly intertwine in ways that change them forever.

After being wronged by a false accusation, gifted healer Rong Zelan enters the imperial palace determined to break into the male-dominated Imperial Medical Bureau. Defying ridicule and prejudice, she proves her brilliance in medicine within the palace—turning her struggles into an inspiring story of courage, justice, and equality on her journey to become the empire’s first female official.
overview_id: Dituduh tanpa alasan dan menjadi korban ketidakadilan, Rong Zelan bertekad menembus lingkaran kekuasaan istana demi membuktikan kemampuannya di dunia medis yang dikuasai para pria. Meski diremehkan oleh tabib-tabib istana, keahliannya membuatnya bangkit melawan segala rintangan. Ia berhasil menyembuhkan Putra Mahkota, menyelamatkan Permaisuri Agung, hingga menghentikan wabah mematikan. Pencapaiannya menjadikannya pejabat perempuan pertama dalam dinasti itu—memimpin para pria yang dulu meremehkannya, sekaligus menorehkan kisah legendaris tentang seorang perempuan yang berani menulis takdirnya sendiri.

overview: The story of János Hunyadi is the epic tale of a hero born into modest circumstances, who, in 1456, with relentless determination and against all odds, vanquished the much larger Ottoman army, halting its drive to conquer the Vatican and overrun Western Europe. In so doing, Hunyadi not only shaped the history of Hungary, but that of all Europe.

Xu Cheng, a devoted housewife, battles severe sleep disorders and hallucinations, leading to disturbing behavior. When a tragic car accident strikes, her husband, Lu Yan, survives—but Xu Cheng mysteriously vanishes. As the truth unfolds, hidden secrets come to light, exposing the cracks in their seemingly perfect marriage.

A modern reimagining of the classic tale. After the Norman invasion of England, Rob, a Saxon forester’s son, and Marian, a Norman lord’s daughter, fall in love and unite to fight for justice, challenge corruption, and restore peace to the land.

Tang Xin and Lan Yangyang, two very different women, fall for military officers Wu Si and Zong Qing and navigate the complexities of love, marriage, and life in the military. As they face career conflicts, emotional challenges, and personal growth, they discover the strength and devotion it takes to stand by the ones they love.
overview_id: Tang Xin, wanita mandiri yang menghindari pernikahan, bertemu Wu Si, tentara disiplin yang hidupnya teratur melalui kencan buta. Meskipun mereka berdua tampak tidak cocok dan sangat bertolak belakang, namun setelah melewati banyak lika-liku yang tidak terduga, keduanya malah jadi semakin dekat. Akankah cinta mereka bertahan di tengah perbedaan dan dunia militer yang keras?

overview: In 1929 Shanghai, a string of brutal murders targeting showgirls uncovers a dark conspiracy tied to a powerful underground network. A forensic doctor, a sharp-witted detective, and the owner of a lavish dance hall form an unlikely alliance to expose the truth, risking everything to shine a light on the city's darkest secrets.
overview_id: Ceritanya tentang tiga anak muda dengan profesi dan kepribadian yang sangat berbeda, yang dipertemukan oleh serangkaian kasus pembunuhan berantai yang aneh. Mereka bersama-sama mengungkap konspirasi besar di balik Zhuquetang.

overview: After a grave illness, a media mogul discovers his children's tactics threaten the empire he carefully built — and he'll do whatever it takes to save it.

After a mysterious accident, Xiao Ning finds himself transported into another world as the live-in son-in-law of the powerful Su family. Using ancient techniques to revolutionize tea and wine, he uses his sharp wit and strategies to quickly rise to prominence.
overview_id: Setelah kecelakaan aneh, Xiao Ning terlempar ke masa lalu dan jadi menantu yang diremehkan. Dengan keahliannya, ia menciptakan teh dan anggur luar biasa, membangun surat kabar pertama, dan membantu putri kerajaan naik pangkat. Dari hinaan, ia bangkit jadi tokoh besar yang mengubah sejarah.

overview: A modern office worker is transported to the past as a noble princess, only to face disdain from everyone, including her cold husband, Prince Ling. After discovering she’s implicated in the death of Prince Ling’s mother, she uses creativity and wit to clear her name. Introducing murder mystery games to aid the investigation, she and Prince Ling team up to uncover the truth, forging an unexpected bond along the way.
overview_id: Seorang pekerja kantoran modern terlempar ke masa lalu dan menjadi seorang putri bangsawan. Namun, semua orang membencinya, termasuk suaminya, Pangeran Ling. Setelah beberapa kali dijebak, ia sadar bahwa "penjahatnya" adalah dirinya sendiri dan bahkan dicurigai dalang kematian ibu Pangeran Ling! Bersama sang pangeran, ia pun mencari kebenaran.

overview: A reformed party girl must prove herself as a businesswoman when she's unexpectedly put in charge of her family's pro basketball team.
overview_id: Seorang gadis yang tadinya gemar berpesta harus membuktikan kehebatannya sebagai pebisnis saat ia tiba-tiba ditugasi mengurus tim basket profesional keluarganya.

overview: A young woman with the ability to see mysterious red connections between lovers discovers her secret gift is no longer unique when special glasses granting similar powers appear on the black market.
Ameena is determined to take revenge after finding out about her husband's affair with her best friend, without realizing it will destroy them.

Warlord Helian Zheng returns to avenge his mother’s death by capturing his stepfather and forcing his beloved stepsister, He Anran, into marriage. Meanwhile, Mo Yutang, once close to him but left crippled by his actions, reappears, hiding deep resentment behind his graceful facade. As love and revenge intertwine, their fates take a dramatic turn.
overview_id: Helian Zheng sangat mencintai saudara tirinya, He Anran, tetapi ia menyaksikan ayah He memenjarakan ibunya hingga meninggal. Lima tahun kemudian, Helian Zheng kembali sebagai komandan militer, dan ia menangkap ayah tirinya dan memaksa saudara tirinya untuk menikah dengannya demi membalaskan dendam ibunya.

overview: A mysterious man appears before six individuals, each struggling with their own issues, as an impending disaster disrupts their lives, unraveling suspense and psychological tension.
Four overlooked housewives, weighed down by daily chores and ignored by those around them, find renewed purpose by solving everyday cases—reclaiming their voices and reigniting long-forgotten dreams.

Emotionless Andromedan mother-daughter Cai Xiaoying and Li Lili, who parted ways on Earth, are forced to reconnect when Li marries human Meng for an interstellar survey. Cai, broke and demanding room and board, joins them, forming a snarky family with Meng’s ditzy dad, navigating hilarity and trials.
overview_id: Cai Xiao Ying dan Li Li Li, ibu–anak dari galaksi Andromeda yang hidup tanpa emosi, sudah bertahun-tahun tak bertegur sapa di Bumi. Namun saat Li menikahi pria Bumi bernama Meng demi misi survei antargalaksi, Cai yang bangkrut tiba-tiba datang menumpang. Bersama ayah Meng yang sama kocaknya, keluarga campur aduk ini harus hidup serumah dan kekacauan pun tak terhindarkan!

overview: In Jiangcheng, the prestigious incense-making family is betrayed by their steward. Orphaned Lin Wanyue returns years later, seeking revenge, and joins forces with the steward’s son, Zhang Hanyi. Together, they rise from humble beginnings to confront their enemies and fate.

Fifty years ago, the sudden emergence of spiritual energy within jadeite gave rise to families of superpowered individuals. After his clan is wiped out for their rare ability to sense jade aura, young Meng Yan escapes with a mysterious girl, Xiao Duo. Years later, he returns with newfound powers to seek revenge, igniting an epic clash between two generations of gifted beings.
overview_id: Lima puluh tahun lalu, energi misterius muncul dari batu giok dan melahirkan manusia berkekuatan khusus. Keluarga Meng yang mampu merasakannya dibantai habis, hanya menyisakan Meng Yan. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, setelah menguasai kekuatannya, ia memulai misi balas dendam yang mengguncang dua generasi.

overview: A woman who was born and raised in a family of alcoholics escaping from her drunkenness meets a man who believes alcohol is not a cure but an anesthetic.

Project Azure-1, a high-profile scientific endeavor, becomes the target of sabotage by the foreign spy agency SAD and a group controlled by Gapung, aiming to steal its technology. National security officer Huo Min and his team race to stop the sabotage and bring the conspirators to justice.
overview_id: Proyek riset "Weilan No.1" menarik perhatian dunia. Namun, kelompok mata-mata SAD dan organisasi misterius dari negara musuh mencoba merebut teknologi rahasia ini. Dapatkah Huo Min dan tim keamanan nasional menggagalkan semuanya sebelum terlambat...?

overview: From black ops and bizarre experiments to deadly cover-ups and nefarious gadgets, David Duchovny pulls the curtain back on all the government secrets in modern history we always suspected, but were never given the answers to.

Over two extraordinary years, National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovered never-before-filmed secret traditions, surprising intelligence and close-knit societies of penguins. This astonishing series reveals they are more like us than we ever dreamed, from their powerful friendships to the courageous risk-takers using ingenuity and innovation in some of the world's most extreme places.
Revealing how the monarchy uses traditions to maintain a place in the British nation's identity.

With over 125 million reads on Wattpad, this hit story follows Alys, a bubbly girl who agrees to seduce the mysterious Drake Palma to help her best friend. But as their pretend relationship starts to feel real, Alys is torn between loyalty and unexpected love.

Jian Mingshu, the daughter of the Jian family, loses her memory after a fall and is saved by her beloved, Lu Shang. They travel to the capital for their studies, where Jian Mingshu uncovers clues about her identity. With Lu Shang's silent support, their bond deepens as they face challenges together, leading to a lasting relationship.
overview_id: Kehilangan ingatan setelah jatuh dari tebing, Jian Ming Shu lolos dari tragedi yang menimpa keluarganya dan mendapat perlindungan dari Lu Chang, kekasihnya. Namun, misteri identitasnya mulai terungkap seiring waktu. Apakah ia akan menemukan jati diri sebenarnya?

overview: The peaceful city of Luzhou is shaken by a series of so-called justice-driven murders. To crack the case, authorities form the 909 Task Force, which works tirelessly to unravel the layers of the chilling exchange-killing revenge scheme.
overview_id: Kota Luzhou diguncang kasus pembunuhan berantai yang mengatasnamakan menegakkan keadilan. Polisi membentuk Tim Khusus 909 untuk menyelidiki. Perlahan, mereka mengungkap rencana tukar-bunuh yang mengerikan…

overview: Answers discovered through endless questioning, never-ending challenges and performances, and the stories shared with CARATs. This 10th-anniversary documentary series captures SEVENTEEN's candid stories.

In 1930s Shanghai, detective Guan Cen and university student Lu Yizhen, meet during an investigation into a mysterious death at a women’s dormitory. Two years later, Lu Yizhen becomes one of Shanghai’s first female police officers, working directly under Guan Cen. Together, they reopen an unresolved child kidnapping case, uncovering hidden truths and confronting the shadows of the past.
overview_id: Pada awal tahun 1930-an, sebuah kasus kematian misterius yang menimpa seorang mahasiswi di asrama perempuan terjadi di Shanghai. Inspektur Kantor Polisi Pusat, Guan Cen, kemudian berkenalan dengan Lu Yizhen, seorang mahasiswi yang gemar membaca novel detektif. Pertemuan itu tanpa sengaja menyeret mereka ke dalam kasus penculikan anak perempuan yang terjadi tujuh belas tahun sebelumnya.\NDua tahun kemudian, Lu Yizhen mengikuti seleksi untuk menjadi salah satu anggota angkatan pertama polisi wanita di Shanghai, sementara Guan Cen menjadi atasan langsungnya. Di kantor polisi yang terus menghadapi berbagai kasus, keduanya bekerja sama membuka kembali penyelidikan kasus penculikan anak itu, menyingkap kabut dan mimpi buruk yang selama ini menyelimuti mereka.

overview: General Li Shuang of Taijin finds a man who has lost his memory and names him Jin'an. Jin'an devotes himself to accompanying Li Shuang; however, as he gradually regains his memories, he discovers that he is actually a prince from an enemy nation. Once bound by love, the two are forced into battle. Together, they confront challenges that test their loyalties and beliefs, striving to resolve the conflict and uphold the justice they both believe in.
overview_id: Drama ini menceritakan tentang Li Shuang, seorang jenderal wanita dari Dinasti Jin yang secara kebetulan menemukan seorang pria yang hilang ingatan, kemudian menamainya Jin An. Jin An dengan sepenuh hati menemani Li Shuang, dan benih-benih cinta pun tumbuh di antara mereka. Namun, tanpa diduga, Jin An secara bertahap mulai mengingat identitas aslinya: ia adalah seorang pangeran dari kerajaan musuh. Kedua insan yang pernah berjanji untuk menghabiskan hidup bersama ini kini terpaksa berhadapan di medan perang. Karena sudah sama-sama lelah dengan peperangan, mereka memutuskan untuk bekerja sama dalam menyelesaikan krisis dan mempertahankan keadilan dalam hati mereka.

overview: An action noir about the life of Cha Woo-sol, who was born again after meeting martial arts champion Jeong Do-hyeon in a juvenile prison.

After being betrayed and killed by her best friend and powerful elites, Jiang Leyao is reborn with memories of her tragic past. Determined to take revenge, she discovers her friend has also been reborn and taken her place in a wealthy marriage. As Jiang Leyao begins her counterattack, she realizes her enemy is backed by an even greater force, complicating her path to justice.
overview_id: Jiang Leyao dikhianati dan mati tragis setelah menikah ke keluarga kaya. Tapi ia terbangun di masa lalu! Kali ini, sahabatnya merebut tempatnya sebagai pengantin elit. Namun Leyao tak akan diam—ia kembali untuk membalas dendam dan mengungkap rahasia besar di balik semua ini.

overview: In Luoyang, a string of murders targeting young women throws the city into turmoil. Dali Temple official Hu Zhengyi is tasked with uncovering the truth, while young martial artist Li Jianxing, seeking to solve his family’s massacre, approaches Hu Zhengyi with hidden motives. Together, they unravel chilling mysteries, transforming from wary strangers to loyal allies in a high-stakes quest for justice.
overview_id: Serangkaian pembunuhan mengejutkan terjadi di kota Luoyang dengan korban para gadis muda. Hu Zhengyi dari Dali Temple ditugaskan menyelidiki, sementara pemuda Li Jianxing mendekatinya untuk mengungkap tragedi keluarganya. Bersama teman-teman baru, mereka menghadapi kasus misterius penuh bahaya dan rahasia.

overview: Mickey Fox investigates criminal activity and patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.
Matt is a stubborn, widowed owner of a classic car restoration shop. When Matt's estranged daughter Riley and her teenage kids move into his house, the real restoration begins.
A comic drama that tells the story of CEO Shin, who mediates disputes for people who are on the edge of a cliff with a 0% chance of winning.

Her heart was anchored in an unrequited love, while the one who truly saw her from the beginning waited in the wings. A tale of a fateful first encounter that changes everything—and a second chance at a love that was always meant to be.
overview_id: Nie Xiguang, gadis ceria yang baru lulus kuliah, pernah memendam cinta pada pria dingin dan genius, Zhuang Xu. Namun, di dunia kerja, ia malah bertemu Lin Yusen, mantan dokter yang kini sukses di industri tenaga surya. Meski awalnya salah paham, Lin Yusen tak bisa menahan pesona Nie Xiguang. Tapi, benarkah cinta ini takkan berujung luka?

overview: Jiang Si, the fourth lady of Dongping Bo Mansion, is reborn after dying at the hands of her lover, Yu Jin. Determined to rewrite her fate, she breaks off her engagement, outsmarts her cruel aunt, opens a perfumery, and investigates a series of mysterious crimes. She reunites with Yu Jin, and despite their unresolved past, they join forces to change tragic destinies—saving her siblings and clearing her father’s name. As they overcome hardships together, Jiang Si’s feelings for Yu Jin rekindle, and they work hand in hand to protect the peace of the Zhou dynasty, embracing a lifetime of prosperity.
overview_id: Jiang Si diberikan kesempatan kedua untuk hidup setelah mati di tangan kekasihnya, Yu Jin. Dengan berani mundur dari pernikahan yang dipaksakan Ia berniat mengubah nasib kelam keluarganya. Saat Jiang Si bertemu kembali dengan Yu Jin, apakah mereka mampu mengubah takdir yang telah ditentukan?

overview: In the final days of the Chinese Civil War, Communist agents Wu Shi and Zhu Feng go undercover in Taiwan to gather vital military intelligence. Sacrificing their personal lives for their mission, they risk everything to aid the liberation of key islands until a betrayal jeopardizes their lives.
overview_id: Film ini berlatar Taiwan tahun 1949 saat bayang-bayang Teror Putih menyelimuti. Kisahnya mengikuti Jenderal Wu Shi, pejabat tinggi KMT yang diam-diam menjadi agen khusus “Agen No. 1,” bekerja sama dengan kurir Zhu Feng untuk menyelundupkan intelijen militer penting demi reunifikasi Tiongkok. Namun, pengkhianatan dan jebakan musuh menggagalkan perjuangan mereka. Meski disiksa hingga buta sebelah, Wu Shi tetap setia tanpa membuka rahasia, hingga akhirnya ia dan rekan-rekannya berkorban jiwa dengan gagah berani, meninggalkan warisan pengabdian dan keberanian abadi di Taiwan.

overview: He Ruoxian, Feng Baichuan, and the Shen brothers navigate wartime struggles in finance, espionage, and material transport in Macau during World War II. Though untouched by Japanese occupation, Macau becomes a crucial battleground where they courageously fight for the nation.
Worried about her sister's too-close relationship with her billionaire boss, a scrappy everywoman seeks answers at a lavish seaside estate.
overview_id: Seorang wanita biasa nan agresif mencari jawaban di sebuah rumah mewah di tepi pantai karena khawatir akan kedekatan saudarinya dengan sang atasan yang kaya raya.

overview: The Hummer Commandos, an elite SWAT team in Binjiang City, fights crime and protects the community. Highly skilled and dedicated, they patrol streets, conduct high-risk arrests, and face danger head-on, serving as a symbol of safety and security.

Set in post-revolution China, the He family faces challenges after the passing of their father, He Changsheng. With six daughters navigating love, work, and life’s ups and downs, their shared strength and unity help them uncover the true meaning of family.

Sixth Sense is back with a 'city tour'! Armed with even stronger 'intuition', the NEW Six Sense members will go on a city tour that only selects 'hot' places in the city! From 30-year-old best friends Yoo Jae-suk X Song Eun-i to variety show gems Go Kyung-pyo X Mimi! The four legendary talkers of Korea will embark on a trip to find fakes in the city!
After a scandal threatens her career, manga artist Wei Zhi escapes to a ski resort, where she meets instructor Shan Chong and begins to heal.
When an arson investigator begrudgingly teams up with a police detective, their race to stop two arsonists ignites a twisted game of secrets and suspicions.
overview_id: Saat penyelidik pembakaran terpaksa membantu detektif polisi, perlombaan untuk menghentikan dua pembakar memicu permainan penuh rahasia dan kecurigaan.

overview: A captivating romance unfolds between a confident, cat-like woman and a bold, loyal younger man. As they navigate their differences, they find mutual healing and redemption, leading to a passionate, fate-driven love story full of tension and desire.
overview_id: Seorang wanita mandiri dengan aura dingin bertemu pria yang lebih muda, hangat dan penuh ketulusan. Keduanya sama-sama menyimpan luka masa lalu yang tak pernah terselesaikan. Tak disangka hubungan mereka berubah menjadi saling menyembuhkan, namun takdir masih menyiapkan ujian berikutnya.

overview: The delicious documentary series that examines the history and evolution of Korean cuisine continues with a celebration of the national drink, soju.
Theo comes up with chaotic schemes to save his impounded car. Meanwhile, his dying dad will stop at nothing to find himself a new kidney.

In a world where he survived the events of Spartacus, Ashur clawed his way to power, owning the same ludus that once owned him. Allying with a fierce gladiatrix, Ashur ignites a new kind of spectacle that offends the elite.

After her parents' divorce, Jiang Mu reunites with her adopted brother Jin Chao, now a hardened young man living a dangerous life in Thailand. Despite their growing distance, Jiang Mu's unwavering love helps bridge the gap between them, leading to a journey of healing and redemption as they fight to rebuild their bond and face their struggles together.

In 1980s China, orphan Lin Xiaoxiao escapes a forced marriage and heads to Yangcheng, where she starts as a waitress and rises in the fashion world. With the help of heir Liang Keqing, she battles betrayal and adversity to become a rising business star.
overview_id: Akhir 1980-an, yatim piatu Lin Xiaoxiao dipaksa menikah oleh bibinya demi uang. Ia melawan, merantau ke Yangcheng, bekerja sebagai pelayan, lalu meraih peluang bisnis hingga sukses di industri busana. Bersama Liang Keqing, ia menyingkirkan musuh dan bangkit dari yatim yang terintimidasi menjadi bintang bisnis.

overview: About an ordinary high school sophomore, Song Woo-yeon, who joins a drawing club called Spirit Fingers and paints the story of finding her own color, personality, and dream.
In the shadowy world of espionage, Sam Fisher is a rumor and a legend. Pulled back into action, he must help a new recruit unravel a global conspiracy.
overview_id: Di dunia spionase yang kelam, Sam Fisher menjadi rumor sekaligus legenda. Kini ia kembali beraksi, membantu seorang rekrutan baru mengungkap konspirasi global.

overview: Determined university student Lu Ran escapes an arranged marriage to an abusive man, only to unexpectedly meet a kind, tall, and handsome stranger—who turns out to be her intended fiancé.
overview_id: Di era 80-an, mahasiswi cerdas Lu Ran dipaksa menikah demi uang oleh paman dan bibinya dengan pria kasar, miskin, dan sudah beranak! Tak terima nasibnya ditentukan orang lain, Lu Ran nekat kabur. Namun di tengah pelariannya, ia malah bertemu pria tinggi, tampan, dan lembut—yang ternyata adalah calon suami aslinya?!

overview: Ye Qinglan, the daughter of a treasonous official who becomes enslaved after her family's downfall, encounters Shen Que, a young lord investigating corruption in secret. Initially wary of each other, they join forces to combat injustice and restore order to the court.
overview_id: Dimulai dari kasus korupsi di Ningzhou, kisah ini mengikuti Ye Qinglan, putri seorang pejabat yang dipermalukan dan kini menjadi budak setelah keluarganya hancur. Bersama Shen Que, tuan muda dari Kediaman Xuan, ia diam-diam menyelidiki kebenaran dan memulai perjalanan untuk mengungkap konspirasi berbahaya.

overview: Orphan Mai Tian saves an injured, amnesiac crown prince and enters a fake marriage with him to escape an unwanted imperial decree. As they grow closer, their contractual union blossoms into genuine love, and together they work to restore her family’s honor.
overview_id: Mai Tian, satu-satunya pewaris Keluarga Shen, menyelamatkan Putra Mahkota Jin Chuan yang terluka dan kehilangan ingatan. Demi menghindari titah istana, keduanya menjalani pernikahan palsu yang perlahan berubah menjadi cinta sejati, hingga bersama-sama mengungkap skandal besar ujian kenegaraan dan membersihkan nama keluarga Shen.

overview: A K-pop star, Sa-gye, reluctantly enters college, forms a 4-member mixed band, and navigates love and growth through music amid the chaos of campus life.

Heiress Zhao Chunman infiltrates the Yuchun Opera House to avenge her father’s death, but when she’s killed by gang leader Zhou Chi and time resets, she finds herself trapped in a cycle of fate. As she unravels the truth and fights to change her ending, an unexpected romance begins to bloom between them.
overview_id: Zhao Chunman menyusup ke teater demi membalas kematian ayahnya, tapi justru tewas di tangan Zhou Chi. Saat waktu terulang, ia mencoba mengubah takdir dan mengungkap kebenaran. Di tengah permainan bahaya dan dendam, tumbuh perasaan pada pria yang dulu membunuhnya.

overview: Self-styled “Squatter Hunter” Flash Shelton crisscrosses the country deploying savvy legal maneuvers — and a whole lot of nerve — to help desperate homeowners reclaim properties seized by unwelcome occupants.
Two outlaws must navigate the galaxy's dangerous underworld as they chart their destinies.

Gu Liusu, a meticulous jewelry brand founder and her unexpected one-night stand, Lu Xingchen, find themselves working together as boss and secretary. What begins as a comedic misunderstanding between opposites slowly transforms into a heartfelt romance, as professional respect deepens into emotional connection.
overview_id: Gu Liusu, pendiri brand perhiasan yang tegas dan perfeksionis, tanpa sengaja menghabiskan satu malam dengan Lu Xingchen, pria yang baru ditemuinya sekali. Tak disangka, Xingchen kemudian bekerja sebagai sekretaris pribadinya. Dari hubungan penuh salah paham dan pertengkaran, perlahan tumbuh rasa kagum dan cinta yang sulit diingkari.

overview: In Republican-era China, orphan Lin Chuning believes her best friend Xiaorou was killed by the wealthy playboy Lu Siyan. Bent on revenge, she infiltrates the Lu family by impersonating his long-lost "twin sister," posing as the missing heiress to get close to him and exact vengeance.

Ambitious and cunning girl Song Yiyi entered the Yulin Group to fulfill her mother's dying wish. Yet she faced her uncle Xue Fanyu's forceful eviction. A tug-of-war between mentoring and reverse mentoring ensued between the girl and the elder man, unraveling amidst the unknown grudges of the wealthy elite.
Ma San, the heir to a mystical tailoring craft, uses his unique skills to save lawyer Song Yuan from a life-threatening ordeal. The duo teams up to unravel strange cases and deliver justice.
A struggling student at Korea's worst high school forms a study group while protecting his classmates with his fighting skills, hoping to overcome academic challenges and secure a spot in college.
overview_id: Yoon Ga-Min, seorang siswa sma yang berpenampilan seperti siswa teladan dengan kacamata, penampilan rapi, dan wajah polos. Namun sebenarnya, ia tidak pandai dalam hal akademis. Sementara itu, di sisi lain, ia merupakan orang yang pandai dalam bertarung. Walaupun ia pandai dalam bertarung, ia ingin sekali pintar dalam hal akademis. Oleh karena itu, iapun membentuk sebuah kelompok belajar dengan beberapa orang.

overview: Courteney Potter is determined to rally her newly recruited junior college cheer squad to win her record-breaking 15th championship and improve their lives along the way.
A young mother's life is upended when she finds herself hiding behind a secret identity to escape the Bucharest gang responsible for her fiancé's death.
overview_id: Kehidupan ibu muda berubah saat ia harus bersembunyi di balik identitas rahasia untuk melarikan diri dari geng Bucharest yang bertanggung jawab atas kematian tunangannya.

overview: Bai Wu, an employee at an antique auction house who has long been bullied, gains the ability to calculate the success rate of events. With this newfound power, he embarks on a series of adventures in the city, gradually growing stronger and turning the tables on his adversaries.

Talented Zhou Shui and loyal Daji fall in love, dreaming of a better future in their cramped rental and finding joy amid hardships. 18 years later, their story is discovered by two 2000s-born youths, who become observers and commentators of this romance. The intersection and intertwining of two generations spark reflections and retrospection on love.
overview_id: Di Beijing, kisah cinta epik pasangan generasi 80-an dimulai. Zhou Shui, pria paling berbakat, jatuh cinta pada Da Ji, gadis paling setia. Mereka merajut impian di kontrakan sempit, menghadapi kesulitan bersama dengan tawa dan air mata. Delapan belas tahun kemudian, kisah mereka ditemukan oleh sepasang kekasih generasi 2000-an. Apakah cinta masih seberani dulu?

overview: Ted Black, a former federal prosecutor from New York, has reinvented himself representing the most powerful clients in Los Angeles. But his firm is at a crisis point, and in order to survive, he must embrace a role he held in contempt his entire career.

Hide well — someone's out there.

A horror survival reality show

After failing her college entrance exam and struggling in her career, Gu Xuejiao is unexpectedly sent back to her high school years. Determined to change her fate, she shifts her focus from love to success, prioritizing academics and career ambitions. Along the way, she finds herself in a transformative romance where both partners inspire each other to grow.
overview_id: Serial ini mengisahkan seorang pekerja kantoran bucin bernama Gu Xuejiao yang tiba-tiba kembali ke masa SMA di tengah krisis PHK. Demi menebus penyesalan masa lalu, ia bertekad belajar giat dan meraih kesuksesan. Dengan bantuan Lin Zhihua, siswa jenius berprestasi tinggi, ia merombak kembali jalan hidupnya. Bersama-sama mereka menjalani hubungan cinta yang mendukung sesama dan penuh kemanisan.

overview: Ten of South Korea's top racing teams will compete in an unprecedented freestyle racing competition. Each team receives 100 million won to purchase and modify a car into a race car, with no rules or restrictions on customization.

Police academy professor Xu Jingzhi returns to investigate a strange case, where he teams up with his late brother’s friend, Zhuang Mingcheng. Together, they work to take down a criminal gang and solve an old case.
overview_id: Sepuluh tahun setelah meninggalkan kepolisian karena kasus lama yang tak pernah terjelaskan, Xu Jingzhi kembali bertugas di tim kriminal yang dipimpin mantan istrinya, He Ya. Namun serangkaian kasus aneh membawanya pada fakta mengejutkan: dalangnya adalah Zhuang Mingcheng, putra sahabatnya yang diyakini telah meninggal. Xu Jingzhi menyusup ke organisasi itu demi menghentikannya, tapi saat mereka yang berbeda jalan saling berhadapan, keputusan siapa yang akan mengubah segalanya?

overview: In their twenties, Lee Kyeong-do and Seo Ji-woo part ways after two passionate relationships. A decade later, they meet again as a reporter who covers an adultery scandal and the wife of the man at the center of that scandal. Reuniting in their late thirties, their youth has passed, but their love remains vivid. Kyeong-do now strives to prove to her and to himself that he still loves her.
overview_id: Di usia dua puluhan, Lee Kyeong-do dan Seo Ji-woo berpisah setelah dua hubungan yang penuh gairah. Satu dekade kemudian, mereka bertemu kembali sebagai seorang reporter yang meliput skandal perselingkuhan dan istri dari pria yang menjadi pusat skandal tersebut. Bersatu kembali di usia akhir tiga puluhan, masa muda mereka telah berlalu, tetapi cinta mereka tetap hidup. Kyeong-do kini berusaha membuktikan kepada Seo Ji-woo dan kepada dirinya sendiri bahwa ia masih mencintainya.

overview: Trainee constable Su Xiaoqiao switches identities with Gu Qingdai, the widow of a bandit leader, to investigate her mother’s murder. Posing as Gu Qingdai, Su Xiaoqiao takes control of the bandit stronghold and is forced to marry Chu Yan, her undercover superior from the Suzheng Office, as part of her mission to uncover a conspiracy.

Top courtesan Lu Huayan returns to Baillemen to avenge her sister, but her mission takes an unexpected turn when she encounters Li Motong, a mysterious man from another world called Wujian. Tasked with killing her to obtain a legendary artifact that can preserve his realm, Li Motong is shocked to realize Lu Huayan's connection to his past.
overview_id: Demi membalas dendam kakaknya, penari terkenal Lu Huayan memasuki dunia intrik dan bahaya. Namun takdir mempertemukannya dengan Li Motong, pria dari dunia lain yang ditakdirkan untuk membunuhnya. Saat kebenaran terungkap, mereka mendapati bahwa cinta di antara mereka telah terjalin sejak kehidupan sebelumnya—cinta yang indah, tapi berujung tragis.

overview: The drama series revolves around Wangquan Fugui, who is trained as the ultimate demon-slayer of the Yiqi Alliance since childhood, meeting Qing Tong, a spider demon who infiltrates Wangquan Manor as a spy. Qing Tong’s presence allows Fugui to broaden his horizon and change his view on demons. Yearning for freedom, Fugui’s fervor for attaining world peace is gradually ignited. After experiencing extreme agony, he leaves Wangquan Manor with Qing Tong, embarking on a journey of self-enlightenment.
overview_id: Drama ini berkisah tentang Wangquan Fugui, yang sejak kecil dilatih untuk menjadi senjata utama Aliansi Yi Qi dalam membasmi siluman, hingga suatu hari ia bertemu dengan Qing Tong, seekor roh laba-laba yang menyusup ke Vila Wangquan sebagai mata-mata. Kehadiran Qing Tong semakin mengubah pandangan Fugui terhadap siluman, dan ia juga menunjukkan Fugui lebih banyak tentang dunia luar. Keyakinan Fugui akan kebebasan dan impiannya untuk melihat kedamaian di seluruh dunia perlahan-lahan menyala. Setelah mengalami siksaan sepuluh ribu pedang menusuk hati, ia membawa Qing Tong meninggalkan Vila Wangquan dan memulai jalannya sendiri.

overview: Guy Anatole joins the clandestine world of the Talamasca, an international spy agency for the immortal universe, as he searches for answers to his family's own part in the supernatural world.

In war-torn Republican-era China, Lai Fu, a wandering sorcerer, sets out to avenge his family's massacre by unraveling a supernatural mystery, only to uncover a far-reaching conspiracy involving spirit possessions, treason, and a powerful enemy from his past.
overview_id: Di masa kekacauan era Republik, yatim piatu Lai Fu mempelajari ilmu gaib untuk membalas dendam atas pembantaian keluarganya oleh “Rubah Abadi”. Saat menyelidiki kasus “Pernikahan Rubah Kuning”, ia terseret ke dalam intrik dan rahasia kelam keluarga tunangannya yang bangsawan, Nona Bai. Bersama Inspektur Gu, ia mengungkap konspirasi besar yang melibatkan roh jahat, pengkhianatan, dan pasukan penjajah. Dendamnya terbalas, namun perjalanan baru dimulai—antara misteri, pengorbanan, dan cinta yang tak terduga.

overview: In the working-class suburbs of Philadelphia, an FBI agent heads a task force assembled to put an end to a string of violent robberies led by an unsuspecting family man.
overview_id: Berlatar di pinggiran kota kelas pekerja di luar Philadelphia, seorang agen FBI memimpin Satuan Tugas untuk mengakhiri serangkaian perampokan rumah-narkoba.

overview: Driven to claim top culinary honors, an arrogant heir meets a low-profile but stubborn chef whose recipes astonish him — sparking an unlikely romance.

Seo Munju, a highly accomplished diplomat and former ambassador to the United Nations, and Sanho, an international special agent shrouded in a veil of secrets, race to uncover the truth behind an attack that threatens the future stability of the Korean peninsula.

A decade after parting ways over class differences, Lin Miaomiao and CEO Cen Siyuan reunite during a business crisis. As past feelings and long-hidden truths resurface, they must decide if love deserves a second chance.
overview_id: Lin Miaomiao dan Cen Siyuan berpisah karena perbedaan status. 10 tahun kemudian, ia jadi sekretaris ibunya, sementara Siyuan akan menikahi artis terkenal. Krisis bisnis mempertemukan mereka lagi, membuka rahasia dan perasaan lama. Setelah semua yang terjadi, akankah cinta lama bersatu kembali?

overview: This is a reality show that blends scripted romance with real-life travel, a sweet variety program centered around on-screen couples.

Thariq Ridzuwan (played by Meerqeen), an elite officer from the Holy Dragon unit, receives shocking news that his former lover, Husniya Radwa (played by Qasrina Karim), is being forced into marriage by her mother, Rozita. Despite being separated for five years, Thariq abandons his mission to save Radwa.

In Japan's newest medical specialty, general practitioner Tokushige Akira listens closely to his patients' stories, uncovering hidden truths and guiding them toward healing through empathy and conversation.
In 1850s Washington, two families led by powerful matriarchs — one wealthy, one poor but deeply loyal — battle for supremacy on the lawless frontier.
overview_id: Di Washington pada 1850-an, dua keluarga yang dikepalai para wanita tangguh—satu kaya dan satu lagi miskin, tapi setia—berebut kekuasaan di perbatasan yang tanpa hukum.

overview: After dropping out of school to protect his first love, Zhou Mingrui teams up with his friends Xu Jiaming and Pan Bowen to chase their dream of making video games. Despite financial struggles, technical challenges, and market doubts, the three persevere, supporting each other through countless sleepless nights to find success.
overview_id: Demi cinta pertamanya, Zhou Mingrui mengambil keputusan besar untuk keluar dari sekolah. Bersama dua sahabatnya, Xu Jiaming dan Pan Bowen, mereka mengejar mimpi untuk membuat sebuah game. Dimulai dari nol, ketiganya menghadapi kekurangan dana, kesulitan teknis, dan keraguan pasar. Meski penuh rintangan, mereka saling mendukung dan berjuang tanpa henti demi mewujudkan impian. Tiga pemuda biasa ini akhirnya menemukan jalan menuju kesuksesan.

overview: Vincent, an heir to a news empire, gets accused of killing his rival, Walter. To protect his reputation, he hires Stella, an escort with her own haunted past, to pose as his alibi. What begins as a transactional arrangement soon becomes dangerously real as their shared wounds and ambitions draw them together. But when they uncover the truth, the two are compelled to confront their true feelings.

The American Revolution was at once a war for independence, a war of conquest, a civil war, and a world war, fought by neighbors on American farms and between global powers an ocean or more away. It impacted millions from Vermont’s Green Mountains to the swamps of South Carolina, from Indian Country to the Iberian Peninsula. In defeating the British Empire and giving birth to a new nation, the American Revolution turned the world upside-down. Thirteen colonies on the Atlantic Coast united in rebellion, won their independence, and established a republic that still endures. The American Revolution will present the story of the men and women of the Revolutionary generation, their humanity in victory and defeat, and the crisis that they lived through.

In a time of war, poisoned Prince Zhao He is saved by Yi Jiu, a mysterious healer secretly tied to the fallen Moon Clan. As they uncover the truth behind the clan’s massacre, Zhao He and his ally Yun Yao fight to expose the conspiracy and restore peace to the realm.
A story following an M&A expert who is known as a legendary negotiator and his team including Lawyer O Sun Yeong and Choi Jin Sun. The M&A expert specializes in large corporation deals.

Lingyun, a cunning palace maid, rises through the imperial ranks to become the emperor’s favored consort, exposing the empress’s hidden corruption. But her ascent comes at a terrible cost, as she becomes ensnared in ruthless palace intrigues and a forbidden love that could destroy her.
overview_id: Demi membalas dendam, pelayan istana Ling Yun menyusup ke dalam istana dan menapaki jalan penuh tipu daya. Langkah demi langkah, ia berhasil merebut perhatian kaisar dan menjadi selir yang paling dicintai, hingga membuka kebusukan para bangsawan di balik tirai emas. Namun keberhasilannya justru menyeretnya ke dalam cinta terlarang dengan saudara kandungnya sendiri. Di tengah intrik, darah, dan rahasia yang menyesakkan, Ling Yun harus memilih antara cinta, kekuasaan, dan keselamatan dirinya.

overview: Secluded on a remote Greek island, retired assassin Julie has a somewhat thorny reunion with her estranged son, Edward, visiting from England. Armed with questions around new information on his paternity, Edward battles to find the right time to speak to his frustratingly distant mother. But, when the moment finally presents itself, things take a deadly turn as Julie’s dangerous past catches up with her and they are forced to flee the island and go on the run together.
A famous author is pulled into a twisted mind game with her rich, powerful new neighbor — who might be a murderer.
overview_id: Seorang penulis tenar terjebak dalam permainan pikiran yang rumit dengan tetangga barunya yang kaya dan berkuasa—yang mungkin seorang pembunuh.

overview: Suffering from insomnia and migraines, Shen Xifan consults a traditional Chinese medicine doctor, He Suye. As their lives intersect, an unexpected romance blossoms.
overview_id: Manajer hotel Shen Xifan, yang sibuk dengan pekerjaannya, menderita insomnia kronis dan mencari bantuan dari pengobatan tradisional. Di sana, ia bertemu dengan dokter He Suye. Awalnya hanya terhubung sebagai dokter dan pasien, pertemuan tak terduga di lingkungan tempat tinggal mereka mendekatkan keduanya. Seiring waktu, mereka mulai membuka hati dan menemukan makna baru dalam hidup dan cinta.

overview: Chloe moves in New York's most elite circles with her lawyer husband Adam and teenage son Ethan by her side while her estranged sister Nicky tries to make ends meet and stay clean. When Adam is brutally murdered, the investigation sends shockwaves through the family and exposes long-buried secrets.
overview_id: Chloe bergaul di lingkaran elit New York bersama suaminya yang seorang pengacara, Adam, dan putranya yang masih remaja, Ethan, sementara saudara perempuannya yang terasing, Nicky, berusaha memenuhi kebutuhan hidup dan tidak minum alkohol lagi. Ketika Adam dibunuh secara brutal, penyelidikannya mengguncang keluarga dan mengungkap rahasia yang telah lama terkubur.

overview: On December 21, 1988, Pan Am Flight 103 exploded over the small Scottish town of Lockerbie, killing 270 people. What followed was the largest murder investigation in the history of Scottish policing, into the deadliest act of terrorism on British soil.
overview_id: Pengeboman tragis sebuah penerbangan transatlantik di atas Skotlandia tahun 1988 menyatukan kepolisian lokal dan FBI untuk memburu para pelaku.

overview: Backwoods bounty hunter Hub Halloran comes back from the dead with an unexpected second chance at life, love, and a nearly-forgotten musical career — only to find that his old job now has a demonic new twist.
overview_id: Pemburu bayaran yang dibunuh, Hub Halloran, dibangkitkan Iblis untuk memburu para iblis yang kabur dari penjara Neraka. Dari memburu para iblis tersebut dengan bantuan dan hambatan dari keluarganya yang hubungannya tidak harmonis, Hub akhirnya mengerti bagaimana dosa-dosanya sendiri mengakibatkan jiwanya dikutuk - yang mendorongnya mencari kesempatan kedua dalam hidup, cinta, dan musik country.

overview: When a shocking double homicide goes unsolved for 16 years, a detective teams up with a genealogist to catch the killer before it becomes a cold case.
overview_id: Saat pembunuhan ganda yang mengejutkan tidak terpecahkan selama 16 tahun, seorang detektif bekerja sama dengan seorang ahli genealogi untuk menangkap si pembunuh.

overview: Two scientists with limited funds, extraordinary dedication and impressive scientific skills are on the brink of making a life-enhancing difference to the treatment of cancer.
After an embarrassing incident at work, suburban family man William Ronald Trosper finds himself investigating a far-reaching conspiracy.
overview_id: Setelah kejadian memalukan di tempat kerja, seorang pria mendapati dirinya menyelidiki konspirasi yang mengakar.

overview: Zuo Qiandai confesses to her crush, Lu Yeqi, only to discover he’s secretly a famous female manga artist. Tricked into becoming his comic assistant, Qiandai enters a vibrant world of eccentric characters and unpredictable adventures while chasing their dreams in the world of manga.
overview_id: Zuo Qiandai menyatakan cinta pada Yeqi, senior yang dia sukai, siapa yang mengira dia akan memberikan tanda tangannya dan menipunya untuk menjadi asistennya. Ternyata Yeqi, si pintar berwajah dingin, sebenarnya adalah komikus manga shoujo terkenal! Pada hari-hari ketika dia dianggap sebagai penggemar, Zuo Qiandai memasuki dunia manga Yeqi, juga bertemu dengan sekelompok orang yang sangat mencolok dan sangat aneh, semua jenis plot yang berbeda dari biasanya, plot fantasi narsisti, adalah rutinitas sehari-hari. Dengan naik turunnya hubungan antara keduanya, semua orang juga bergerak maju menuju dunia manga...

overview: A future-era antique shop owner, Bi Zhi, joins forces with modern veterinarian Su Beilu on a time-traveling quest to recover lost antiques. As they journey through different eras, they encounter unique cultures and life stories, building an unexpected friendship that inspires them to approach their own lives with renewed optimism.
overview_id: Pemilik toko barang antik dari masa depan, Bi Zhi, bekerja sama dengan Su Beilu, dokter hewan di era modern. Keduanya menempuh perjalanan lintas waktu untuk menemukan kembali artefak bersejarah yang hilang. Di setiap era, mereka menyaksikan kisah manusia, budaya, dan takdir, sekaligus membangun persahabatan yang melampaui waktu.

overview: When an analyst discovers his eyes and ears have been hacked, he's drawn into a controlled world designed by his agency to draw out their enemies.

Three women with completely different careers, personalities, and routines become unlikely housemates.
