Despite their differences, they share one ritual: every night, no matter what challenges they face, they cook and share dinner together. Around the dinner table, their daily struggles begin to untangle — one meal at a time.
overview_id: Tiga perempuan dengan profesi, kepribadian, dan gaya hidup yang sangat berbeda tinggal bersama di bawah satu atap. Namun ada satu hal yang menyatukan mereka: apa pun masalah yang dihadapi, entah dalam hidup, cinta, atau pekerjaan, setiap malam mereka selalu memasak dan menikmati makan malam bersama, seolah-olah semua kesulitan bisa terurai setelah santapan hangat di meja makan.

overview: Li Jingnian and Lin Xiaoran travel to Chang’an, unraveling a string of mysterious and unsettling cases along the way. With each investigation, they come closer to exposing the true culprit behind the chaos plaguing the empire. Through relentless pursuit of justice and intense confrontations, they fight to restore order and bring peace back to Chang’an.
overview_id: Di akhir Dinasti Tang, beberapa kejadian aneh melanda Chang'an. Sebanyak Enam kasus mengerikan mencengkeram ibu kota. Li Jingnian dari Dalisi bersama Lin Xiaoran dan ksatria pengembara Shen Qiuwan, bersama membuat tim investigasi untuk menyelediki kasus-kasus misterius, apakah mereka berhasil mengungkap kebenaran?

overview: Amid political chaos caused by the former emperor’s suppression of the military, the general’s son Nan Chenxiao disguises himself as a woman to stay safe, while aspiring official Rui Yu hides her identity by posing as a man. Forced into partnership through an unexpected marriage by the new emperor, the two face dangerous trials and uncover each other’s secrets to help the emperor restore stability to the realm.
overview_id: Untuk menyelamatkan putra jenderal, Nan Chenxiao menyamar sebagai perempuan, sedangkan Rui Yu masuk istana sebagai pria. Kaisar Yan Lin memerintahkan mereka menikah demi melindungi identitas masing-masing. Lewat pelarian dan ancaman maut, keduanya saling membuka rahasia. Namun, mampukah cinta bertahan ketika takdir kerajaan dipertaruhkan?

overview: DCI Jeanette Kilburn and eminent psychotherapist Dr. Sophia Craven join forces to hunt the killer of young men. The investigation takes Jeanette and Sophia into a dangerous world of historic abuse and murder.

After being pulled into the world of his own teahouse business game, modern-day developer Lin Yuhao awakens as Wei Xiaotang, the only daughter of a powerful merchant family. Thrust into an arranged marriage with Li Zixuan, heir to a rival teahouse, the two start off as reluctant partners. But as they face challenges together in a world of commerce and tradition, their bond deepens.
overview_id: CEO modern Lin Yuhao tiba-tiba sadar bahwa dirinya telah masuk ke dalam game pedagang teh yang ia ciptakan sendiri, dan berubah menjadi Wei Xiaotang, menantu baru keluarga Li. Satu-satunya cara untuk kembali ke dunianya adalah dengan menyelesaikan misi dalam game dan mendapatkan gelar “Teh Terbaik di Dunia”. Wei Xiaotang pun bekerja sama dengan suami kontraknya, Li Zixuan, memulai perjalanan penuh strategi, intrik, dan ketulusan hati demi meraih kemenangan.

overview: Take a deep dive into real-life scandals, exposing bizarre secrets, shattered lives, and twisted motives. Led by Beth Karas, each gripping story uncovers deceit, greed, and manipulation, proving truth is far more chilling than fiction.

A quiet town is shaken by strange events that mirror a century-old tragedy. When a cursed message written in blood resurfaces, the community spirals into fear. As darkness spreads, it becomes unclear whether the threat is supernatural or the result of a sinister human plot.
overview_id: Kota kecil yang tenang tiba-tiba diguncang kejadian aneh. Kutukan dari surat berdarah peninggalan wanita gila membawa teror dari masa lalu. Di balik kabut misteri, tersimpan rahasia kelam—benarkah ini kutukan, sisi gelap manusia, atau konspirasi yang direncanakan?

overview: When a mysterious dice game puts lives on the line, players must fight, betray, and survive—or lose everything.

After 500 years of seclusion, cultivator Hua Zhaoyang attains the Heavenly Realm and confronts her nemesis, Ye Tian. To complete her ascension, she must fulfill Ye Tian's final wish. Thus begins Hua Zhaoyang's journey through reincarnations, seeking Ye Tian's past self to erase his malice and uncover the true power of redemption.
overview_id: Hua Zhaoyang dari Sekte Bulan Manusia mengalahkan musuh bebuyutannya, Asura Ye Tian, setelah 500 tahun menyendiri dan mencapai Alam Surga. Untuk menjadi makhluk surga, ia harus memenuhi wasiat Ye Tian: menyelamatkannya dan mencegahnya menjadi Asura. Hua Zhaoyang menyegel jiwanya ke dalam giok dan memulai reinkarnasi untuk membangunkan Ye Tian.

overview: An action thriller depicting the revenge of children who barely survived the brink of death after being abandoned by their adoptive parents.

Fan Dayao, the mighty Tiger Demon King, rules Qianchun Mountain with absolute power. Shen Wangchen, a frail and distant nobleman’s son, seeks a cat demon to cure his illness. When they meet, an unlikely and humorous cohabitation between human and demon begins.
overview_id: Fan Da Yao, ratu iblis harimau yang ditakuti karena kekuatannya, dipertemukan dengan Shen Wangchen, putra penguasa Kota Moyuan yang rapuh sejak lahir. Demi mencari obat, Wangchen justru terikat dengan sang iblis. Dari situlah dimulai kisah “hidup bersama” antara manusia dan iblis, dengan hari-hari yang dipenuhi canda tawa, kekacauan, sekaligus romansa.

overview: In the bustling city of Guangping, where humans and demons coexist, the wealthy young lady Ban Xia possesses unusual eyes that see shadows invisible to others. Despite her propriety and considerate nature, she is labeled a "madwoman" by others. When Ban Xia uncovers her sister-in-law's secret, she meets the demon hunter Xuan Ye, who reveals the world where humans and demons coexist. Together, they investigate various mysterious phenomena in Guangping.
overview_id: Di kota Guangping tempat manusia dan siluman hidup berdampingan, Ban Xia—putri keluarga kaya yang bisa melihat hal-hal tak kasatmata—terlibat dalam berbagai kejadian aneh setelah mengungkap identitas siluman saudara iparnya. Dalam pelariannya, ia bertemu Xuan Ye, penangkap siluman misterius yang membantunya melihat dunia siluman dengan lebih jelas. Saat mereka menyelidiki kasus-kasus bersama, hubungan mereka berkembang menjadi kisah cinta rumit yang diuji oleh rahasia kelam Xuan Ye, yang mungkin bukan hanya seorang penangkap, tapi juga siluman itu sendiri.

overview: This stranger-than-fiction crime caper follows the attempted robbery of a precious gem, told by the gangsters who did it and the police on their tail.

No Ki-jun, an employee at an insurance company, decides to develop a divorce insurance policy after personally experiencing three divorces that impacted his life and finances. Despite potential biases, he believes divorce is an unforeseen disaster and establishes a team for divorce insurance.
overview_id: Aktuaris genius Ki-jun dari Asuransi Plus General, tempat berkumpulnya para ahli, mulai mengembangkan polis asuransi perceraian. Tim khusus dibentuk, termasuk penanggung, analis kuantitatif, surveyor risiko, penilai kerugian, dan mantan agen asuransi terbaik. Komedi romantis kantor ini mengisahkan hubungan dan cinta baru mereka sambil menghitung angka perceraian untuk menentukan premi yang tepat.

overview: Kim Nak-su is a middle-aged man who loses everything he once considered valuable in an instant. After a long journey, he finally discovers his true self, beyond his role as a department manager at a large corporation.

Hei Fuyi, the sole survivor of her family’s massacre, accidentally awakens the ancient lamp spirit A Qi and forms a life-bound partnership with her. With the spirited A Qi and a runaway young prince at her side, she moves through the chaos of the late Qing era, chasing supernatural secrets and human darkness until she uncovers the truth behind her family’s fall.
overview_id: Setelah keluarganya dibantai dan dirinya jatuh ke jurang bersama artefak kuno Lentera Tujuh Bintang, He Fuyi tanpa sengaja membangunkan roh lentera Aqi dan terikat dengannya. Demi membalas dendam dan mempertahankan hidup, keduanya menjadi penjelajah mimpi, menembus mimpi manusia untuk menghapus dendam dan ilusi. Dalam perjalanan melintasi kekacauan akhir Dinasti Qing bersama Pangeran Xiao Wuye, mereka menyaksikan berbagai kisah cinta dan kehilangan hingga akhirnya mengungkap kebenaran kelam di balik tragedi masa lalu.

overview: Discover the harrowing tales of those who survived Korea's gloomiest chapters, shedding a light on long-hidden truths.

After a difficult childbirth, Jiang Rong falls into a coma and wakes up to find herself transformed into an empress dowager with a newborn son but no memory of the father. To survive the taboo of a widow giving birth, she must navigate her relationships with three suspected fathers, uncovering secrets, romance, and unexpected humor.
overview_id: Saat melahirkan, Jiang Rong mengalami koma dan terbangun sebagai Permaisuri Janda yang baru melahirkan seorang putra. Ia kehilangan ingatan dan tak tahu siapa ayah anaknya. Demi bertahan hidup di istana dan mencari kebenaran, ia harus berhadapan dengan tiga pria misterius yang memicu kisah penuh intrik, cinta, dan komedi.

overview: After being brutally killed in her past life, Lady Zhang Xiyin is reborn and vows revenge on her husband, Marquis Zhou Yihong, and his concubine. She forms a strategic alliance with Prince Duan Jianli, but as they pursue their goals, an unexpected romance begins to bloom between them.
overview_id: Dibunuh secara kejam di kehidupan sebelumnya, Zhang Xiyin bereinkarnasi dan bertekad untuk balas dendam pada suaminya dan istri keduanya. Ia menjalin aliansi dengan Pangeran Ji demi kepentingan bersama, namun hubungan mereka menjadi lebih dari kerja sama.

overview: Wen Yifan, by chance, ends up living with her high school classmate Sang Yan, whom she once rejected. They keep their distance until Wen Yifan learns from Sang Yan that she sleepwalks, intertwining their lives once more.
overview_id: Wen Yifan dan teman sekelas SMA-nya yang pernah dia tolak, Sang Yan, akhirnya tinggal bersama sebagai teman serumah. Awalnya mereka tidak saling mengganggu, tetapi karena Wen Yifan tahu dirinya sering tidur berjalan dari Sang Yan, hubungan mereka pun mulai terjalin.

overview: A drama depicting a life-threatening confrontation between a woman who takes another person's life for revenge and a woman who takes another person's life for her own desires.
Reincarnated as a minor character in a novel, Cha Seon-taek unexpectedly spends a night with Prince Kyungsung, sparking an intense and unexpected romance.

After getting caught up in a brutal case, young forensic assistant Xu Linlang joins forces with the bold Lu Jiu and clever Sima Kong. Together, the trio navigates the treacherous underworld of Wuxiang City, solving mysteries and uncovering hidden truths, all while forging deep bonds and growing through danger and discovery.
overview_id: Koroner muda Xu Linlang terseret ke dunia bawah akibat pembantaian berdarah. Bersama Lu Jiu dan Sima Kong, mereka menelusuri labirin kekuasaan dan konspirasi faksi Kota Wuxiang. Dalam bayang-bayang dunia gelap, mereka mengungkap kebenaran dan membangun ikatan tak terduga.

overview: Chronicles the lives of four generations of an upper-class family of stockbrokers, set against the backdrop of a rapidly evolving late-Victorian world.

Zhou Nanfeng discovers a diary that lets him travel back in time to stop a vengeful act that could destroy Qin Zhiyi’s future. As past and present collide, four lives become entangled in a cycle of love, revenge, and fate, where uncovering the truth may come at the ultimate cost.

While haunted by memories of a failed arrest that allowed the Ripton Stalker to remain free, retired detective Inspector Huw Miller becomes suspicious of his enigmatic new neighbour Patrick Harbottle.
A career-driven game developer fights back against misogynistic expectations after she becomes the target of brutal attacks online and in real life.
'The Gaslight District,' a supernatural crime series about a family of undead gangsters in a town where death means nothing and consequences only matter if you can't slime your way out of them.

Laura has it all: a glittering career, a loving husband, and her precious son, Daniel. But her perfect life unravels when Daniel brings home Cherry, a girlfriend who changes everything. After a tense introduction, Laura becomes convinced Cherry is hiding something. Is she a manipulative social climber, or is Laura just paranoid? The truth is a matter of perspective.
overview_id: Laura memiliki segalanya: karier, suami penyayang, dan putra yang berharga, Daniel. Namun, kehidupannya yang sempurna hancur saat Daniel membawa Cherry, pacar yang mengubah segalanya. Usai perkenalan yang menegangkan, Laura yakin Cherry menyembunyikan sesuatu. Apakah dia pemanjat sosial yang manipulatif, atau Laura hanya takut? Kebenaran hanyalah soal perspektif.

overview: Zhuang Hanyan, abandoned as a child and raised in the countryside, returns to her family in the capital, catching the attention of Fu Yunxi, a magistrate seeking a capable wife. As they grow closer, Hanyan finds warmth in family bonds as their relationship deepens.
overview_id: Zhuang Han Yan, yang ditinggalkan dan dibesarkan di pedesaan selatan sejak kecil, akhirnya kembali ke keluarga Zhuang di ibu kota, menarik perhatian Fu Yun Xi. Fu Yun Xi menderita penyakit aneh dan mencari wanita berbudi luhur dan berbakat untuk mempercayakan keluarganya. Zhuang Han Yan, dengan keberanian luar biasa dan hati yang baik, menjadi pilihan idealnya. Saat Zhuang Han Yan dan Fu Yun Xi saling jatuh cinta melalui berbagai ujian, bisakah Han Yan berdamai dan menemukan kembali ikatan keluarga yang hilang?

overview: Wei Jianhao, gifted with a unique jade appraisal ability, returns to Chongjiang and is drawn into a dangerous power struggle threatening the jade trade district. Using his skills, he faces mounting challenges to protect the people and uphold justice.
Thrown into the gritty world of a weekly magazine, rookie reporter Hinako Shinoda chases scandals, crime, and secrets she never expected to uncover.

Five years after being framed in a scandal and forced out of LinLin Breakfast, Chiang Zhi-hao now runs a small beauty salon that serves breakfast. When the chairman’s youngest son appears with proof of his brother’s betrayal, Chiang gets a chance to clear his name and seek justice.
overview_id: Kisah drama ini berpusat pada tiga keluarga yang mengelola salon kecantikan, kedai sarapan, dan pabrik mainan. Di antara ketiga keluarga ini, ada yang kehilangan pekerjaan karena dijebak, ada yang merasa tidak dihargai, dan ada juga yang ingin memanfaatkan orang lain untuk mengalahkan saudara tiri mereka. Di setiap jalan yang mereka tempuh untuk membalas dendam, terungkaplah konflik antar dua generasi, dan bagaimana dendam dari generasi sebelumnya menyebabkan kehancuran emosional pada generasi berikutnya.

overview: After waking up in an ancient book as a noblewoman accused of murder, Lin Qianjin must solve a tangled poisoning case while trying to win over her cold rival, Li Yan. As danger closes in, unexpected romance and hidden motives complicate her quest for survival.
overview_id: Lin Qianjin masuk ke dunia dalam buku kuno dan dituduh meracuni seseorang. Meski berusaha membuktikan dirinya tak bersalah, Jenderal Li Yan tetap ingin membunuhnya. Ia pun berubah taktik, mulai menggoda Li Yan sambil mencari kebenaran. Tapi semua orang mencurigakan, dan cinta tak terduga pun tumbuh.

overview: Ni Xiangdong agrees to deliver a wooden box to an abandoned cabin, only to uncover a shocking secret that ties him to a missing persons case. As police investigate, they uncover a complex web of relationships and buried truths involving Ni Xiangdong, his estranged friends, and a troubled past.

A small team of investigators are assembled to track down and capture the most dangerous killers our country has ever seen, all of whom have just escaped from a top-secret prison that's not supposed to exist.

Han Li, an ordinary, poor boy from a mountain village, joins a small martial arts sect by chance. Despite his mediocre talent, he eventually cultivates himself into an immortal through hard work and careful planning.

A beachfront hotel sparks family conflict when Helen won't sell, despite her children's wishes. The arrival of Amanda, claiming to be Helen's long-lost daughter, adds complexity. As the hotel's fate hangs, deception leads to murder.

When 14 year old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped, he awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and who are all possessed of unusual abilities. In a nearby town, haunted former police officer Tim Jamieson has come looking to start a new life, but the peace and quiet won’t last, as his story and Luke’s are destined to collide.
A rootless genius, Iris Nixon, steals an enigmatic code from a charming philanthropist and disappears. A tense countdown ensues as she races to unravel the code's mystery.

Jay-jay, the only girl in the mischievous Section E, hopes for a fresh start in high school but quickly becomes the target of her rowdy male classmates' pranks and schemes to make her leave. Dubbed their "Mutya" (muse), she fights back with wit and charm, turning the tables on her tormentors. Amidst the chaos, unexpected friendships blossom, and hilarious misunderstandings lead to heart-fluttering moments. Can Jay-jay survive the madness of Section E, or will she win over their hearts instead?
Xiao Mingming is a martial arts novel enthusiast who, as the novel's protagonist Xiao Qiushui, journeys through a fictional martial arts world and grows from a passionate youth into a noble hero.
overview_id: Drama ini menceritakan kisah Xiao Mingming, seorang penggemar novel wuxia yang telah menerima kenyataan hidup. Ia menjelajahi dunia persilatan melalui sudut pandang tokoh utama novelnya, Xiao Qiushui, dan tumbuh dari pendekar pedang muda yang impulsif dengan keterampilan terbatas menjadi pahlawan yang andal, penuh kasih dan keadilan, melindungi keluarga dan negaranya.

overview: When a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness—freeing dozens of violent inmates—the region's lone marshal must protect the town he's vowed to keep safe.
overview_id: Ketika sebuah pesawat yang mengangkut tahanan penjara jatuh di hutan belantara Alaska yang terpencil dan membebaskan lusinan narapidana yang kejam, satu-satunya marsekal di kawasan itu harus melindungi kota yang dia bersumpah akan dia jaga.

overview: A Librarian from the past time travels to the present and finds himself stuck here. When he returns to his castle, which is now a museum, he inadvertently releases magic across the continent. He is given a new team to help him clean up the mess he made, forming a new team of Librarians.

The story follows Li Shande, a man deceived by his colleagues and demoted from his supervisory role. Now forced to become the “Lychee Envoy,” he faces a near-impossible mission to deliver fresh lychees from Lingnan to Chang’an as a birthday gift for the Noble Consort. The saying goes that lychees change color in one day, lose their fragrance in two, and their flavor in three days. With more than 5,000 li between Lingnan and Chang’an, and under tight deadlines with limited resources, how can he possibly pull it off?
overview_id: Akibat dikhianati rekan kerja, Li Shande harus menerima misi mustahil: mengirimkan buah leci segar dari Lingnan ke Chang'an untuk ulang tahun Selir Gui. Tapi leci hanya tahan tiga hari, sedangkan jaraknya ribuan mil. Akankah misi ini berhasil, atau justru jadi jalan kematian?

overview: The journey of an ordinary soldier in the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army during the 14-year Second Sino-Japanese War, highlighting the region's grueling and heroic fight against Japanese imperialist forces.

After his mentor Zan Maochang’s death, archaeologist Fang Kun joins an excavation of a newly discovered tomb, where he reunites with his former lover, Luo Qing. Their investigation sparks controversy and draws the attention of artifact criminals. Together with Qi Dacang from the public security bureau, they must confront challenges to protect the tomb and preserve cultural heritage.

Between 1995 and 2001 in southern France, a teenage girl vanishes and three young women are murdered—sparking a relentless manhunt that will haunt detective Flore Robin and the Perpignan police for years.
Follow the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon, a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian" whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble.

Shen Yuqing, a mistreated noblewoman’s daughter, assumes a new identity to seek revenge and expose political conspiracies. With the help of Regent Prince Pei Ji, they battle powerful enemies, face deadly trials, and protect their family.
overview_id: Shen Yuqing, putri haram keluarga Adipati, menderita setelah ibunya dibunuh. Demi menuntut balas, ia menyamar sebagai selir Xiyan untuk mendekati wali negara Pei Ji. Dengan kecerdikan, ia merebut hatinya sekaligus membongkar konspirasi keluarga Adipati dan Permaisuri Janda. Saat Pei Ji mengorbankan diri demi melindungi mereka, Xiyan membawa putra kecilnya ke perbatasan. Namun, takdir masih menyimpan kejutan—akankah mereka dipertemukan kembali?

overview: Taejoong's life is torn apart when he's framed for a heinous crime and imprisoned. Discovering it was all orchestrated by someone on the outside, he embarks on a rage-fueled quest for revenge.

When a powerful arcane relic known as 'The Beacon' falls into nefarious hands, a group of fugitives and outcasts, bound by secrets and scars, must learn to work together to save the realm and stop reality as they know it from unraveling.
overview_id: Sekelompok orang buangan, penjahat, dan orang-orang yang tidak beruntung berusaha menyelamatkan benua ketika sebuah relik misterius yang mampu mengubah realitas jatuh ke tangan yang salah.

overview: In Shenzhen, a jobless Lu Da rekindles hope in a 24-hour bookstore; opera star Fan becomes a tech sales whiz in Huaqiangbei; delivery rider Tan earns dignity; drone engineers Zhang Yi and Nuan build love with code; teen Xiao Peng creates a wildlife overpass; planner Wang Pengqian and daughter protect mangroves, with spoonbill Y075 marking eco-change. These stories weave entrepreneurship, innovation, and sustainability, showcasing Shenzhen’s 45-year transformation and future promise.
overview_id: Dengan tema besar "keajaiban", serial ini menyoroti perjalanan Shenzhen selama 45 tahun reformasi dan keterbukaan. Lewat kisah-kisah yang dikemas artistik, ditampilkan capaian gemilang masa lalu, semangat muda kota, serta visi masa depan yang terus bergerak maju, sebuah potret tentang mimpi, keberanian, dan perubahan yang lahir dari zaman.

overview: As a serial killer targets couples and strikes terror in Italy, authorities explore a case from 1968 that may be key to finding The Monster of Florence.
overview_id: Saat pembunuh berantai mengincar para pasangan dan meneror Italia, otoritas menyelidiki kasus tahun 1968 yang bisa jadi kunci untuk menemukan Monster dari Florence.

overview: The fates of a man with a hidden past, a wise and just woman, and an upright man intertwine.

Xiao Jiu, a female corpse handler, is sent to deliver the body of a wealthy young man to an old mansion, where she discovers his parents are holding a ghost marriage ceremony for him. The following day, the parents show up at her door, demanding the return of their son’s body, which they claim has gone missing.

In 1995, bankrupt smuggler Lu Shaohua turns to meth production for profits, while anti-narcotics cop Lin Qiangfeng transfers to Xigang after an undercover mission. Over years of cat-and-mouse across borders, Lin finally dismantles Lu’s expanding drug empire.
overview_id: Tahun 1995, Lu Shaohua kehilangan segalanya dan tergoda membuat sabu demi keuntungan besar. Di sisi lain, Lin Qiangfeng kembali dari tugas penyamaran dan memimpin perang melawan narkoba. Saat ambisi dan hukum saling beradu, mampukah kebenaran menang sebelum semuanya terlambat?

overview: Seok-cheol, the eldest son in a family of three generations of gangsters, navigates the tumultuous ups and downs of life with tears and laughter, all to protect his family, career, and love.

Two sisters enter the palace and quickly earn the emperor’s favor, but their rise ends in tragedy when the elder sister—pregnant with the heir—is killed in a palace scheme. Left with nothing, the younger sister Lu Jiuning hides her grief and, as a lowly palace maid, carefully plots her revenge. Moving between rival consorts and imperial power, she wages a quiet but ruthless battle to avenge her sister’s death.
overview_id: Emperor, setting her meticulous plans for revenge. This battle is not for favor, but for blood! Dua saudari masuk ke istana; sang kakak yang memikat dan sang adik yang cerdik ingin hidup tenang, namun terus dijebak hingga nyaris tak punya jalan keluar. Saat kejayaan tiba, sang kakak tewas tragis saat mengandung. Lu Jiuning pun menyimpan dendam dan, sebagai pelayan istana, menantang para selir dan kaisar demi membalas kematian kakaknya. Demi keadilan.

overview: The documentary crew that immortalized Dunder Mifflin's Scranton branch is in search of a new subject when they discover a historic Toledo newspaper, The Truth Teller, and the eager publisher trying to revive it.
A perfect crime unravels hidden human darkness as a child-related case emerges, exposing the unsettling truths of society beneath its calm facade.
The staff of Pittsburgh's Trauma Medical Center work around the clock to save lives in an overcrowded and underfunded emergency department.
A potato researcher with 12 years of experience who is working on a secret project and a newly appointed eccentric director go head to head before falling for each other in a sweet office romance.
Accused of killing her husband, a woman is offered a way out by a mysterious stranger: in exchange for a confession in her place, she must commit murder.
overview_id: Dituduh membunuh suaminya, seorang wanita ditawari solusi oleh sosok misterius. Sosok itu bersedia mengaku membunuh sang suami jika si wanita mau melakukan pembunuhan.

overview: When a political marriage ignites a long-awaited revenge, the returning Princess Royal and her former lover clash in the court’s power struggles. But as love and rivalry collide, they realize they are each other’s only salvation and join forces to reshape the kingdom’s future.
overview_id: Dendam yang lahir dari pernikahan politik mempertemukan kembali Sang Putri dengan mantan kekasihnya di istana. Cinta dan persaingan saling terkait, namun pada akhirnya mereka menyadari bahwa hanya satu sama lain yang dapat menyelamatkan mereka. Bergandengan tangan, mereka memainkan kekaisaran layaknya papan catur, menciptakan sebuah era kejayaan bersama.

overview: In a world divided into three kingdoms, Princess Jiang Taohua of Zhao escapes Empress Lv's control through a marriage alliance in Wei, a kingdom fraught with political intrigue. An unexpected encounter with Chancellor Shen Zaiye draws her into his world, where their complex relationship unfolds as they navigate personal ambitions and the turbulence of court politics.
overview_id: Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, Putri Jiang Taohua dari Zhao memilih pernikahan politik untuk lepas dari kendali Permaisuri Lu. Namun, tiba di Wei, ia terjebak skandal dengan Kanselir Shen Zaiye dan dipaksa menjadi selirnya. Keduanya saling menjebak, tapi perasaan perlahan tumbuh. Saat takhta jadi taruhan, siapa yang akan bertahan demi cinta?

overview: Xiao Qiao, a clever girl from the Qiao family, marries Wei Shao, the brave and kind master of the Wei family. Despite initial wariness due to ancestral grievances, Xiao Qiao and Wei Shao navigate their relationship with humor and determination. As they face challenges together, they come to appreciate each other's qualities through their warm daily life, intertwined with family and national affairs, and work to restore peace and resolve conflicts.

After losing her kingdom, Princess Xiao Ningyun is sold into slavery and bought by Prince Chen Fengxue, who initially tortures her out of revenge. As they face challenges and misunderstandings, they eventually open up to each other.

In a rapidly developing Hanzhou, police officer Qin Feng and his sworn brother Liu Tianye face off against dangerous criminals while grappling with deep moral dilemmas and the complicated ties between family, power, and justice.

After being betrayed and left disfigured when a lookalike steals her identity, Lin Hong'er receives a new face and a new name from a mysterious healer. Now living as Hong Linlang, she sets out on a path of revenge against the powerful family that destroyed her life and to reclaim her lost love.
overview_id: Putra mahkota, Xiao Xian, mencari kekasihnya, Lin Hong'er. Namun, wanita mirip Lin Hong'er, Xu Ziyi, menyamar sebagai dirinya. Keluarga Xu membunuh keluarga Lin Hong'er dan merusak wajahnya. Diselamatkan oleh tabib misterius, Lin Hong'er mengubah wajahnya menjadi Hong Linlang dan memulai balas dendam.

overview: A woman from a prestigious family helps her husband become king, but their relationship deteriorates as he takes many concubines. Tensions rise as the king seeks to control her and her family.

An unexpected encounter occurs when Xiao Muchen, a perfectionist and heir to the Yingman Group, hires Yi Ran, a low-rated reviewer working odd jobs, to help solve a crisis at the hotel. Despite their clashes and having little in common, they eventually draw closer together through a series of challenges.
overview_id: Yi Ran yang bekerja serabutan menjadi penguji kamar hotel bintang lima dan bertemu dengan Xiao Mu Cheng. Tanpa disangka, Xiao Mu Cheng ternyata adalah direktur hotel dan atasannya. Bersama-sama, mereka menghadapi masalah hotel dan pengunjung yang beragam. Meskipun banyak perbedaan, mereka mulai saling mendekat…

overview: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor goes head to head with courtroom lion Leo Drummond as well as his law school girlfriend, Sarah. Rudy, along with his boss, Bruiser, and her disheveled paralegal, Deck, uncovers two connected conspiracies surrounding the mysterious death of their client's son.

Museum curator Xiao Yue’s life is disrupted when a mysterious incident causes a time swap between her mother and a maid from the Western Han dynasty. With Yao Yao, the maid, now in the modern world, they search for a way to reverse the swap and uncover secrets from ancient times.
When Shizuka Urumi reluctantly works as a high school teacher and aims to keep her distance, her students provoke her to get involved in their lives.
A brilliant, eccentric detective must solve a murder in the White House residence — where the staff and guests at a state dinner are all suspects.
overview_id: Seorang detektif yang brilian dan eksentrik harus memecahkan kasus pembunuhan di Gedung Putih. Di sana, semua staf dan tamu perjamuan kenegaraan jadi tersangka.

overview: Two grieving mothers resurrect a scam ringleader to avenge their daughters — but as painful truths emerge, justice slips from their reach.

Six strangers are brought together by a divorce support group who quickly transform from therapy-seeking victims into architects of retribution. With little in common beyond their pain, they form an unlikely bond. What begins as a cathartic outlet quickly spirals into something far more dangerous.

Mia is fleeing addiction and leaving behind a professional life in tatters in Scotland. She accepts a wedding invitation from her estranged sister in New Zealand – only to find the would-be-bride dead upon arrival. Caught up in grief and pulled by a dark attraction to her late-sister's fiancé Ewan, Mia soon finds that familiarity among a small community breeds secrets and tensions, endangering the brittle fabric of the town itself.

Heir to the powerful Jin Hai Group, Zhao Jiadi rejects his controlling father's path and gives up a top university placement to attend a lesser-known college. Determined to prove himself, he makes a bold bet to build his own business empire. But as his success grows, he attracts the wrath of rival Chen Hongxiong—setting off a fierce battle in the world of business.
overview_id: Zhao Jiadi, pewaris Grup Jinhai, tidak tahan dengan cara licik Ayahnya. Ia memutuskan untuk tidak kuliah di universitas ternama dan memilih untuk kuliah di universitas biasa. Ia bahkan bertaruh jutaan yuan untuk membangun bisnisnya sendiri! Namun, kesuksesannya segera menarik perhatian dari saingannya, Chen Hongxiong. Perang bisnis yang sengit akhirnya terjadi...

overview: Blake Shelton and Taylor Sheridan are the executive producers of this show where aspiring artists will compete to become the next big music star while touring with a headlining superstar.
Explores the murder of Byron Griffy, a respected mortician, who was found dead on his remote ranch, shot execution-style.
This documentary series chronicles the trials and triumphs of Bollywood's iconic Roshan family — musician Roshan Lal Nagrath, Rajesh, Rakesh and Hrithik.
overview_id: Serial dokumenter ini mencatat perjuangan dan kesuksesan keluarga ikon Bollywood, keluarga Roshan, yaitu musisi Roshan Lal Nagrath, Rajesh, Rakesh, dan Hrithik.

overview: Kurisu has always admired his father, who runs a tax accounting firm, and dreamed of working with him one day. To broaden his skills, he joined a major tax firm, but a professional setback left him disillusioned. His life takes an unexpected turn when he meets racehorse owner Sanno Kozo, reigniting his sense of purpose.
When charming Prince Aviraaj meets Sophia, a self-made girl boss, the worlds of royalty and startups collide in a whirlwind of romance and ambition.

Witch clan leader Xia Mo, weakened by the loss of her magical necklace, strikes a deal with physics professor Mu Hanyu, who is on a quest for revenge. As they navigate their intertwined fates, unexpected feelings arise, but destiny soon puts them at odds.
overview_id: Penyihir Cantik Xia Mo terikat oleh kutukan mematikan setelah kehilangan kalungnya. Karena putus asa ingin mendapatkan kalungnya kembali, ia membuat perjanjian dengan Mu Hanyu, seorang profesor fisika yang pendendam. Melalui hubungan yang terus berlanjut, mereka perlahan-lahan jatuh cinta. Namun, takdir mempertemukan mereka satu sama lain...

overview: Betrayed during her ascension ceremony, cultivator Cheng Yan is saved by her contracted beast, Chen. Discovering that an ancient demon has possessed her senior, Cheng Tian, she embarks on a path of vengeance, leading to a final battle to seal the demon and restore peace to the three realms.

Adapted from the novel The Seven Relics of ill Omen by Weiyu. In ancient times, a mysterious substance descended upon Fengzi Ridge. Capable of parasitic invasion, it twists the human heart and lures its host into evil. Now, these relics of ill omen have reemerged, unleashing a series of bizarre and gruesome murders. Five ordinary yet passionate young people—Mu Dai, Luo Ren, Thirteen-Thousand, Yan Hongsha, and Cao Yanhua—are successively drawn into this crisis through their own fateful encounters. They form the "Phoenix Squad" and embark on a perilous quest to subdue these ill omens. Amid life-and-death trials, Luo Ren and Mu Dai heal each other's wounds and forge a genuine bond. Through a long and arduous journey fraught with danger, the five overcome relentless challenges, their friendship tempered and deepened in the fires of adversity.
overview_id: Diadaptasi dari novel “Tujuh Relik Misterius” karya Weiyu. Di zaman kuno, benda misterius yang tidak diketahui asal usulnya jatuh di Puncak Fengzi. Ia bisa menumpang hidup di tubuh manusia dan mengubah hati manusia, bahkan mengarahkan manusia untuk berbuat jahat. Sekarang Parasit Hati muncul lagi di dunia, satu per satu kasus pembunuhan datang secara bergiliran. Mu Dai, Luo Ren, Yi Wansan, Yan Hongsha dan Cao Yanhua, lima anak muda yang penuh semangat secara bergiliran terlibat dalam kasus Parasit Hati karena hal tidak terduga. Mereka berlima membentuk Tim Phoenix dan bersama-sama mengambil risiko untuk mengatasi Parasit Hati. Dalam perjalanan yang membahayakan, Luo Ren dan Mu Dai saling menolong dan memperlakukan satu sama lain dengan tulus. Mereka melakukan perjalanan panjang, menghadapi berbagai kesulitan, persahabatan mereka terus meningkat seiring dengan perjalanan yang mereka jalani.

overview: One year after their parents' mysterious disappearance, sisters Sabrina and Daphne move to a magical town where fairytales are real and secrets lurk behind every corner.
overview_id: Setahun pasca hilangnya orang tua mereka secara misterius, Sabrina dan Daphne pindah ke kota ajaib tempat dongeng menjadi nyata dan rahasia mengintai.

overview: In the Southern Song Dynasty, judicial officer Song Ci finds himself unexpectedly allied with theater performers Zhao Zhiting, Wang Ling, and dancer He Wenning. Despite their contrasting backgrounds, the four form an unlikely team, using keen investigation and forensic skills to solve four intricate murder cases. Together, they bring justice to the dead and fairness to the living, each case strengthening their bond and dedication to the truth.

Desperate for celebrity approval, the newly appointed head of a movie studio and his executive team at Continental Studios must juggle corporate demands with creative ambitions as they try to keep movies alive and relevant.
overview_id: Seth Rogen berperan sebagai kepala studio film yang baru. Keinginannya mendapatkan pengakuan dari para selebriti, dia bersama tim eksekutifnya di Continental Studios harus menyeimbangkan tuntutan perusahaan dengan ambisi kreatif saat mereka mencoba mempertahankan film tetap hidup dan relevan.

overview: Branded a demon since birth, Bai Xiaoying seeks immortality to avenge her father. Bound to the Night God Ye Chenyuan, she uncovers a celestial plot and, through sacrifice and love, fights to restore peace to the heavens.
overview_id: Bai Xiaoying, yang sejak lahir dianggap pembawa malapetaka, bertekad menempuh jalan kultivasi demi membalas dendam ayahnya. Takdir mempertemukannya dengan Dewa Malam, Ye Chenyuan, dan jiwa mereka pun terikat. Dari ikatan itu tumbuh rasa cinta, meski berujung pada pengorbanan besar. Saat Ye Chenyuan lenyap demi melindunginya, Bai Xiaoying bersumpah menunggu ribuan tahun demi kebangkitannya kembali…

overview: Before The Terminal List, Navy SEAL Ben Edwards finds himself entangled in the black operations side of the CIA. The deeper Ben goes into the 'gray', the harder it will become to not give himself over to his darker impulses. Every man has two wolves inside him – light and dark – fighting for control. Which wolf will Ben Edwards feed?
overview_id: Beberapa tahun sebelum peristiwa DAFTAR AKHIR, dua anggota SEAL Angkatan Laut, Ben Edwards dan Raife Hastings, terseret dalam konspirasi spionase internasional saat mereka bertugas untuk CIA. Tapi dalam dunia 'operasi hitam', tak ada yang lolos tanpa luka. Bukan hanya nyawa yang terancam, terkadang jiwa pun ikut menjadi taruhan.

overview: Lin Yue, a man trapped in a time loop for 100,000 years, finally escapes after saving a young saintess. Armed with millennia of experience, he sets off on an epic adventure, only to find that the powerful enemy he could never defeat is now reawakening in the world he’s returned to.

When a wild night at the notorious Paradise Seven party ends with Bam found dead, famous spirit medium Phing is pulled into a twisted murder mystery involving four prime suspects. Lieutenant Dan takes charge of the investigation, secrets, lies, and suspicions collide, and Phing must piece together the truth from fractured memories—both living and dead—before the killer gets away.

After her family is destroyed and she’s killed by the tyrant Jun Che, Lu Yingying is reborn before the tragedy begins. Determined to change her fate, she takes control of her destiny. When she encounters Jun Che again—this time as a powerless slave—she buys him for revenge. But as they face enemies together, hatred turns to love, and their lives become irrevocably intertwined in a battle for justice and redemption.
overview_id: Lu Yingying, putri seorang menteri yang jatuh miskin setelah keluarganya terpuruk, akhirnya menjadi selir sang tiran, Jun Che. Tragisnya, hidupnya justru berakhir di tangan pria itu. Namun, takdir memberinya kesempatan kedua—Yingying terbangun kembali di masa sebelum semua tragedi terjadi. Kali ini, ia bertekad untuk mengubah nasib. Demi mewujudkan tekadnya, ia mendekati Jun Che yang saat itu masih berstatus tahanan, dan membeli pria itu untuk menjadikan majikannya...

overview: To create a top-tier trauma center, a war-seasoned doctor arrives — bringing his blunt but skilled ways to transform his team into life-saving mavericks.
overview_id: Agar jadi pusat layanan trauma terkemuka, dokter yang berpengalaman dalam perang menjadikan timnya penyelamat nyawa independen dengan caranya yang lugas, tetapi terampil.

overview: The youngest forensic doctor in Licheng, Qi Sizhe, loses his girlfriend, Yu Fei, in a car accident. However, he soon uncovers a mysterious force behind the crash. Determined to find the truth, he joins the criminal investigation team in Hecheng, only to be caught in a series of bizarre, chilling cases. Victims long dead are wrapped in webs, and missing bodies appear preserved in formalin in the morgue. As he teams up with Zhu Qingyue and Han Feng, they break case after case. And the truth behind Yu Fei's death and the "Original Diamond" drug case begins to surface…

Amanda Knox arrives in Italy for her study abroad only to be wrongfully imprisoned for murder weeks later. Follow Knox's relentless fight to prove her innocence and reclaim her freedom and examines why authorities and the world stood so firmly in judgment.

After her family is massacred, Shen Qingru infiltrates the General’s household through marriage to seek revenge against the man she believes destroyed her life. Trapped within palace intrigue, she becomes entangled in a turbulent relationship of love and hatred, until the truth behind the massacre is revealed—forcing both to choose between vengeance, sacrifice, and redemption amid a brutal power struggle.
overview_id: Keluarga Shen Qingru dibantai hingga habis. Mengira Yu Wenque sebagai pelakunya, ia pun memulai jalan balas dendam. Ia menikah masuk ke kediaman sang jenderal dan terkurung di istana, terjebak dalam hubungan cinta dan benci yang saling menyiksa dengan Yu Wenque. Pada akhirnya, kebenaran terungkap—Yu Wenque rela mengorbankan segalanya demi melindunginya. Keduanya berdamai, dan Shen Qingru kembali pada asal-usulnya sebagai Putri Cangzhou, menemukan penebusan di tengah perebutan kekuasaan.

overview: For centuries, humans and demons have battled over the legendary Yuli Spring, a symbol of desire. Free-spirited Xiao Yao unexpectedly enters Ten Thousand Demons Valley, disrupting the demon world. There, she meets the powerful Demon King Hong Ye, who grows to admire her pure heart. Together, they face mysterious cases and formidable enemies, uncovering hidden truths along the way.

Framed as the notorious Night Devil on his wedding day, top detective Xiao Beiming is accused of murder and treason, forcing him to flee. Three years later, he returns to the capital, earning the trust of his apprentice sister, Zhong Xueman. With a team of fearless allies, he unravels a series of mysterious cases, to expose the real Night Devil and restore order to Da Qi.
overview_id: Xiao Beiming, petugas penangkap terbaik dari Daqi yang melarikan diri setelah difitnah membunuh guru dan berkhianat pada negara. Tiga tahun kemudian, ia kembali ke ibu kota. Bersama dengan adik seperguruan, Zhong Xueman, dan sekelompok rekan yang cerdas dan berani, bekerja sama memecahkan berbagai kasus aneh, mengungkap kebenaran di balik Ye Sha, meredakan gejolak Daqi, dan melindungi rakyat.

overview: When a fearsome and ancient species emerges from the ocean, dramatically revealing themselves to humanity, an international crisis is triggered. With the entire population at risk, UNIT step into action as the land and sea wage war.
A prominent North Carolina fishing family wades into treacherous waters to keep their crumbling business empire afloat.
overview_id: Sebuah keluarga nelayan yang ternama asal Carolina Utara memasuki wilayah berbahaya demi mempertahankan kerajaan bisnisnya yang nyaris ambruk.

overview: Follows three high schoolers mistakenly transported to a brutal medieval world. Falling in with unlikely comrades caught in a civil war, the teens fight for survival as they search for a way back home.

During an interview mission in the turbulent East Country, Song Ran, a female reporter from Liangcheng Satellite TV, came across a sudden danger. Thankfully, Li Zan, a Chinese explosive engineer who volunteered in the East Country, was able to save her. After multiple interactions, Li Zan discovered that despite appearing weak on the outside, Song Ran was brave, strong, and full of justice and kindness. The same ideals and compatible souls ignited the love between them.

A sudden bombing attack ended their budding relationship, and they fell into a trough of life after returning to China and even losing contact with each other. By chance, they came across each other again, and gradually, their lives got back on track. Together, they planted the seeds of the white olive tree.
overview_id: Saat melakukan wawancara di negara Timur yang bergejolak, reporter Song Ran diselamatkan oleh Li Zan, seorang insinyur bahan peledak sukarelawan. Kelembutan Li Zan menarik perhatian Song Ran, sementara Li Zan mengagumi keberanian dan kebaikan Song Ran. Keduanya jatuh cinta, namun sebuah serangan bom menghentikan hubungan mereka. Setelah kembali ke Tiongkok, keduanya mengalami penderitaan fisik dan mental, dengan Li Zan merasa bersalah atas kematian temannya dan Song Ran terlibat dalam kontroversi. Takdir membawa mereka kembali bersama, dan mereka mulai membangun hidup baru, menanam pohon zaitun putih sebagai simbol cinta mereka.

overview: Explore hidden corners of Earth with a trio of experts as they try to save six endangered species from extinction. With crafty camerawork and survival skills, the team race to find, record, and protect these elusive creatures before it's too late.
overview_id: Bagaimana cara kita membantu hewan yang terancam punah? Ikuti perjalanan tim pembuat film satwa liar ke sudut-sudut terpencil di dunia demi menangkap rekaman inovatif spesies paling sulit dipahami di planet ini menggunakan teknologi mutakhir.

overview: A disgraced former rugby star returns as a coach to his high school’s struggling team, where he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and helps the determined captain lead the team to redemption.
The story of a woman who is kicked out of her village and called a "witch" when the men that she likes get hurt or die, and a man who risks his life to try to save her from the law of death.
After a life of solitude, a lawyer finds companionship with an art teacher. But behind their quiet union lies a secret that could change everything.

After the sudden loss of her husband, Mingzhu, pregnant and newly married, is forced to confront hidden family secrets. With strength and resilience, she faces numerous challenges and works to rebuild her life, bringing her family together in the process.
overview_id: Hidup Mingzhu tampak sempurna, baru menikah dan mengandung anak pertamanya, namun semuanya berubah ketika suaminya meninggal secara tragis. Saat berjuang melanjutkan hidup, ia dipertemukan kembali dengan keluarga kandung yang lama hilang. Namun kebahagiaan yang baru tumbuh harus diuji lagi ketika rahasia dan beban masa lalu mulai terungkap…

overview: Jin Xiaowan, betrayed by her boyfriend and killed in a car crash, reincarnates into a 5-year-old prodigy in 1999. Using modern knowledge, she helps mother Lin Han escape her toxic boyfriend, transforms her into a tiger mom, and becomes a wealthy kid. While pushing Lin toward romance with Ying Huiming, she discovers her mother is also reborn, but Lin's secret scheme surpasses her plans.
overview_id: Jin Xiaowan meninggal karena kecelakaan yang disebabkan pacarnya, lalu terlahir kembali di tahun 1999 sebagai anak jenius umur lima tahun. Ia membantu ibunya, Lin Han, menjauh dari pria jahat, jadi kaya, dan bertemu pria baik. Tapi saat tahu ibunya juga mungkin terlahir kembali, rahasia besar pun terungkap.

overview: After being reborn, Jiang Xueying swaps marriages with her sister and becomes the Crown Princess. She must outwit rival women in the household and join forces with her seemingly idle husband to expose a dangerous conspiracy.
overview_id: Dua putri keluarga Jiang terlahir kembali. Jiang Xueying menukar perjodohan dengan adiknya dan menjadi istri pangeran. Ia menghadapi saingan licik, termasuk Jiang Yu’er, dan mengubah suaminya yang ceroboh. Bersama, mereka mengungkap konspirasi jahat yang mengancam keluarga dan kerajaan.

overview: Once a far-off promise, now a reality — three buddies finally hit the road in Kenya. Get ready for adventure, banter and maybe even a giraffe selfie.

Antique dealer Wu Xie stumbles upon a cryptic silk text, leading his uncle and a team to explore its hidden map. Facing deadly creatures and uncovering a serpentine bronze fish, they reveal buried secrets—until his uncle vanishes with a mysterious woman, propelling them into a new quest.
overview_id: Wu Xie, pedagang barang antik, menemukan teks sutra misterius yang membawa paman dan timnya ke peta tersembunyi. Dari makhluk mematikan hingga rahasia perunggu berbentuk ikan, mereka terus digiring ke misteri lebih dalam, sampai pamannya lenyap bersama seorang wanita misterius, membuka pintu petualangan baru.

overview: After being unexpectedly pulled into the world of a fantasy novel, Li Song'er, a sheltered princess from the Kingdom of Zuimeng, finds herself entangled with a notorious dark lord. With her only way home tied to him, the two are forced into a reluctant partnership, one that quickly turns into a passionate and turbulent love-hate journey.
overview_id: Kabur dari Gu Yuan adalah tujuan Li Song’er. Tapi saat ia tahu pria itu satu-satunya jalan pulang, semuanya berubah. Apa yang terjadi saat benci berubah jadi rindu?

overview: Li Fuyuan returns to her hometown years after her brother’s suspicious death, teaming up with a seemingly carefree magistrate to uncover the truth behind a long-unsolved case.
overview_id: Tiga belas tahun setelah kehancuran keluarganya di masa kecil, Li Fuyuan kembali ke Huachang untuk membalas dendam atas kematian kakaknya yang dibunuh. Di sana, ia bertemu Lu Yanchong, magistrat kabupaten yang tampak sembrono dan tak berguna. Namun, seiring identitas dan tujuan asli Lu Yanchong perlahan terungkap, kecurigaan di antara mereka berubah menjadi kerja sama. Bersama-sama, mereka menyelidiki serangkaian kasus misterius hingga akhirnya mengungkap kebenaran di balik tragedi di masa lalu.

overview: Assassin Di Shiqi, disguised as a princess on a political mission, infiltrates the palace with a hidden agenda. There, she encounters the enigmatic fifth prince, Ouyang Shao, sparking an unexpected bond. As duty and emotion collide, their paths intertwine in a high-stakes tale of love and betrayal.

Three colleagues at a confectionery company struggle to break free from financial hardship. When they turn to cryptocurrency as a possible solution, their lives are shaken by risk, reward, and unexpected change. Alongside a successful but unfulfilled big data director, they face risk, ambition, and the search for meaning in an uncertain world.

A naive, fair-skinned country boy from Yamagata moves to Tokyo for work and has a one-night stand with an older city woman. As they navigate their feelings, they question whether their connection is real or just a fleeting moment.

In Tokyo, police officer Mari Kouda and Chinese interpreter Ryo Arikino solve cases while bonding over meals from different cultures, forming an unexpected connection through their shared experiences.
When a heartbroken New Yorker moves to London hoping for a love story, she falls for an indie musician who's anything but the typical romantic hero.
overview_id: Seorang warga New York yang patah hati pindah ke London, berharap memulai cinta. Ia jatuh hati kepada musisi indi yang jelas bukan pangeran romantis seperti pada umumnya.

overview: Princess Nangong Ying betrays Crown Prince Su Wuyang, the man who loved her, to avenge her fallen kingdom. Believing his love died with her betrayal, he moves on—until five years later, when seeing her with General Pei Xian reignites his jealousy, obsession, and heartbreak.
overview_id: Putri dari negara yang telah runtuh, Nangong Ying, secara pribadi menikam Putra Mahkota Su Wuying, yang sangat mencintainya, untuk membalas kehancuran negaranya. Su Wuying percaya hatinya telah mati saat Nangong Ying mencelakainya. Namun lima tahun kemudian, ketika ia melihat sang putri hidup rukun dengan jenderal muda Pei Xian, hatinya yang seharusnya telah mati itu masih terasa sakit dan terbakar oleh rasa cemburu, membuatnya menjadi gila.

overview: Ten years after surviving the massacre of his clan, Shen Song, now a humble chef, is drawn back into his quest for justice when a festival fire uncovers hidden remains. Appointed as the emperor’s civilian investigator, he tackles a series of strange cases, uncovering conspiracies tied to his family’s tragic past.
When dozens of babies in Corby are born with disabilities, their mothers embark on a battle to hold those responsible to account.
overview_id: Saat lusinan bayi di Corby lahir dengan disabilitas, para ibu memulai pertempuran untuk meminta tanggung jawab dari para pihak yang terlibat.

overview: Follow the popular J-Pop group Snow Man as they journey north from Okinawa to Hokkaido, showcasing the members’ adventures as they meet locals, savor regional cuisine, and explore the sights together. Joining them on this adventure is Tabi, an AI-style robot who acts as the group's 10th member – capturing their candid moments throughout the show.

Li Ya’er steps in to receive his father’s bride, but the wedding night turns horrific when the bride mysteriously burns to death and assassins leave him injured, amnesiac, and sold into slavery. As a buried conspiracy exposes his true identity, he becomes entangled in a turbulent master-servant romance that puts them on opposing sides. Together, they unravel the plot threatening the Tang dynasty and fight to protect both the realm and the fragile bond between them.
overview_id: Li Ya'er kehilangan ingatannya dan terpaksa menjadi budak setelah diserang pembunuh bayaran pada malam pernikahan yang berakhir tragis. Saat rahasia masa lalunya terbongkar, ia terlibat dalam kisah cinta rumit dengan pria berhati dingin dan harus menghadapi intrik serta konspirasi berbahaya di balik misteri berdarah untuk melindungi negeri Dinasti Tang.

overview: As illegal firearms flood into a gun-free South Korea, a resolute cop and a mysterious partner join forces to stop the chaos from sweeping the nation.
overview_id: Saat senjata api ilegal membanjiri Korea Selatan yang bebas senjata, polisi tegas dan mitra misteriusnya bersatu demi menghentikan kekacauan melanda negeri.

overview: Follow Stanley Tucci as he returns to Italy for more food-based adventures, seeking out the essence of each region and its people through the food they eat.
A group of heroes, each embodying one of the 12 zodiac signs, battles to defend the Korean Peninsula from malevolent spirits.

In a small town, twelve mysterious letters and a 35-year wait intertwine to shape the lives and loves of a close-knit group of friends. Yu Nian and Shen Cheng’s world is thrown into turmoil when their parents vanish, followed by cryptic messages arriving from another time. Driven to uncover the truth, they plunge into a complex puzzle, navigating dual timelines and unraveling the secrets hidden within the letters that could explain their disappearance.
overview_id: Dua belas surat misterius dan penantian selama 35 tahun menjadi awal cerita. Drama ini menceritakan cinta anak-anak muda di sebuah kota kecil, dibalut dengan fantasi, diwarnai unsur misteri, dan digerakkan oleh emosi. Dua ruang-waktu yang saling terhubung melalui papan tulis di ruang kelas tua, penuh teka-teki dan ketegangan.

overview: Chi Yu, a cold-hearted phoenix divine beast, unexpectedly forms a twin soul pact with Mu Lingxue, a mortal girl whose family was destroyed by treachery. Bound together on a fateful full moon night, the two grow through shared hardships, forging trust and strength as they face powerful enemies.
overview_id: Chi Yu, phoenix suci dari klan Api Merah, telah lama menutup hatinya dari cinta. Hingga suatu hari ia bertemu Mu Lingxue, gadis manusia yang keluarganya hancur akibat pengkhianatan. Pada malam bulan purnama, keduanya membentuk perjanjian jiwa yang menyatukan takdir mereka. Sejak itu, mereka menjalani perjalanan penuh rintangan, bertarung bahu-membahu untuk membalas dendam dan menyelamatkan dunia.

overview: Depicts the struggles of small and medium-sized businesses and their families who face the 1997 IMF crisis head-on.

After a traffic accident, taxi driver Fat's soul enters the body of pregnant homemaker Ching, forcing him to navigate her family life while only his daughter Rene can see the truth. As he learns to be a wife and mother, Ching faces unexpected challenges of her own. Through humor and struggles, they help each other grow, working toward the shared goal of bringing Ching’s baby into the world.

After blaming her family’s downfall on her ex-husband Xiang Yang, Leng Xiaoxiao undergoes plastic surgery and manipulates her kind best friend Xie Yuxuan into helping her carry out a revenge scheme. But as unexpected complications arise, Xie Yuxuan begins to see Xiang Yang’s true character — and even develops feelings for him.

Ace NIS agent Jung Hae-seong is demoted after a mission failure. He goes undercover at a high school to locate King Gojong's missing gold, meeting his teacher Oh Soo-ah, who sees him as her lost first love, stirring old heartbreak.

In modern-day Seoul, a crack team of investigative journalists fight for their careers after broadcasting a controversial story. With time running out, the team are given an impossible task if they want to save their jobs – solve a twenty-year-old cold case involving a famous actor who disappeared without a trace.

Fire investigator Xu Tongsheng is determined to uncover the truth behind an old case involving his family. He reunites with his childhood friend, forensic doctor Xin Chun, and criminal investigation deputy captain Shen Ye during his work. The three collaborate to establish a rapid response mechanism for major fire incidents and work together to solve a series of mysterious fire cases.
overview_id: Drama ini mengisahkan perjalanan Xu Tongsheng, seorang penyelidik kebakaran yang bertekad mengungkap kebenaran di balik kasus lama keluarganya. Dalam pekerjaannya, ia bertemu kembali dengan teman masa kecilnya, forensik Xin Chun dan Wakil Kapten Unit Kriminal, Shen Ye.Bersama-sama, mereka membentuk mekanisme respons cepat untuk menangani kasus kebakaran besar dan bekerja sama mengungkap serangkaian insiden kebakaran misterius.

overview: In the vast expanse of Yosemite National Park, a woman's death draws a federal agent into lawless terrain — where nature obeys no rules but its own.
overview_id: Di hamparan lahan luas Taman Nasional Yosemite, kematian seorang wanita menyeret seorang agen federal ke wilayah tanpa hukum—tempat alam hanya menaati aturannya sendiri.

overview: Hosted by renowned wildlife biologist, conservationist, and adventurer Forrest Galante, the six-episode series will take audiences on a visually stunning journey into Vantara, the world's largest wildlife rescue and rehabilitation facility that offers lifelong care for some of the most magnificent animals on Earth. Located in Gujarat, India, Vantara is a closed-to-the-public sanctuary designed for the wellbeing of the animals who live there. It is home to over one million animals, representing over 1000 species and is operated by a dedicated team of 25,000 employees. Now, for the first time ever, Galante offers an unprecedented look inside the walls of this extraordinary, not-for-profit sanctuary - a world very few have ever been allowed to enter.

The Lin family’s live-in son-in-law, Ye Dong, pretends to be the perfect husband while secretly plotting to seize everything the family owns. After being betrayed by her deceitful husband, Lin Xia miraculously regains her sight and vows to take revenge. Reborn from pain, she sets out to expose his crimes and cleanse the darkness that destroyed her family.
overview_id: Suami Lin Xia, Ye Dong, tampak seperti suami sempurna, padahal diam-diam berambisi merebut seluruh harta keluarga Lin. Ia menjebak Lin Xia hingga buta, berselingkuh dengan sekretarisnya, dan bahkan membunuh ayahnya di depan mata istrinya yang tak berdaya. Saat penglihatannya pulih akibat kekejaman ibu mertuanya, Lin Xia menyadari seluruh kebusukan yang tersembunyi. Dari kehancuran, ia bangkit menyalakan api dendam dan bersumpah menuntut balas atas semua yang telah direnggut darinya.

overview: Step into Victoria Beckham's London atelier, as the Spice Girl-turned-powerhouse designer opens up about her life while preparing for Paris Fashion Week.

Wang Heng, a disillusioned modern man, is transported to the Western Han dynasty, where he meets De Jiu, a warrior woman who resembles his ex-girlfriend, and befriends the carefree Prince Liu He. Together, they attempt to change fate, but personal struggles and painful choices lead them on a journey of growth, redemption, and unexpected healing.
overview_id: Wang Heng, pemuda terpuruk, tiba-tiba terlempar ke masa Dinasti Han Barat. Ia bertemu pendekar wanita mirip mantan kekasihnya dan bersahabat dengan Liu He yang ceria. Mereka bertekad melawan sejarah, mencoba mengubah nasib Liu He yang hanya bertakhta 27 hari. Sebuah petualangan lintas waktu penuh tantangan pun dimulai.

overview: Eun-soo is a housewife, who struggles to pay for her husband's medical expenses. He is terminally ill. Eun-soo becomes entangled in a bag of drugs with a teacher named Yi-kyeong. He is a mysterious figure. Eun-soo and Yi-kyeong are chased by veteran detective Tae-gu.

11-year-old George Washington "Wash" Black embarks on a globe-trotting journey of identity after fleeing a Barbados sugar plantation aboard a flying machine in the company of his master’s eccentric inventor brother.

A year after the death of his friend and partner Sherlock Holmes at the hands of Moriarty, Dr. John Watson resumes his medical career as the head of a clinic dedicated to treating rare disorders. However, he soon finds that his old life is not done with him yet.
A struggling single mom rallies her quirky family to outsmart a mafia boss after her estranged, wealthy father dies, leaving them with massive debt.
overview_id: Ibu tunggal ini berjuang menyatukan keluarganya yang unik demi mengalahkan bos mafia, setelah sang ayah yang kaya tetapi lama terpisah wafat dan meninggalkan utang besar.

overview: After inheriting her father's struggling store, Wan bonds with a charming regular who offers to help, but her new friend's family have other ideas.

Modern-day office drone Zou Yan accidentally stumbles into the world of cultivation and wakes up as Liao Tingyan, a disciple of the Qinggutian Sect. She's soon selected to serve the reclusive Grandmaster Sima Jiao, a powerful cultivator who's been secretly sealed inside a mountain for 500 years. Twisted by isolation and rage, he's cold, hot-tempered, and bent on revenge. Liao Tingyan doesn't know that "her" original identity is a demonic assassin. But to his surprise, she shows no ill will, no ambition, and no desire at all. Her nature fascinates him. Thus begins an unlikely romance between a villainous immortal and a healing-type "slacker," a connection that defies fate and spans lifetimes.
In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs — proving love endures across time.
overview_id: Di Jeju, kisah gadis energik dan pemuda gigih di pulau itu bersemi jadi riwayat panjang penuh kegagalan dan kesuksesan—bukti bahwa cinta bisa bertahan melintasi waktu.

overview: Jing Qiu, a young woman from a politically stigmatized family, is sent to the countryside, where she falls for Lao San, a talented local man. As their bond deepens, social class differences and family pressures threaten to tear them apart, putting their quiet love and a promise to see the hawthorn tree bloom at risk.
overview_id: Pada awal tahun 1970-an, Jing Qiu, seorang gadis dari keluarga yang "bermasalah", dikirim ke pedesaan untuk dididik ulang. Saat mendokumentasikan sejarah desa di Xicunping, ia bertemu dengan Lao San yang berbakat dan tampan. Kisah cinta mereka yang baru dimulai, sudah harus menghadapi cobaan berat: stigma kelas, pertentangan keluarga, dan hierarki sosial yang kaku. Apakah janji mereka untuk bersama akan terwujud?

overview: From two different worlds and with separate missions, an astronaut and a space tourist entangle in space — only to start falling for each other.

Aspiring filmmakers Michelle, Jacky, and Gthan launch their own online channel with rising KOLs Yannis and Sugar. When Yannis gains fame and considers leaving for a rival platform, they scramble to find a new star, leading them to Anna. As they navigate the challenges of online success and failure, they confront the harsh reality that while success is rare, the journey—and the digital footprints they leave—lasts forever.

When an influential and fearsome clan is massacred in mysterious circumstances, the clan’s talented disciple Tang Lici finds himself accused of masterminding the crime. Accusers say that Tang Lici is a traitor who murdered his master. A decade later, suspicions about Tang Lici linger, but much darker forces are conspiring to unleash chaos into the realm. Torn by his duality and his apparent inability to distinguish between good and evil, Tang Lici finds himself drawn back into the wider world to help defeat the evil conspiracy – armed only with his wits and his martial arts skills. His path soon crosses with former acquaintances, with some swearing enmity and others allied to his cause. Can he and his companions help defeat the forces of wickedness – or will his dual nature prove his undoing?
overview_id: Drama ini mengisahkan Tang Lici, seorang pendekar misterius yang berasal dari dunia lain, yang menjalani perjalanan dan pertumbuhan di dunia persilatan dan dataran Shenzhou. Di tengah dunia yang penuh kerumitan dan pertarungan sengit, ia bertekad untuk menjaga kedamaian dunia.

overview: After her ex-cop father is murdered on Christmas Eve, Komugi finds a letter hinting at a dark conspiracy and teams up with a lawyer to uncover the truth.
overview_id: Usai ayahnya—mantan polisi—dibunuh di malam Natal, Komugi menemukan surat yang mengisyaratkan adanya konspirasi kelam. Bersama si pengacara, ia mencoba menguak kebenaran.

overview: A quirky yet kind-hearted man, firmly against marriage, sparks humor and reflection as he navigates life. Despite his eccentricity, he finally meets the woman of his dreams and must decide how to win her heart, proving there's no man who won't marry, just one who hasn't found the right match yet.
overview_id: Seorang pria eksentrik tapi berhati lembut menjadi bahan candaan sekaligus misteri bagi sekitarnya. Di usia matang, ia tetap bersikeras tak ingin menikah. Apakah karena ia takut cinta, atau belum menemukan orang yang tepat? Hingga sosok perempuan impiannya muncul，akankah prinsipnya goyah, atau justru hatinya yang kalah?

overview: In a turbulent era, a rich young master falls for a lowly opera performer. Despite harsh social divides, rumors, and betrayal, they bravely fight for a passionate love, determined to be together against all odds.
overview_id: Di masa penuh kekacauan, pewaris kaya jatuh cinta pada aktris sederhana. Meski terhalang status sosial, gosip, dan pengkhianatan, mereka tetap saling mendekat. Kota yang tampak gemerlap menyimpan konflik, dan panggung kecil mencerminkan gejolak zaman. Mereka berjanji untuk tetap mencintai dengan sepenuh hati.

overview: Fallen heiress Cheng Youran assumes a new identity to seek revenge on Xu Shian, the son of her mother’s killer. As she gathers evidence, Xu Shian discovers her secret and secretly aids her, leading to a shocking revelation about the true mastermind behind her mother’s death.
A student at a top entertainment school chases her dream of becoming a pop manager. Will a rival learn a secret from her past – and derail her plans?
As a championship game looms, eight characters are thrown a curveball in their off-the-field lives.

When Bloom discovers she has magic, her life takes a wild turn. At the Alfea school for fairies and witches, she meets five girls who become her best friends — and her greatest strength. Together, they’re the Winx. As dark secrets rise and powerful enemies close in, the Winx will need to unlock their true potential to protect their world — and themselves.
A young commoner comes of age and learns he's the last of a long line of Werewolves — and heir to the throne.
overview_id: Di serial petualangan fantasi ini, seorang remaja biasa beranjak dewasa dan mendapati bahwa ia adalah generasi terakhir Manusia Serigala—dan penerus takhta.

overview: A couple who pretend to be newlyweds, find themselves developing genuine feelings for each other as they navigate their fake marriage.
From Monday Night RAW to WrestleMania, this series goes backstage with WWE Superstars and staff as they bring the company's biggest spectacles to life.
From teen years to adulthood, two friends linked by warmth and tension grow apart — until one is asked to accompany the other through her final days.
overview_id: Dua sahabat sejak remaja, yang akrab karena kehangatan dan ketegangan, tumbuh terpisah—sampai salah satunya diminta menemani sang sahabat melewati hari-hari terakhirnya.

overview: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.
overview_id: Ikuti perjalanan Peter Parker menjadi pahlawan, dengan gaya yang mengangkat akar karakter ini dari komik-komiknya yang pertama.

overview: When a financial titan suddenly finds himself divorced and jobless, he starts robbing his wealthy neighbors to stay afloat. Stealing from his own social circle strangely exhilarates him—but he gradually gets tangled in a deadly web.
overview_id: Saat seorang raksasa finansial mendadak diceraikan dan menganggur, dia mulai merampok orang kaya untuk hidup. Mencuri dari lingkaran sosialnya membuatnya senang, tapi dia perlahan terjerat dalam jaring mematikan.

overview: When General Jiang Xu returns to the capital after eight years to investigate military corruption, he enters a strategic marriage with a strong-willed noblewoman, Ming Tan. As they navigate political intrigue and work to protect their families, an unexpected romance gradually blossoms between them.

A chance encounter brings the Shen family to Yong'an City, where they meet Lin Yan, a magistrate. Their journey unfolds into a whimsical tale of gourmet delights, local traditions, and an unexpected romance.
overview_id: Mengisahkan keluarga Shen yang secara tak sengaja tiba di Kota Yong'an dan bertemu dengan Lin Yan, seorang pejabat kerajaan. Perjalanan ini membawa mereka pada petualangan unik penuh keajaiban yang melibatkan makanan lezat, tradisi rakyat, dan cinta yang tak terduga. Namun, bagaimana akhir perjalanan mereka?

overview: A former U.S. President is called out of retirement to find the source of a deadly cyberattack, only to discover a vast web of lies and conspiracies.
overview_id: Seorang mantan Presiden AS dipanggil dari masa pensiunnya untuk menemukan sumber sebuah serangan siber. Ia menemukan jaringan besar berisikan kebohongan dan konspirasi.

overview: In a city plagued by terrifying undead and mysterious illnesses, the sorcerer Dongqing emerges from seclusion to investigate. Suspicious of both supernatural and human causes, he sets out to uncover the truth behind the deadly chaos threatening Xuancheng.
When an apocalyptic virus that turns people into zombies ravages a city, a group of students take shelter in a school and fight to survive.
overview_id: Saat virus yang membawa kiamat dan mengubah orang-orang menjadi zombi menyerang sebuah kota, sekelompok murid berlindung di sekolah dan bertarung demi bertahan hidup.

overview: Ichiko and Otoya are happily married, despite not having sex for the last two years. The secret to their happiness is Otoya's affair with Mitsuki, which Ichiko approves. Everything is going well until Otoya rejects Ichiko's advances on the night of their seventh anniversary. In shock, Ichiko seeks advice from her friend who suggests she exercise her right to have a boyfriend of her own.
A popular student gravitates toward someone she only knows online, forcing her lovesick classmate to decide if she should reveal her true identity.
Across continents and decades, five brilliant friends make earth-shattering discoveries as the laws of science unravel and an existential threat emerges.
overview_id: Melintasi beberapa benua dan dekade, lima sahabat brilian menemukan berbagai hal mengejutkan saat hukum-hukum sains terungkap dan sebuah ancaman eksistensial muncul.

overview: A cash-strapped young man, a gifted realtor and a pair of fake exorcists form an unlikely squad to sell houses haunted by spirits.
Anabel Segura's abduction held Spain in suspense for 900 days. This docuseries explores the case through never-before-heard recordings of the kidnappers.
overview_id: Penculikan Anabel Segura membuat Spanyol tegang 900 hari. Dokumenter ini mengupas kasus itu lewat rekaman para penculiknya yang diperdengarkan untuk pertama kalinya.

overview:
Hiroshige Akihisa works for a karaoke company. When he is interviewed about the past 30 years of the Japanese music industry, he gets confused when he is asked about his high school student days. An incident that happened 29 years ago caused him to suppress his memories, which have now come back.

On March 20, 1995, the Tokyo subway sarin attack took place. At that time, Akihisa was a high school student who got good grades and was well-mannered, but the Tokyo subway sarin attack led him to face the death of someone he knew and shook his world. Around that time, he was suddenly called out by his classmate Suzuki Shotaro, whom he wasn't very close to. Shotaro asked him if he wanted to live vacantly into his adulthood and then die. Would he be happy living that type of life? Akihisa then joined Shotaro’s group and hung out with them in Shibuya. One day, Shotaro is attacked by someone. Akihisa decides to take revenge on the attacker and begins to search for him.

Count Alexander Rostov finds himself going from riches to rags following the Russian revolution. A Soviet tribunal banishes him to the attic room of an opulent hotel, where, oblivious to the world outside, he discovers the true value of friendship, family and love.

Five years after the death of schoolgirl Andie Bell, Pippa Fitz-Amobi sets out to uncover what really happened to her. Sal Singh, Andie's boyfriend, admitted to the murder before taking his own life, but Pip doesn't believe he's responsible and teams up with Sal's brother Ravi to uncover the truth. If Sal Singh isn't a murderer and the real killer is still out there, how far will they go to keep Pip from finding out the truth?
When one accidental killing leads to another, an ordinary young man finds himself stuck in an endless cat-and-mouse chase with a shrewd detective.
overview_id: Saat suatu pembunuhan tak disengaja memunculkan pembunuhan serupa lainnya, pemuda biasa ini terjebak dalam aksi kucing-kucingan tanpa henti dengan detektif yang lihai.

overview: Gu Yizhong, a scion of the Gu family in Suzhou, returns to China after completing his studies in the Architecture Department at the University of Pennsylvania. When the war breaks out, a failed rescue mission to assist his underground party girlfriend exposes all the contacts of the Suzhou underground organization. Falsely framed and accused by the Japanese collaborators, Gu Yizhong is mistaken for a traitor within the party. Unable to prove his innocence, he takes the initiative to infiltrate the Japanese collaborators and eventually becomes an undercover agent in the Suzhou special operations station of the Communist Party.

Chadjen and Som-O have been friends since their childhood. They go to the same kindergarten, primary, and high schools, but Som-O only realizes that she loves Chadjen when they attend university! Or is he Som-O's true love? But she thinks it can't be because no matter how many years have passed, Chadjen's feelings toward her are still unclear! Will this friendship that blossoms into love turn into true love or one-sided love in the end?

Supreme Court's Nan Fengyi and demon broker Meng Xizhou cross paths through a crime, leading her to apprentice under him as they team up to capture demons. Their growing bond is tested when Meng Xizhou’s inner demon takes control, and Nan Fengyi discovers the demonic core she lost resides within him.
overview_id: Nan Fengyi dari Mahkamah Agung dan perantara Meng Xizhou bertemu karena sebuah insiden dan bersama-sama menangkap siluman. Ketika hubungan mereka semakin dalam, Meng Xizhou yang dikendalikan mantra siluman mengungkapkan rahasia tentang inti siluman yang ada dalam tubuh Nan Fengyi. Untuk menyelamatkan kekasihnya, Nan Fengyi mengembalikan inti tersebut dan menghabiskan sisa hidupnya bersama Meng Xizhou untuk melawan kejahatan dan membebaskan yang tidak bersalah.

overview: Facing relentless foes and sudden bankruptcy, an Atlanta real estate tycoon must claw his way back to the top when his empire begins to crumble.
overview_id: Menghadapi para musuh yang gigih dan kebangkrutan yang mendadak, seorang taipan real estat Atlanta harus berjuang untuk kembali berjaya saat kerajaannya mulai runtuh.

overview: A retired professor with a knack for snooping gets a new lease on life when a private investigator recruits him to go undercover and crack a case.
overview_id: Sang pensiunan profesor yang ahli menggali informasi mendapat kesempatan baru dalam hidupnya saat seorang detektif swasta merekrutnya untuk menyamar dan memecahkan kasus.

overview: Enter an unseen micro-verse where miniature heroes use amazing superpowers to survive in a series of spellbinding dramas.

Anaís Mallory is a smart and savvy homicide investigator who after returning to her hometown, and taking the lead detective position, faces a series of startlingly complex murders with links to her family's tragic history.
Struggling with existential angst and longing for his past life in an orange, a man navigates his quirky family in this decades-spanning drama.
A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.
